title: Customer Success Manager Grands Comptes - Cabinets comptables H/F
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 900,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Le rôle

En tant que Customer Success Manager Key Accounts (CSM KA), tu accompagnes un portefeuille de cabinets partenaires grands comptes (7 à 10 comptes, Top 150) qui déploient Pennylane auprès de leurs équipes et de leurs clients. Ton objectif : maximiser l’adoption, la satisfaction et la rétention, tout en structurant une gouvernance adaptée à des organisations multi-bureaux.

Tes responsabilités

  • Piloter la relation au quotidien avec les décisionnaires et équipes projet du cabinet.

  • Construire et animer la gouvernance : COPIL, comités d’adoption, instances de suivi, communauté de relais locaux.

  • Définir et exécuter des plans d’adoption (collaborateurs + clients) fondés sur la donnée.

  • Coordonner l’exécution avec les expert·e·s internes Pennylane (Produit, Support, Ops, Sales, etc.).

  • Anticiper les risques (satisfaction, déploiement, adoption) et mettre en place des plans de remédiation.

  • Contribuer à l’inscription et à l’usage de la PA Pennylane pour centraliser les flux.

Ce que tu vas faire concrètement

1) Stratégie d’embarquement clients (TPE/PME)

  • Conseiller les cabinets sur la communication, l’activation et la formation des clients.

  • Aider à intégrer les enjeux de facture électronique dans le plan d’embarquement.

  • Suivre l’exécution post-déploiement et proposer des actions correctives.

2) Adoption et usage côté collaborateurs

  • Mesurer l’usage et identifier les leviers d’amélioration.

  • Mettre en place des plans d’action et en piloter l’exécution.

3) Satisfaction & rétention

  • Maintenir une relation de confiance, cadrer les attentes et délivrer de la valeur.

  • Déployer des plans d’action stratégiques (annuels / semestriels) avec les partenaires.

Indicateurs de réussite

  • CSAT sur ton portefeuille.

  • Progression de l’adoption (collaborateurs et clients), suivie en COPIL.

  • Qualité de la gouvernance et autonomie des relais locaux.

  • Réduction des risques et amélioration de la rétention.

  

Profil recherché

 

  • Expérience de 5 ans minimum :

    • en Customer Success SaaS avec de bonnes bases comptables (ou motivé(e) à monter en compétences à ce sujet

    • ou en finance / audit avec gestion de relation clients (dimension commerciale)

  • Excellente relation client : capacité à rassurer, structurer, et prendre de la hauteur.

  • Assertivité : recommandations claires, diplomatie et capacité à convaincre.

  • Pilotage de portefeuille (santé client), plans d’action ad hoc.

  • Analyse de données : tirer des insights et prioriser.

  • Gestion de projet : coordination multi-interlocuteurs, rigueur et autonomie.

  

Process de recrutement

 

  • Premier entretien avec Florent Mirigay - Senior Business Recruiter (45 min)

  • Deuxième entretien avec Alexandra Ser, Team lead de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (45min)

  • Etude de cas (préparée en amont) avec Alexandra et une personne de l’équipe CSM Grands Comptes (1H)

  • Dernier entretien avec Arnaud Bernard (Head of Grands Comptes)

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🇬🇧 La possibilité de perfectionner ton anglais grâce à Busuu

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. title: Customer Success Manager, UK
descriptionHtml:
About 3E:

3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. 

You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges.

Join us and make an impact!

About the Role

At 3E, we're seeking a Customer Success Manager who can transform customer relationships into lasting partnerships and help clients fully leverage our evolving portfolio of solutions.

This role offers the chance to make a meaningful impact by engaging with customers, providing product education, and offering consultative problem-solving. You'll partner closely with two Account Managers, becoming a trusted advisor to their customers as you guide them through complex solutions, highlight valuable features, and support them in achieving their business objectives.

You will play a key role in shaping the customer experience, from building their confidence in our products to identifying opportunities for greater adoption, and proactively addressing challenges that could impact retention. Throughout this process, you'll collaborate with teams across Customer Success, Onboarding, Support, and Product to connect customers with the expertise and resources they need.

If you're passionate about helping customers explore new possibilities, building relationships, simplifying complex technology, and taking ownership to maximize the value of their technology, this is your opportunity to make a tangible difference through your work. We want to hear from you!

Location & Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote position supporting customers and internal partners across EMEA.The role requires 10–20% travel.

 

What You'll Do

  • Build relationships that last. Develop trusted partnerships with customer stakeholders, understand their business priorities, and help them realize ongoing value from 3E solutions.

  • Turn product knowledge into customer success. Guide customers through product capabilities, deliver training, and help them confidently adopt new features and workflows that support their goals.

  • Drive meaningful engagement and adoption. Create and execute customer success plans, lead proactive outreach, and identify opportunities to increase product usage and engagement.

  • Partner to support retention and growth. Collaborate closely with two Account Managers to strengthen customer relationships, identify opportunities to expand value, and contribute to renewal success.

  • Get ahead of customer challenges. Monitor engagement, product usage, and customer feedback to recognize potential risks early, set clear expectations, and coordinate solutions before issues escalate.

  • Connect customers with the right expertise. Work across Customer Success, Onboarding, Support, and Product to address customer needs, coordinate resources, and ensure timely follow-through.

  • Be a voice for the customer. Share insights, feedback, and emerging needs with internal teams to help improve products, processes, and the overall customer experience.

  • Grow your expertise across our solutions. Build knowledge of 3E's product portfolio, including Protect and Insight, and help customers discover capabilities that make their work easier and more effective.

What Makes You a Great Fit

You're someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers succeed. You know how to build trust, communicate clearly, and translate product capabilities into practical value. You're comfortable taking initiative, collaborating across teams, and navigating situations where the answer isn't always straightforward.

What you'll bring:

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, client services, software training, or a related customer-facing role in a SaaS, technology, information services, or a similar environment.

  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage confidently and empathetically with different customer stakeholders.

  • Experience helping customers learn software, adopt new capabilities, and achieve meaningful outcomes.

  • Clear communication and presentation skills, including the ability to explain complex information in an approachable, practical way.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate customer meetings, manage competing priorities, and follow through on commitments.

  • Confidence navigating challenging conversations, setting realistic expectations, and collaborating constructively with internal partners.

  • Curiosity and adaptability, with an interest in learning multiple products and finding solutions in an evolving environment.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 applications, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint, and the ability to learn new systems and tools.

  • Ability to travel 10-20% of the time to customer locations or 3E events as needed.

Even better if you bring:

  • Experience supporting customer renewals, retention, or expansion in a recurring-revenue business.

  • Fluent in French or German.

  • Familiarity with customer success measures such as net revenue retention (NRR), product adoption, and customer engagement.

  • Experience with Salesforce, Gong, or similar CRM and customer engagement platforms.

  • Exposure to environmental, regulatory, compliance, chemical, or other complex B2B software solutions.

  • Experience supporting mid-market or enterprise customers across different locations.

  • Familiarity with AI-enabled tools and an interest in exploring how emerging technology can improve customer experiences and workflows.

title: Data Platform Engineer – Data Operations (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Data Operations team owns the entire data lifecycle behind STARK's AI stack: collection, acquisition, generation, curation, and management. We run our own data-collection campaigns across Europe, evaluate new sensors and platforms, and build the internal data platform that turns raw recordings into ready-to-use datasets. Everything we produce feeds directly into the perception and autonomy systems deployed on STARK's platforms — a real data advantage is built, not bought. The team is scaling up right now: real scope, direct impact, no legacy.

YOUR MISSION

Data is the fuel of STARK’s AI stack - you build the engine that makes it usable. You own the software backbone of our data platform: the metadata systems, ETL pipelines, data contracts, catalogs, databases, and internal tools that let engineers find, understand, validate, and reuse terabytes of multi-sensor field data in minutes, not days. You treat data context as a product: structured, searchable, version-aware, documented, and traceable from raw recording to processed asset, annotation delivery, dataset, and downstream ML workflow. Success in this role requires seamless cross-functional collaboration—acting as the central hub between the teams collecting data in the field, our external annotation vendors, and the ML engineers training the models. Your job is to design the automated workflows and data tooling that unify these groups, transforming raw operational data into reliable, high-quality systems at scale.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Build the Data Backbone: Design, write, and maintain robust Python software and ETL pipelines that ingest, process, and merge complex field recordings (flight data, rosbags, video) and external deliveries into our GCP cloud storage.
  • Create Data Tooling: Build the programmatic tools that bridge raw data and downstream usage. This includes writing services to automatically sub-sample video feeds, extract valuable frames, package datasets, and build self-serve data access tools.
  • Database & Metadata Engineering: Design, implement, and maintain our metadata databases and data catalogs (tracking datasets, recordings, sensors, labels, and lineage) using solid SQL and schema design principles.
  • Data Operations & Labeling Workflows: Own the end-to-end technical workflows for data curation and labeling. You will build the operational tooling and coordinate with external labeling subcontractors to ensure high-quality data deliveries, track progress, and run automated QA.
  • Internal Tooling & APIs: Develop backend APIs, self-service dashboards, and data-access tools that allow the entire AI and engineering organization to quickly search, filter, and understand terabytes of multi-sensor data.
  • Drive Engineering Excellence: Establish and enforce good software engineering hygiene in a young codebase: rigorous testing, typing, documentation, logging, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Generalist Problem Solving: Thrive in an evolving startup environment. Take on ambiguous problems, migrate legacy data, handle access management, and aggressively automate away manual support tasks.

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Strong Software Engineering in Python: You write clean, typed, tested, and maintainable Python code. You approach data problems with a software developer's mindset.
  • Data Engineering & ETL: Proven experience designing, building, and operating robust ETL/data ingestion pipelines.
  • Database Mastery: Solid SQL (PostgreSQL preferred) with a strong grasp of schema design, data modeling, and metadata systems.
  • Cloud & Infrastructure: Hands-on experience with object storage (GCP/GCS, S3) and the basics of containerization (Docker) and CI/CD.
  • Unix/Linux Environments: Strong familiarity with Unix-based systems, shell scripting, and standard Unix tools. You are comfortable working natively in a Linux environment.

title: Data Steward - People Platforms
descriptionHtml:
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. 

We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. 

We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.

Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow. 

For more information, visit WPP.com.

Why we're hiring:

As a Data Steward in the WPP’s Enterprise Technology Data team, you will be responsible for the hands-on administration and maintenance of master data across one or more enterprise data domains. Reporting to the Global Programme Director - Data, you will be the first line of stewardship, ensuring that golden records are accurate, source system mappings are maintained, and data governance standards are consistently applied.

You will execute matching and mapping activities, triage stewardship exceptions, and support the onboarding of new source systems into the MDM framework. Your work will directly impact the trustworthiness and completeness of master data flowing through WPP’s enterprise platforms.

This role involves daily data administration including investigating and resolving match conflicts, maintaining entity mappings and hierarchies, classifying data assets, and supporting the operational processes that keep master data healthy across the enterprise.

You will be part of a Data Steward team led by the Global Programme Director - Data, with the opportunity to develop deep expertise in master data management, data governance, and stewardship at enterprise scale.

What you'll be doing:

Master data stewardship and golden record maintenance

  • Execute day-to-day stewardship activities including reviewing, approving, and correcting master data records in line with governance standards set by the Global Programme Director - Data.
  • Maintain and curate golden records, ensuring survivorship rules are correctly applied and master entities remain accurate and complete.
  • Investigate and resolve match conflicts, potential duplicates, and merge exceptions, escalating complex cases to the Global Programme Director - Data with supporting analysis.
  • Process new entity creation requests, validating source data against matching rules before golden record creation.

Source system mapping and onboarding support

  • Manage and maintain mappings between source system entities and golden master records, ensuring traceability and accuracy.
  • Support the onboarding of new agencies and source systems by executing mapping activities and validating initial data loads against MDM standards.
  • Maintain reference data configurations, ensuring code sets and lookup values remain aligned across source systems.

Data governance and classification

  • Apply data classification standards to master data entities as defined by the governance framework, covering sensitivity, confidentiality, and regulatory categorisation.
  • Review and correct AI-generated data classifications, providing feedback to improve automated tagging accuracy over time.
  • Follow and enforce stewardship workflows including exception handling, approval processes, and escalation procedures.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of entity mappings, transformation rules, hierarchy structures, and stewardship decisions.

AI-assisted stewardship operations

  • Act as the human-in-the-loop for AI-assisted matching and entity resolution, reviewing model-suggested matches, adjudicating low-confidence merge candidates, and approving or rejecting proposed golden record updates.
  • Review and validate AI-generated mapping recommendations during source system onboarding, ensuring accuracy before mappings are committed.
  • Provide feedback on AI model outputs to support continuous improvement of match accuracy, classification quality, and enrichment relevance.
  • Work with AI-driven anomaly detection alerts, investigating flagged records and determining appropriate stewardship actions.

Data quality monitoring and remediation

  • Monitor data quality dashboards and alerts, investigating exceptions and applying remediation actions in a timely manner.
  • Execute data quality checks across master data entities, documenting findings and tracking resolution through to completion.
  • Maintain and update data quality rules as business requirements and source systems evolve, under the direction of the Data Manager.

Operational reporting and team support

  • Provide first-line support for master data issues raised by downstream consumers and business users.
  • Contribute to operational reporting on stewardship volumes, exception trends, match rates, and resolution times.

Support data migration and reconciliation activities during source system onboarding and platform changes.

What you'll need:

  • Experience in a data stewardship, data administration, or master data management role.
  • Practical understanding of MDM concepts including golden records, matching, survivorship, and entity resolution.
  • Familiarity with enterprise master data management and data governance solutions (e.g. Informatica MDM, Informatica Data Governance) or equivalent platforms is desirable.
  • Proficiency in SQL for data investigation, validation, and reporting.
  • Understanding of data governance principles including data classification, ownership, and stewardship workflows.
  • Willingness to work with AI and machine learning tools as part of day-to-day stewardship operations, including reviewing AI-suggested matches, classifications, and enrichments.
  • Experience working with ERP or HCM data (Workday, SAP, Dynamics, or similar) is an advantage.
  • Attention to detail with the ability to identify and resolve data discrepancies methodically.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent stewardship tasks and priorities.
  • Good communication skills with the ability to document and explain findings clearly to both technical and business audiences.
  • Self-motivated with a proactive approach to identifying and resolving data problems.
  • Enthusiasm for developing expertise in master data management, data governance, and AI-assisted data operations.

Who you are:

You're open: We are inclusive and collaborative; we encourage the free exchange of ideas; we respect and celebrate diverse views. We are open-minded: to new ideas, new partnerships, new ways of working.

You're optimistic: We believe in the power of creativity, technology and talent to create brighter futures or our people, our clients and our communities. We approach all that we do with conviction: to try the new and to seek the unexpected.

You're extraordinary: we are stronger together: through collaboration we achieve the amazing. We are creative leaders and pioneers of our industry; we provide extraordinary every day.

What we'll give you:

Passionate, inspired people – We aim to create a culture in which people can do extraordinary work.

Scale and opportunity – We offer the opportunity to create, influence and complete projects at a scale that is unparalleled in the industry.

Challenging and stimulating work – Unique work and the opportunity to join a group of creative problem solvers. Are you up for the challenge?

#LI-Hybrid 

We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.

WPP is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to particular characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.

Please read our Privacy Notice (https://www.wpp.com/en/careers/wpp-privacy-policy-for-recruitment) for more information on how we process the information you provide.

title: Data Trainee Gegevensmanagment
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij analytisch, werk je graag met data en vind je het interessant om informatie om te zetten in bruikbare inzichten? Krijg je energie van het verbeteren van datakwaliteit en het structureren van gegevens? Dan is deze functie iets voor jou! Als Data Trainee Gegevensmanagement werk je aan uiteenlopende datavraagstukken binnen een organisatie in de publieke sector. Je helpt data toegankelijk, betrouwbaar en bruikbaar te maken en draagt zo bij aan betere informatievoorziening en bedrijfsprocessen.

Wat ga je doen als Data Trainee Gegevensmanagement?

Als Data Trainee Gegevensmanagement ondersteun je een team dat verantwoordelijk is voor het beheer en de ontwikkeling van data- en informatieproducten. Je houdt je voornamelijk bezig met geografische data, maar werkt ook met Business Intelligence (BI) en gestructureerde datasets. Je analyseert gegevens, bewaakt de kwaliteit en denkt mee over hoe data slimmer kan worden ingezet. Daarbij werk je samen met verschillende collega's en adviseer je over oplossingen die aansluiten bij de informatiebehoefte van de organisatie.

Je hoeft niet op ieder onderdeel een expert te zijn. Het is vooral belangrijk dat je een brede interesse in datamanagement hebt, analytisch kunt denken en het leuk vindt om verschillende soorten datavraagstukken op te pakken. Je krijgt de ruimte om je kennis in de praktijk in te zetten en verder te ontwikkelen.

Via The Trainee Company combineer je werken, leren en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Binnen het traineeship Data & Analytics ontwikkel je jezelf in twee jaar tijd tot een echte Data-professional. Je doet direct praktijkervaring op, volgt trainingen en behaalt relevante certificaten die je de rest van je carrière kunt gebruiken. Denk hierbij aan PowerBI, Python, SQL en Azure.

In het eerste jaar van het traineeship leg je een sterke basis in data, systemen, processen en communicatie. Daarnaast krijg je persoonlijke begeleiding van jouw people manager en blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen tijdens je opdracht. Zo leer je niet alleen in de praktijk, maar werk je ook gericht aan je technische én persoonlijke ontwikkeling.


· Je hebt hbo-werk- en denkniveau en een relevante opleiding afgerond, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van Geo, Datamanagement, Business Intelligence, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting.

· Je hebt affiniteit met ETL-tooling en Business Intelligence, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft Azure en Power BI;

· Je vindt het interessant om data te analyseren, te structureren en inzichtelijk te maken;

· Je bent analytisch, nauwkeurig en denkt graag mee over verbeteringen;

· Je kunt goed samenwerken en communiceert helder met verschillende betrokkenen;

· Ervaring met datamanagement, bij voorkeur binnen een overheidsorganisatie, is een pré.

title: Delivery Lead
descriptionHtml:
About hyperexponential (hx)

At hyperexponential, we’re building the AI-powered platform that enables the world’s most critical decisions in a $7 trillion industry - which risks to take, and how to price them. These are the decisions that shape real-world outcomes: whether rockets successfully launch into space, autonomous vehicles make it to market, or communities recover after major storms.

Until now, insurers have been making billion-dollar decisions using outdated tools. We’re changing that. Our platform brings together data, AI, and human expertise to give insurers the fastest path from submission to decision - helping them move faster, act smarter, and take on more risk with confidence.

Backed by a16z, Highland Europe, and Battery Ventures, we’re scaling globally - already trusted by nearly 50 of the world’s largest insurers, with close to zero churn and billions in premiums flowing through hx.

What began as a single product in one market has rapidly evolved into a multi-product, multi-territory platform powering every stage of pricing and underwriting. AI is at the core of what we do - from building the world’s first domain-specific AI peer programmer for insurance (think GitHub Copilot with a PhD in actuarial science) to shaping agentic workflows that reinvent how this industry operates.

What makes hx different is the people who build it. Here, impact isn’t tied to title or tenure; it’s defined by the challenges you take on and the discipline you bring. Surrounded by peers who stretch you, you’ll do the best, hardest work of your life in a company engineered to endure.

If that sounds like you, join us in building what comes next.

About the Project Management team

The Project Management team takes hx customers from signed contract to live in production. We work in cross-functional pods alongside delivery engineers and solution architects, and we own the customer relationship day to day: the plan, the budget, the risks and the conversations that go with them. We work with some of the most sophisticated insurers in the world, including Lloyd’s syndicates, Tier 1 carriers, reinsurers and MGAs. We are moving to a shared, AI-first way of working, where one set of skills is used and improved by the whole team, and we are looking for people who want to help build it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead delivery across the projects in our Strategic pod, holding commercials to plan and surfacing risks early.

  • Lead and develop the people who report to you, so they progress.

  • Spot where a project can grow, and bring cross-sell and upsell opportunities to the account team.

  • Lead internal projects that change how the pod delivers, and feed them into our shared delivery framework.

  • Shape how AI is used in our delivery workflows, beyond your own work.

  • Work alongside the pod’s technical lead, so technical delivery can focus on technical problems.

What you’ll need to have done

  • Run several projects at once with commercial accountability.

  • Led people, through line management or equivalent, and be able to point to someone who progressed.

  • Changed how a team works and be able to show it was adopted.

  • Built or shaped AI-enabled workflows, and be able to explain what you learned.

You’re unlikely to thrive here if

  • You prefer to direct work from a distance, rather than stay close enough to the detail to make sound commercial and delivery calls.

  • You’re more comfortable following an established playbook than building one as the team and the product evolve.

  • You see leadership as managing tasks rather than developing people and holding them to a high standard.

If reading our Culture Document leaves you feeling neutral rather than energised, hx may not be the place where you’ll do your best work. We’re building something that asks for commitment and conviction, and we want you to feel excited by the opportunity to grow with us.

Compensation

At hx, we’re committed to salary transparency. You’ll always have clarity on pay early in the process - our Talent Partner will share details with you during initial conversations - and we’re working towards publishing salary information for all roles globally.

Because we’re building at the intersection of technology/SaaS and insurance, our roles don’t always map neatly onto traditional benchmarks. Our approach is to design compensation that’s competitive in the market, fair across teams, and aligned with the impact our people make.

Benefits

  • £5,000 training and conference budget for individual and group development.

  • 25 days of holiday plus 8 bank holidays (33 days total).

  • Company pension scheme via Penfold.

  • Mental health support and therapy via Spectrum.life.

  • Individual wellbeing allowance via Juno.

  • Private healthcare insurance through AXA.

  • Income protection and Life Insurance.

  • Cycle to Work Scheme

Additional perks

  • Top-spec equipment (laptop, screens, adjustable desks, etc.).

  • Regular remote and in-person hackathons, lunch and learns, socials, and game nights.

  • Team breakfasts and lunches, snacks, drinks fridge, and a fun office at The Ministry.

  • Exceptional opportunities for personal development and growth as we build something remarkable together.

Interview process

  • Initial call with our Talent team - 30 minutes

  • Manager Interview - 60 minutes

  • Skills presentation - 60 minutes

  • Values Interview - 60 minutes

  • Meet the CEO - 30 minutes

Our commitment to Diversity

hxer’s are at the centre of everything we build. We know that progress depends on diverse perspectives, and we are committed to creating an environment where everyone can thrive, grow, and make an impact. We recognise there is always more to do, and we take responsibility for shaping a workplace that is not only diverse but genuinely inclusive.

Diversity is not just the right thing to do, it is key to solving the complex challenges we choose to take on. By welcoming people from all backgrounds and experiences, we strengthen our ability to question assumptions, push boundaries, and design solutions that endure. If you’re energised by complexity and motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply and join our global team.

Next steps

If this opportunity resonates with you, we encourage you to apply or share it with your connections! Our dedicated talent team reviews all applications, and we promise to provide feedback regardless of the outcome.

For more information about applying and to view other opportunities, you can visit our careers page.

Please note that background checks will be conducted as part of the hiring process to ensure compliance with our governance policies. We handle all background checks sensitively and in full compliance with relevant regulations. All applicant data will be processed in accordance with data protection regulations and our privacy policy.

As Director Business Development at SkyNRG, you will lead the team responsible for growing our SAFc business with large corporate customers. You will set the sales strategy, develop key customer relationships, and build the commercial capabilities needed to support the next stage of growth.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

The Communications Tribe

The Communications Tribe is part of HelloFresh's Growth Alliance. Our mission is to enable a highly personalised, automated CRM communication ecosystem that prioritises user-centric engagement across our owned channels: email, push, SMS, in-app and embedded.

  • How we move to an autonomous, self-optimising system that continuously learns from every past interaction and gets better with each send.
  • How we make sure we can reach our customers in their preferred channels.

Our vision is to decentralise how HelloFresh talks to people across the whole relationship with us: prospects, subscribers and those who have left. Setting up and steering communications stops being the job of a small group of specialists and becomes something teams across the business can do safely, on top of tools and an intelligence layer that we build and that learn from every send. descriptionHtml:

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As a Drone System Validation Technician and Pilot, you will be at the front line of our quality, safety, and reliability efforts. Your primary mission is to ensure that our defense-grade products meet rigorous operational standards before they are cleared for active duty.

Working within a dedicated flight testing team, you will manage, prepare, and operate fleets of newly assembled drones or related product during intensive field validation campaigns. By logging massive operating hours, you will actively hunt for rare, hard-to-replicate system bugs and edge-case anomalies. We are looking for operators who combine rigorous testing discipline with the hands-on piloting expertise required to accurately assess and validate nominal drone behavior in flight. Your technical feedback will directly enable our engineering teams to secure and polish our next-generation defense systems.

 

Responsibilities

  • Intensive Flight Testing: Conduct high-volume flight testing of newly assembled interceptors to log hours, validate systems, and actively hunt for rare, intermittent flight anomalies.

  • Aviation Performance Assessment: Manually operate, stress-test, and critically evaluate the flight dynamics of various platforms (multirotors, fixed-wing, flying wings, and RC planes) to ensure they handle exactly as designed.

  • Field Deployment: Lead and execute demanding on-site flight missions, sometimes lasting several weeks, under diverse weather and environmental conditions.

  • Mission Safety & Logs: Rigorously follow test checklists, maintain safety protocols during high-throughput flight operations, and accurately report flight observations to the engineering, production and industrialisation teams.

Candidate Requirements

  • Good RC/UAV Piloting Skills: You have extensive hands-on experience piloting RC planes, flying wings, or multirotor UAVs. Manual piloting dexterity and a deep instinct for flight mechanics are the absolute priorities for this role.

  • Rigor & Endurance: Strong discipline to run repetitive, structured test cycles with consistent attention to detail and unwavering focus on safety.

  • Adaptable Mindset: You thrive in fast-paced, lean startup environments where initiative, quick decision-making, and teamwork are valued over rigid hierarchy.

  • Field-Ready & Mobile: You possess a valid driver’s license (Permis B) and are ready to drive team vehicles, transport flight gear/drones. You are looking for a highly active, hands-on role where you will be out in the field on a daily basis, all year round.

  • Technical background: Any technical degree or professional experience in electronics, RC modeling, mechanics, or aeronautics is a great plus, but passionate self-taught pilots are highly encouraged to apply.

  • Basic Technical English: Capable of understanding technical guidelines and writing flight reports in English.

Nice-to-have

  • Certifications & FPV: Official drone pilot certifications, instructor ratings, or solid FPV (First Person View) racing/freestyle experience.

  • Military or Field Background: Past experience in specialized military units or demanding field-oriented professions.

  • Basic data/technical literacy: a basic grasp of autopilot systems, telemetry or flight-log reading, to help bridge the field and R&D. This is what turns an operator into a genuine validator, and is worth probing even if not required.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

descriptionHtml:

At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. Our Developer Ecosystem organisation shapes how developers and the AI agents working for them build on the Databricks Data and AI Platform, from within the product to the tools they already use.

We are hiring an Engineering Manager to lead our declarative deployment framework, which turns data and AI projects into versioned, reviewable, repeatable software. It is one product with two entry points. Third-party developers use our open-source CLI from their IDEs, terminals, and CI/CD systems. First-party, they author, deploy and inspect the same projects inside the Databricks workspace. In both, AI agents increasingly do the work: coding agents drive the CLI, and our in-product AI assistant authors and deploys projects alongside the developer. Thousands of organisations run their CI/CD on it, and it is one of the fastest-growing parts of the platform.

The team owns the deployment engine and CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and the metadata service and deployment history that record every deployment. The hard problems are real infrastructure-as-code problems: reconciling declared and live state, making plans safe for humans and agents to approve, keeping visual authoring and code in sync, and shipping weekly releases that remain backwards-compatible for our largest customers.

  • Lead and grow the team: Manage a team of senior engineers across three closely connected areas (the deployment engine and open-source CLI, the in-workspace authoring and deployment experience, and deployment history and metadata), working with strong tech leads. Make the trade-offs explicit when the demand is larger than the team.

  • Ensures that appropriate standards (corporate, industry, national and international) are adhered to.
  • Consult with clients to evolve early solutions
  • Develop architecture for solutions in response to procurement requests from clients.
  • Work with Account Management and Sales functions to ensure that key sales messages for the solutions are accurately and authoritatively communicated within bids and pitches, and to develop or qualify new opportunities

Skills & Experience:

  • Strong experience as an ERP Solution Architect, Enterprise Architect or Solution Design Lead.
  • Proven expertise with Infor LN (formerly Baan) or a comparable enterprise ERP platform.
  • Experience designing solutions across manufacturing, warehousing, supply chain, finance and operational business functions.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration architecture, middleware technologies and API-led design principles.
  • Experience with integration platforms such as Infor ION or equivalent enterprise integration technologies.
  • Strong SQL and data integration experience, including working with complex enterprise data environments.
  • Knowledge of enterprise asset management, business process management and operational technology ecosystems.
  • Experience integrating ERP solutions with platforms such as Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) tools or similar enterprise applications.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working within large, complex and highly regulated organisations.

Desirable Skills:

  • Experience supporting enterprise-wide ERP transformation or modernisation programmes.
  • Knowledge of cloud-based ERP, integration and enterprise architecture frameworks.
  • Experience with enterprise asset management and business process management platforms.
  • Understanding of AI, automation and emerging technologies within enterprise environments.
  • Experience defining technology roadmaps and driving continuous improvement initiatives.

The successful candidate will provide architectural leadership across a complex ERP ecosystem, ensuring enterprise platforms, business processes and integrations operate effectively across multiple functions. They will deliver robust, scalable and supportable solutions that align technology with business objectives while maintaining architectural integrity and governance standards. Success will be measured through improved system integration, streamlined business processes, successful delivery of transformation initiatives and the ability to balance immediate business needs with long-term strategic goals.

About Peregrine

We build workforces that deliver tech and change programmes at leading UK organisations. By combining data science from Peregrine Intelligence, our industry-accredited Peregrine Academy, and market-leading attraction and diversity initiatives, we bridge capability gaps at all levels in public and private sector organisations. We work closely with our clients to understand their challenges and deliver flexible, long-term solutions that make a real difference. When you join Peregrine, you become part of a team that’s focused on growth, both yours, our clients’, and the sectors we support. You’ll also get access to a full range of benefits alongside your salary.

How Specialist Talent Works

As a permanent employee at Peregrine, you’ll be part of our Specialist Talent team. That means you’ll work on-site or remotely with our clients, supporting them on complex, high-impact projects in Data, Digital and Business Transformation. You’ll get the variety and challenge of consultancy work, with the stability and support of a permanent role. You’re not a contractor - you’re a valued member of our team, with access to all the same benefits, learning opportunities, and community.

Our Culture

We’re curious, open, and always learning. We believe in doing great work and doing it with integrity. We support each other, share ideas freely, and celebrate progress big and small. And we care about the impact we make, whether that’s helping clients solve tough problems or creating opportunities for people from all walks of life.

Diversity and Inclusion

We’re proud to be a diverse team, with 20+ nationalities represented across Peregrine. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences, and we’re committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. Through our partnerships and internal initiatives, we’re working to improve social mobility, reduce our environmental impact, and help our clients build more inclusive teams too.

title: Expert Support Technique et Comptable (Télétravail complet possible - Charente / Charente-Maritime / Deux-Sèvres)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

En 6 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 400 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 million de TPE/PME et plus de 7 000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !

Tu as une solide expérience en comptabilité et tu aimes comprendre comment fonctionnent les outils SaaS ?
Tu souhaites intervenir sur des problématiques complexes, à la frontière entre métier, produit et technologie ?
Rejoins Pennylane en tant qu’Expert·e Support Technique et Comptable.

Ton rôle
Tu prends en charge les sujets les plus complexes remontés par nos utilisateurs et nos équipes Support.
Ton objectif : comprendre l’origine des problèmes, qu’ils soient comptables, fonctionnels ou techniques, puis coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes Produit et Tech.
Tu joueras un rôle clé entre les utilisateurs, le Support, les développeurs et les équipes Produit.

Tes missions

  • Investiguer des bugs, anomalies et problématiques comptables ou fonctionnelles.

  • Qualifier les incidents et coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes concernées.

  • Échanger avec les développeurs et le Produit pour transmettre des analyses claires et exploitables.

  • Utiliser les outils d’investigation disponibles : logs et SQL simple.

  • Documenter les solutions et contribuer à l’amélioration continue du produit et des process.

  • Partager ton expertise avec les équipes Support.


Le profil recherché

Tu peux venir de différents environnements : cabinet d’expertise comptable ou éditeur de logiciel comptable.

Nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • dispose d’une solide expérience en comptabilité et comprend les problématiques des cabinets et entreprises ;

  • a déjà travaillé sur des sujets complexes nécessitant analyse et coordination ;

  • est à l’aise avec les outils et problématiques techniques ;

  • sait communiquer clairement avec des interlocuteurs métiers et techniques ;

  • parle anglais dans un contexte professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral ;

  • fait preuve de rigueur, d’autonomie et de curiosité.

La connaissance de SQL est un plus, mais n’est pas indispensable. Ce qui compte surtout, c’est ton envie de comprendre les systèmes et de monter en compétence sur les sujets techniques.

Pourquoi rejoindre Pennylane ?

Tu rejoindras une équipe au cœur de la qualité produit, en lien direct avec les utilisateurs, les développeurs et les équipes Produit. Tu travailleras dans un environnement international, en forte croissance, où ton expertise comptable aura un impact concret

Process de recrutement :

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

  • Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

  • Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

  • Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou @pennylane-partners.com .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. title: Field Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋

Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place!

Lightspeed is looking for Field Sales Account Executives in Lyon. Working closely with our Field Sales Manager, you’ll play a key role in building a high-performing and ambitious team.
You’ll be at the heart of our local sales strategy out in the field across Lyon and its surroundings, driving the entire sales cycle from prospecting and demos all the way to closing deals.

Lightspeed’s Hospitality team is now in hyper-growth mode. Our process has been refined and optimised at a smaller scale in the last few years, now is the time to expand our team and our reach. 

*** Please note this role is based in Lyon, France. ***

What you’ll be doing:

  • Converting prospects into successful customers through customer sales methods such as door-to-door, cold calling and presentations - all in person

  • Carrying out the whole sales cycle which includes identifying and developing leads, meeting with your clients, creating value propositions, structuring financial deals, negotiating contracts, and closing deals

  • Visiting customers on a regular basis to identify their business challenges & pain points

  • Successfully running in person demonstrations of the product

  • Analyzing, reporting and taking action on pipeline metrics

  • Driving performance to consistently meet monthly, quarterly and annual goals

  • Create new business through network events 

What you’ll be bringing:

  • Relevant sales experience in a Field and outbound environment, preferably in a solution-sales / technology-related

  • Strong understanding of sales development best practices

  • Ability to manage time effectively and efficiently

  • Excellent customer service and telephone skills, including strong listening, verbal and written communication

  • Demonstrated ability to meet and/or exceed sales targets

  • A love of numbers: you recognize a quantitative approach to making decisions

  • Ability to thrive in a competitive, dynamic and quota-driven environment

  • Fluency in French and English

  • An entrepreneurial and agile mindset, a bias toward action and an ability to pivot when needed to meet business needs and objectives

Nice to have: 

  • Experience in hospitality 

We know that people are more than what’s on their CV. If you’re unsure that you have the right profile for the role... hit the ‘Apply’ button and give it a try!

What’s in it for you?

Come live the Lightspeed experience...

  • Genuine career opportunities in a company that’s creating new jobs every day;

  • Work in a team large enough for growth but lean enough to make a real impact;

  • Exposure to modern and proven technology;

  • Ability to work and grow in a truly flexible environment;

  • Opportunity to learn, expand your skill set, forge wonderful relationships and make your mark within the diverse and inclusive Lightspeed culture, a true Canadian tech success story

… and enjoy a range of benefits that’ll keep you happy, healthy and (not) hungry:

  • Lightspeed equity scheme (we are all owners)

  • Health & Wellness Credit- expense up to 400 EUR per year towards your gym membership, yoga classes, a new bike or whatever else you do for your health 

  • Mental Health Support through the Modern Health App- whether it is meditation, coaching or counseling you need - each employee gets access to this platform 

  • People Experience - Our PX benefit allows you to work from pretty much anywhere in the world for 60 days a year 

  • Time off to volunteer and give back to your community

  • Health insurance with attractive guarantee plans

To all recruitment agencies: Lightspeed does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. If we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy, Lightspeed will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Lightspeed is a proud equal opportunity employer and we are committed to creating an inclusive and barrier-free workplace. Lightspeed welcomes and encourages applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Where to from here?

Obviously, this has to be mutually beneficial: we want you to step into a role you love, and we want to offer you a place you’re proud to come to every day. For a glimpse into our world check out our career page here.

Lightspeed is building communities through commerce, and we need people from all backgrounds and lived experiences to do that. We were founded in 2005, in Montreal’s gay village and our original members were all part of the LGBTQ+ community. The ethos of our business has been about inclusion from the very beginning, and we strive to provide a workplace where everyone belongs.

Who we are:

Powering the businesses that are the backbone of the global economy, Lightspeed's one-stop commerce platform helps merchants innovate to simplify, scale, and provide exceptional customer experiences. Our cloud commerce solution transforms and unifies online and physical operations, multichannel sales, expansion to new locations, global payments, financial solutions, and connection to supplier networks.

Founded in Montréal, Canada in 2005, Lightspeed is dual-listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: LSPD) and Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX: LSPD). With teams across North America, Europe, and Asia Pacific, the company serves retail, hospitality, and golf businesses in over 100 countries.

Lightspeed handles your information in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Statement.

Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager, based in London, to build and run Ema’s on-the-ground presence across the UK and Europe. You’ll cover industry events, tradeshows, executive dinners and sponsored programs in our priority markets: the UK, France, DACH and Benelux, with the Nordics and wider Europe as they grow. You’ll be the connective tissue between our BDR, Sales, AI Strategy, Product Marketing and Design teams, turning live experiences into qualified pipeline.

You’ll be Ema’s first field marketer in the region, working alongside our US Field Marketing Manager. Our Marketing Lead sets the global event strategy and budget. Within that, you own the UK and Europe calendar: which events we back, which cities we show up in, and how we run them. Then you execute it.

We need someone who thrives in startup environments, moves fast, and doesn’t wait for permission to solve problems. If you’ve built field programs across more than one European market, know how to get scrappy when budgets are tight, and can run a booth in London one week and an executive dinner in Paris the next, we want to talk to you.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Event Planning

  • Build and maintain the UK and Europe event calendar within the global strategy and budget set by our Marketing Lead.

  • Recommend which conferences, tradeshows and sponsorships to back in each market, based on target accounts, pipeline and cost. Know the difference between an event that matters in London and one that matters in Munich or Amsterdam.

  • Work with the US Field Marketing Manager to share what works, reuse playbooks and assets, and keep the two programs consistent.

Event Execution & Operations

  • Plan, manage and execute end-to-end logistics for industry conferences, tradeshows and Ema-hosted events (executive roundtables, dinners, meetups) across the UK and Europe.

  • Manage all on-site operations: booth design, staffing, signage, swag, shipping, A/V, catering and speaker logistics. You’re the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Handle the cross-border details that US events don’t have: shipping and customs between the UK and the EU, local venues and suppliers, and GDPR-compliant lead capture.

  • Evaluate sponsorship opportunities, negotiate vendor contracts and manage event budgets to maximise ROI.

Pipeline & Sales Alignment

  • Work with the BDR team and Sales to align event programming with target accounts and pipeline goals in each market.

  • Coordinate pre-event outreach, booth and event activations, and post-event follow-up to drive lead conversion.

  • Make sure every event lead reaches Sales quickly and cleanly. No leads die on the vine.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate with AI Strategists, Product Marketing and Design so demos, collateral and messaging are event-ready, on-brand and right for the local audience.

  • Support broader demand-generation campaigns as needed, including regional activations and partner co-marketing events.

  • Work across time zones with US-based marketing and leadership, with some early-evening calls.

Measurement & Optimisation

  • Track and report on event performance by market (leads generated, pipeline influenced, cost per lead, attendance, deal acceleration) and share insights to improve the program.

  • Obsess over what’s working vs. what’s noise, and use data to make the case for where we invest next.

What You Bring

  • 5–7+ years of field marketing, event marketing or demand-gen experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology, with a track record of running events in the UK and at least one other European market. Startup experience is required. You’ve built programs, not just inherited them.

  • A working knowledge of the European event circuit and what each market expects, from London tech weeks to Paris and DACH industry shows.

  • Exceptional project management skills. You can juggle 5+ events in different countries and stages at once without dropping a ball. You live in spreadsheets, timelines and run-of-show docs.

  • A roll-up-your-sleeves operator. You’re the person zip-tying cables to a booth at 6 AM, getting a pallet of swag through customs, and sending the recap email before the Eurostar pulls in.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You partner naturally with Sales, BDRs, Product Marketing and executives, including colleagues eight hours behind you, without needing to be managed into it.

  • Experience with HubSpot and marketing automation platforms to track attribution and ROI, and a practical grasp of GDPR as it applies to event data.

  • Proficiency with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.) to speed up day-to-day work, from drafting event briefs to analysing post-event data. We’re an AI company and we expect you to work like one.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and fast-moving environments. Priorities shift, budgets change, events get added last minute, and you handle it. This is a fast growing Series B company. If you need a playbook handed to you, this isn’t the role.

  • High agency and an ownership mindset. As our first field marketer in Europe, you’ll see gaps and fill them without waiting to be asked.

Location & Travel

  • Based in/near London, working hybrid from our London office.

  • Travel up to 40% across the UK and Europe, with occasional trips to the US.

title: Finance Systems Intern
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Finance Systems Intern, you will help run and improve the quote-to-cash systems behind Parloa’s enterprise contracts. You will learn how signed agreements (annual commits, usage-based pricing, ramps and one-time fees) become accurate subscriptions and invoices across SAP Subscription Billing, NetSuite and Salesforce. This is a full-time, 6-month internship in Berlin, starting as soon as possible, with a dedicated mentor and real project work from your first weeks.

This is your opportunity to get hands-on with a modern quote-to-cash stack at a fast-growing AI company and take your own automation project from idea to delivery.

Areas of ownership:

  • Billing Operations: Set up and amend customer subscriptions from signed contracts and run pre-billing checks on billing runs and invoices, with team review before anything goes live. Investigate rating, pricing and master-data errors so customers are billed correctly.

  • Systems Configuration and Reporting: Maintain SAP Subscription Billing master data such as products, rate plans, pricing elements, and billing profiles, configuring and testing changes before they reach production. Build NetSuite saved searches, reports, and data imports, and support month-end close and reconciliations.

  • Cross-System Data Integrity: Keep products, billable metrics, and customer data consistent across Salesforce, SAP, and NetSuite. Build reports that flag mismatches before they turn into billing issues.

  • Issue Triage and Controls: Reproduce and document billing and finance-systems issues as clear, reproducible tickets for the team or our partners. Write and execute test cases for new features, and keep change logs and audit evidence current.

  • Process Automation: Write SOPs, process maps, and user guides for finance colleagues, then spot manual steps and automate them with scripts, integrations or AI tools. One of these becomes your own internship project, which you present at the end of your internship.

Who you are:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in Information Systems, Business Informatics, Industrial Engineering, Accounting, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field for the full duration of the internship, and available full-time for 6 months

  • First exposure to an ERP, billing or CRM system (such as SAP, NetSuite, Salesforce, Zuora or Stripe Billing) through coursework, a university project, a previous internship or a working-student role

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and the willingness to learn to read a JSON payload or an API error message; SQL or scripting experience (Python, Google Apps Script, n8n or Zapier) is a plus

  • A systems mindset and real interest in how a contract becomes an invoice and a journal entry: when something breaks, you keep tracing it until you find the root cause

  • Precise in how you work and handle financial data, with fluent written and spoken English and the confidence to ask questions and speak up with facts

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

 

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.
