This is a blended role, covering development and maintenance up until handling client requests. This role works closely with the Solutions, DevOps and Engineering teams.

DESCRIPTION

As part of the Development and maintenance responsibility, the resource handles:

• Develop, test and maintain connector components in C# on .NET (AWS Lambda), including the parsers and mappers that convert source-system data (API payloads, files) into the formats required by the Trial Interactive CTMS and eTMF.

• Configure and extend mappings for new studies, sites and visit/status definitions on existing connectors, reusing existing modules wherever possible.

• Assist in the technical onboarding of new clients and studies: connector configuration, test runs in non-production environments, and verification before go-live.

• Work with the AWS services connectors are built on (Lambda, SQS, S3, EventBridge/Step Functions, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and make small, reviewed infrastructure changes using Terraform under supervision.

• Consume, test and troubleshoot REST APIs (client/vendor APIs and Trial Interactive import APIs) using code and tools such as Postman, and help extend APIs that improve connector stability and connectivity.

• Write unit and functional tests; use Git (feature branches, merge requests, environment branches) and follow the team’s code review and release process.

• Keep code, configuration and change records documented so that others can maintain them.

• Work on special projects, such as local test environments using LocalStack.

As part of handling Client communication, support and ticket resolution, the resource does:

• Own assigned support tickets from triage to closure: reproduce the issue, investigate, fix or escalate, and record the outcome in the ticketing system (for example Jira, ServiceDesk Plus).

• Investigate data issues end to end – trace a record from the source payload through the archive, parser, connector database and logs to its CTMS/eTMF import result – and establish the root cause (RCA) with evidence.

• Reconcile source-system data against the CTMS/eTMF when a client reports missing or mismatched subjects, visits or statuses, and explain any differences.

• Communicate with clients and Solutions Engineers by email, tickets and calls: acknowledge requests promptly, ask clear clarifying questions, give regular status updates, and explain findings and next steps in plain language.

• Monitor connector health (CloudWatch logs, failed imports, notifications) and respond to failures within agreed response times.

• Escalate appropriately to senior engineers, DevOps or the vendor, with a concise summary of what happened, when, in which environment and for which records.

• Write up RCAs, fixes and known issues so that repeat problems are resolved faster, and help keep support documentation current.

• Handle client and clinical data with care: use the minimum data needed, never share one client’s information with another, and follow Trial Interactive data-protection and change-control procedures.

General

• Keep learning the connector platform, the clinical-trial data domain and cloud and software development best practices.

• Complete all other tasks that are deemed appropriate for this role and assigned by the manager/supervisor.


REQUIRED SKILLS

• Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical issues in plain language to non-technical clients and to write concise ticket updates and emails.

• A client-service mindset: responsive, calm under pressure, and takes ownership of a ticket until it is resolved or properly handed over.

• Strong problem-solving and debugging skills: forms a hypothesis, checks logs and data, and proves the root cause with evidence before concluding.

• Strong attention to detail with data, such as identifiers, dates, time zones and character encodings.

• Good time management: balances planned development work with interrupt-driven support, prioritizing by client impact.

• Works collaboratively within a team, asks for help early, and is self-motivated and eager to learn.

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 0–1 years of experience in software development, technical support or cloud-based application support; internships and substantial academic or personal projects count.

• Working knowledge of C# and the .NET framework: able to read and debug existing code and deliver small features.

• Familiarity with AWS, particularly Lambda, S3, SQS and CloudWatch Logs.

• Working SQL skills (joins, filtering, aggregation) on relational databases, preferably MySQL.

• Understanding of REST APIs and of JSON, XML and CSV data; experience calling APIs with Postman or similar tools.

• Understanding of data parsing and mapping techniques, including handling of dates, null values and encodings.

• Experience or familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git).

DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

• Experience with LocalStack for local AWS cloud application development.

• Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.

• Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.

• Prior experience in customer-facing support, or with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceDesk Plus.

• Exposure to clinical research systems and concepts (EDC, CTMS, eTMF; study, site, subject, visit) or to regulated (GxP) software environments.

• Scripting (Python or shell) for data checks and log analysis.

• Familiarity with containerization and microservices architecture.

title: Key Account Manager - Public Sector
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

We are looking for amazing people to help us take care of our growing pipe on Public Sector accounts (Ministries and other public entities).
Being a Key Account Manager at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate experts, with different backgrounds.
We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

As a Key Account Manager, you will:

It is nice to have a previous experience in Insurance or any industry linked to benefits. Having experience with or within the Public Sector space is also a nice to have.

title: Lead AI Product Manager - Telematics
descriptionHtml:
About Zego 🚀

At Zego, we're on a mission to do the good thing, not the insurance thing.

Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has. We're building the real-time, AI-driven infrastructure that powers innovative insurance, so good drivers get cover that works the way they actually drive.

We're not just updating insurance; We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖

For us, AI isn't a line on a roadmap or a buzzword on a slide. It's our operating reality, and it's how we build products that back drivers instead of the old insurance playbook.

We don't do things slowly, and we don't do bureaucracy. We back high-performance builders who want ownership, early responsibility and the chance to do the most career-defining work of their lives. You'll get the space to try things, the tools to move fast, and the room to see your ideas reach millions of drivers.

Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor.

If you're ready to build the future of insurance, we're hiring.

About the Role

We are looking for a Lead AI Product Manager to own Telematics at Zego. Our proprietary telematics is how we understand the way people actually drive, and the ratings it produces shape pricing, risk management and claims across our whole book.

You’ll own the telematics stack as a product: the SDKs that capture driving data, the processing that turns it into trips, events and scores, and the Risk Management capabilities that act on them. You’ll set the 6-12 month direction across these teams and make the build-vs-buy-vs-partner calls on sensors, data sources and models.

You’ll work closely with Data Science, Pricing, Claims and Zego’s Leadership Team, champion an experiment-first culture, and mentor Product Managers across the organisation.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Set the six-to-12-month Telematics strategy across the SDKs, data processing and Risk Management, including the build, buy or partner calls on sensors, data and models.

  • Own data quality at the source, setting the standards for trip recording, location accuracy, battery impact and stability that every score depends on.

  • Own the product side of our scoring models with Data Science, so the score is accurate, explainable and safe to change on a live book.

  • Lead Risk Management, defining how we act on driving behaviour - from price adjustments to interventions and cancellations - balancing loss ratio with fair customer outcomes.

  • Turn driving data into P&L impact with Pricing, Underwriting, Claims and Fraud, through sharper risk selection, fairer prices and better fraud detection.

  • Embed rigorous experimentation as the default operating rhythm, even when changes touch price and live policies.

  • Build reusable AI playbooks, workflows and assets that multiply the whole team’s output, from trip-data analysis to automated data and model monitoring.

  • Coach Product Managers across the organisation, raising the bar for product craft and data capability.

What You’ll Need to Be Successful

  • Strategic product leadership. Significant experience leading product strategy across multiple teams or domains in a high-growth environment, with decisions that moved business-level metrics.

  • Data, sensor or ML products. You’ve built products on behavioural, location or sensor data - ideally telematics, mobility or IoT - and understand how signals become models, and models become decisions.

  • Technical depth. Comfortable engaging engineers on mobile SDKs, data pipelines and ML pipelines, enough to make informed strategic bets.

  • Commercial and risk fluency. Deep understanding of pricing levers, risk modelling and loss ratios, and credible with Actuarial, Finance and Leadership.

  • Data mastery. You are as comfortable in Snowflake as you are in a strategy review, and you can interrogate model performance, not just read a dashboard.

  • Experiment-first operator. You have built experiment cultures, not just run individual tests.

  • You work AI-first. You will use AI daily here, and we mean daily. You do not need to arrive an expert, but you do need to arrive curious, experiment fast, and take ownership of getting good quickly. People who wait to be trained will find this uncomfortable.

The Zego ways of working 🏡

Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our office (central London, Gibraltar or Halifax) weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.

We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does, properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Here is what the last one looked like.

Benefits 🎁

💰 Market-competitive salary, benchmarked against your function and reviewed every year.

🏆 Annual performance bonus, linked to company performance and your contribution.

📈 Share options, a real stake in the company and a share in the future you build

🩺 Private medical insurance.

🏖️ Pension, generous holiday, and £1,000 a year to spend on getting to the office or learning something new.

💻 Cutting-edge systems and tools, so you always have what you need to drive your impact.

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? We want to hear from you.

Zego, leading the AI evolution in insurance.

title: Legal Engineer - Applied AI Knowledge
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

What you'll do

Legal AI is inventing its best practices in real time, and this role sits where that happens. You'll sit within the Legal Engineering team and work hand in hand with Product at one of the fastest-growing legal AI companies in the world, seeing new capabilities before almost anyone else, experimenting with them against real legal work, and turning what you learn into the standards a global function runs on. In a year here, you will see and vet more legal AI use cases than most people in the industry see in a career, working directly with some of the best legal engineers in the industry.

This is a judgement role, not a filing one. You'll be the person who vets the skills, workflows and use cases the function ships: testing them hands-on, separating the genuinely strong from the merely plausible, and quality-controlling practice-area workflows so that what carries the Legora name is consistently excellent. You'll research and experiment with prompting techniques and applied AI methods, author the exemplar use cases the rest of the function copies, and teach what you learn: delivering technical onboarding for new Legal Engineers in your region and broadcasting best practices to the team worldwide. And because judgement needs grounding, around 30% of your time stays on live client work, chosen for what it teaches.

Specifically, you will

• Vet the Skills Library and Legal Engineering outputs against the quality bar: review skills, workflows and use cases hands-on before they go live, and quality-control practice-area workflows for consistency.

• Research and experiment with prompting techniques, skill patterns and emerging AI methods, and turn what works into best practices the whole function adopts.

• Author the reference use cases that show what great looks like, published as the exemplars others copy.

• Work closely with the Product team on up-and-coming capabilities: early hands-on testing, the first best practices for new features, and structured feedback from real use.

• Produce materials that would support the technical onboarding and training for new Legal Engineers in your region, such as best practices to create use cases etc.

• Communicate new best practices, exemplars and platform changes to the Legal Engineering team worldwide.

• Support the flagship demos our CEO and C-suite take on stage at the industry’s biggest events: use case preparation, fixtures and rehearsal support.

• Oversee the quality and currency of the use case and skills libraries, including coordination across regions

• Spend roughly 30% of your time on live client work, selected for what it feeds back into the standards and libraries.

What you bring

You're a lawyer with real practice experience who has become genuinely technical: maybe you did a coding bootcamp, maybe you taught yourself, but either way you're the person colleagues ask how something actually works. You live in AI tools, and it shows: you can tell a strong use case from a plausible-sounding weak one, you know why a prompt underperforms before you've finished reading it, and you hold both halves of the judgement this role needs: what makes a prompt run well, and what makes a legal output substantively right rather than merely fluent. When you vet, you vet properly: line by line against the source, with the discipline to put the AI down when the job calls for your own eyes.

We're looking for

• A qualified lawyer with solid practice experience at a leading firm or in-house team, or equivalent: enough substantive judgement to vet outputs across practice areas.

• Real technical prowess: comfortable with code or scripting (a bootcamp or self-taught background counts entirely), and fluent in the mechanics of how AI tools actually behave.

• A heavy, habitual user of AI, ideally legal AI, with sharp prompt and use case discernment: able to rank a strong prompt against a mediocre one, articulate exactly why, and improve it.

• Visible pride in the craft of prompting and use case design: someone who wants to be the reference point for what good looks like.

• Rigour in review: line-by-line verification against source, and the judgement to know exactly when not to use AI.

• Comfortable running high-throughput workstreams: you triage well, keep many threads moving, and build process where volume demands it.

• Experience building skills, workflows or automations in a legal AI platform is a strong plus.

• Good to have: an M&A or wider transactional background, or deal coordination experience.

Where this role can go

This role is built to grow with the field itself. Applied legal AI knowledge barely exists as a discipline yet, and nobody accumulates evidence faster than the person vetting and testing the entire output of a global function. Do this job well and you are positioned to become one of the industry’s recognised voices on what good looks like. Inside Legora, the role is designed to grow into owning applied AI knowledge globally: the standards, techniques and systems every region operates on. Growth is subject to performance and company need, but the direction is deliberate: master the material here first, then define the standard for the industry.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Manager, Quantum Applications Software
descriptionHtml:
PsiQuantum's mission is to build the first useful quantum computers: machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry, including partners like GlobalFoundries, we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don't feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

That approach has since been tested at the highest level of scrutiny the U.S. government applies to emerging technology, and it has held up. In 2025, PsiQuantum closed a $1 billion funding round that valued the company at $7 billion. In 2026, the U.S. Department of Commerce signed a $100 million Letter of Intent under the CHIPS and Science Act, followed by a $125 million agreement with DARPA under Stage C of its Quantum Benchmarking Initiative, PsiQuantum's most valuable U.S. government agreement to date. This year, we also broke ground on our utility-scale quantum computer in Brisbane, Australia, and continued building out our Chicago site. Victor Peng, our CEO, and co-founder Jeremy O'Brien, now Executive Chairman, lead a team and board that reflects how seriously the world is taking this build, joined this year by Intel's Lip-Bu Tan and Atomico's Niklas Zennström. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies, including Airbus, Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical, to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift, and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we now have the funding, the government validation, and the sites under construction to make it real. 

Job Summary:

PsiQuantum is building the world’s first useful, fault-tolerant quantum computer. Our applications team focuses on developing algorithms and workflows in the fault-tolerant regime.

We are seeking a Quantum Applications Software Manager to lead a small, high-impact team of Quantum Applications Software Developers. This team builds the software tools and infrastructure that enable the development, evaluation, and deployment of quantum applications for real-world problems.

In this role, you will combine hands-on software engineering with team leadership. You will work closely with quantum algorithm developers and architects to deliver scalable, high-quality tools—such as simulators, resource estimators, and compilation workflows—that are critical to turning quantum algorithms into practical solutions.

Responsibilities:

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Team

  • Manage, mentor, and support a team of quantum applications software developers.
  • Provide clear direction, set priorities, and ensure alignment with team goals.
  • Foster a collaborative, inclusive, and execution-focused team culture.

Drive Execution and Delivery

  • Translate team objectives into actionable plans and deliverables.
  • Own day-to-day execution, ensuring projects are delivered on time and to a high standard.
  • Identify risks and remove blockers to maintain team momentum.

Contribute Technically

  • Remain hands-on in the design, development, and deployment of quantum applications software.
  • Guide technical decisions and support the team in solving complex engineering challenges.
  • Promote strong software engineering practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.

Build Quantum Applications Tooling

  • Oversee development of core tools such as quantum simulators, resource estimation frameworks, circuit compilation pipelines, and domain-specific application integrations.
  • Support the development of scalable and reliable simulation and compute infrastructure.

Collaborate Across Teams

  • Partner closely with quantum applications architects, algorithm researchers, and other engineering teams to implement software solutions for real-world use cases.
  • Contribute to cross-functional efforts that connect algorithms, software, and hardware.

Enable Quantum Algorithm Development

  • Support analysis and optimization of resource requirements for fault-tolerant quantum computations.
  • Help enable improvements in quantum algorithms through robust and flexible software tooling.

Experience/Qualifications:

  • MSc or PhD in Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • Experience in quantum computing, quantum algorithms, or quantum circuit compilation.
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including building and maintaining production-quality systems (Python, C++, or similar).
  • Experience leading projects and/or mentoring engineers; prior people management experience is a plus.
  • Experience with distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, or API-driven architectures.
  • Familiarity with fault-tolerant quantum computing and resource estimation is desirable.

Key attributes

  • A hands-on leader who enjoys both coding and developing people.
  • Strong execution skills, with the ability to turn objectives into delivered outcomes.
  • Pragmatic problem solver with a focus on impact and quality.
  • Effective collaborator who can work across disciplines and teams.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

PsiQuantum does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable laws.

title: Mobile Application Developer - AI Neobank App
descriptionHtml:

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

The Role

We are looking for Android engineers to build the native Android experience for Doit's AI Neobank App.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

 

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

 

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

 

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

  • Cares about making complex financial products feel simple.

  • Moves fast without creating messy code.

  • Notices UX, performance and reliability issues before users complain.

  • Honest about what they personally built, what was team-owned and what impact they can or cannot claim.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who only want fully defined tickets.

  • Developers who build screens without caring about user experience.

  • People who ignore crashes, edge cases, loading states or performance.

  • Engineers who move slowly in a startup environment.

  • People who exaggerate impact without explaining their actual contribution.

 

Location

This role is based in UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our UK office at least 3 days per week.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round


For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Operations Manager – Field Deployment, Logistics & Validation
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 160 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

The challenge

Our interceptor drone systems are deployed by small teams who must set up, operate and pack up fast, under pressure, far from any workshop. Between a system that works on the bench and one that works in the field, the difference is operations: the right kit in the right case, a checklist nobody skips, a manual operators trust. You will take our ground equipment into the field, see first-hand what slows teams down or breaks, and turn every lesson into a lighter kit, a sharper procedure and a better product.

Missions

  • Run field deployments: set-up, operation and teardown of ground equipment during trials and deployments.

  • Write operational checklists: preparation, set-up, pre-mission checks and teardown, so every team gets the same result.

  • Organize logistics: transport cases, packing lists, shipping and lithium battery transport.

  • Track weight and portability: weigh each subsystem, set targets with engineering, push for kits that are faster to carry and deploy.

  • Lead verification and validation: test plans, trials, acceptance tests and reports against requirements.

  • Produce user documentation: user manuals, quick-start guides, and structured field feedback to R&D.

Required skills

  • Engineering degree or equivalent (systems, mechanical or electronics), with experience in testing, integration or field operations of technical equipment.

  • Strong V&V fundamentals: requirements, test plans, acceptance criteria, test reports.

  • Tools: measurement instruments (multimeter, scales), office and documentation tools, Notion or equivalent.

  • Knowledge of drone or defense field operations; dual-use and lithium battery transport rules (UN38.3, ADR) are a plus.

  • Clear technical writing in English for manuals and checklists; French or Ukrainian is a plus.

  • Field-oriented and organized, available for frequent travel.

title: [Paris] Applied AI Architect, Industries
descriptionHtml:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic, you will be a pre-sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation

  • Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success

  • Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work

  • Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives

  • Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack

  • Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases

  • Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams

  • Travel occasionally to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building

  • Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns

You may be a good fit if you have:

  • 5+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager

  • Native or fluent French speaker (C1 or above)

  • Experience working with enterprise customers, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders

  • Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more

  • Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders

  • Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems

  • Comfortable with python

  • Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science

  • A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

  • Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 

À propos du poste

Au sein de l’équipe Applied AI d’Anthropic, vous intervenez comme architecte avant-vente, avec un objectif : devenir le conseil technique de confiance des grandes entreprises. Vous les aidez à comprendre la valeur de Claude et à se projeter sur la façon de l’intégrer et de le déployer avec succès dans leur environnement technologique. Vous alliez une expertise technique pointue à un vrai sens du client pour concevoir des solutions innovantes à base de LLM, qui répondent à des enjeux métier complexes tout en respectant nos exigences élevées de sécurité et de fiabilité.

En lien étroit avec nos équipes Sales, Produit et Engineering, vous accompagnez les clients depuis le cadrage technique initial jusqu’au déploiement. Vous mettez votre expertise à leur service pour leur faire comprendre les capacités de Claude, construire des évaluations et concevoir des architectures évolutives qui tirent le meilleur de nos systèmes d’IA.

Vos responsabilités

  • Travailler avec les account executives pour comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients et les traduire en solutions techniques, en alignant objectifs métier et mise en œuvre
  • Être le conseil technique principal des grands comptes tout au long de leur adoption de Claude, du cadrage à l’évaluation initiale puis au déploiement, en coordonnant en interne les différentes équipes et parties prenantes pour assurer leur réussite
  • Accompagner les clients qui développent aussi bien avec l’API Claude qu’avec Claude for Work
  • Créer et présenter des contenus techniques, adaptés à chaque public : aussi à l’aise dans une session technique approfondie avec des équipes d’ingénierie que dans une discussion sur la valeur métier avec des dirigeants
  • Orienter les choix d’architecture et aider les clients à intégrer efficacement Claude dans leur environnement technologique existant
  • Aider les clients à mettre en place des cadres d’évaluation pour mesurer la performance de Claude sur leurs cas d’usage
  • Identifier les schémas d’intégration récurrents et faire remonter ces enseignements à nos équipes Produit et Engineering
  • Vous déplacer ponctuellement chez les clients pour des ateliers, des sessions techniques et pour développer la relation
  • Vous tenir à jour des dernières évolutions des LLM, de leurs capacités et de leurs modes de mise en œuvre

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous avez

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans des fonctions techniques en contact avec les clients, comme Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer ou Technical Account Manager
  • Un français natif ou de niveau C1, et un anglais courant
  • L’expérience des grands comptes et des cycles d’achat complexes impliquant de nombreuses parties prenantes
  • Une capacité exceptionnelle à créer des relations et à expliquer des concepts techniques à des interlocuteurs variés : comités de direction, équipes d’ingénierie et IT, entre autres
  • D’excellentes qualités de communication technique, pour faire le lien entre les besoins des interlocuteurs techniques et métier
  • L’expérience de la conception d’architectures cloud évolutives et de l’intégration aux systèmes d’entreprise
  • De l’aisance avec Python
  • Une bonne connaissance des frameworks et outils LLM courants, ou un parcours en machine learning ou en data science
  • Le goût de transmettre, d’accompagner et d’aider les autres à réussir
  • D’excellentes qualités relationnelles et de communication : vous savez rendre simples des sujets complexes pour des interlocuteurs internes et externes très différents. Vous aimez collaborer au-delà de votre équipe, arbitrer et concilier des priorités parfois concurrentes
  • L’envie de réfléchir de façon créative à une utilisation sûre et bénéfique de la technologie, au service du développement d’une IA sûre

Date limite de candidature

Aucune. Les candidatures sont étudiées au fil de l’eau.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:€190.000—€220.000 EUR

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. title: Partner Account Manager, Cabinet Intégrateurs (en télétravail depuis Rennes) (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Vous cherchez un environnement professionnel stimulant basé sur l'autonomie et la confiance ?

Pennylane vous offre l'opportunité de grandir au sein d'une entreprise en pleine croissance.

Ici, votre expertise contribuera directement à aider les entrepreneurs à reprendre le contrôle de leurs finances. Découvrez un lieu où vos compétences seront valorisées et où vous pourrez façonner l'avenir de la gestion financière.

 

Notre vision

Notre ambition est de devenir le logiciel de pilotage financier préféré des PMEs européennes.

Nous aidons les entrepreneurs à se débarrasser des tâches chronophages liées à la comptabilité et à la finance, tout en leur donnant accès à des informations financières clés pour les aider à prendre les meilleures décisions pour leur entreprise.

Parallèlement, nous aidons les cabinets d'expertise-comptable, en leur permettant de passer moins de temps sur des tâches redondantes et répétitives, et plus de temps sur la partie conseil et accompagnement de leurs clients.

 

À propos de Pennylane

Pennylane est une des FinTech à la plus forte croissance en France, et souhaite bientôt adresser le marché européen.

 

En 5 ans d'existence, nous sommes parvenus à :

💻 Nous positionner sur le marché comme un éditeur de solution de comptabilité et de gestion financière innovant

💰 Lever un total de 350 millions d'euros, auprès d'investisseurs de renom, dont Sequoïa, le fonds phare de la Silicon Valley, connu pour avoir soutenu Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal et bien d'autres à leur début

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Passer de 7 cofondateurs à une équipe de 1000 collaborateurs, avec une note moyenne de 4,9/5 sur Glassdoor et 94% des évaluateurs Glassdoor qui recommanderaient PL à leurs proches!

🌍 Construire une équipe internationale composée de collaborateurs issus de 25 pays différents, avec une culture du télétravail très flexible

🤝 Gagner la confiance de milliers d'utilisateurs et obtenir d'excellents retours

🚀 Déjà plus de 1 000,000 TPE/PME et plus de 6000 cabinets d’expertise-comptable utilisent Pennylane en France !



Pourquoi ce rôle est-il important chez nous ?

Les intégrateurs historiques disposent souvent d’une expertise métier reconnue, d’équipes commerciales et de conseil, ainsi que d’un parc de clients à accompagner. Ils peuvent contribuer fortement à la croissance de Pennylane, à la fois par la vente de nouvelles solutions et par le développement de leur parc existant.

Pour transformer ce potentiel en résultats, il faut installer une dynamique commerciale durable : aligner les dirigeants et les équipes terrain, faire émerger des opportunités, améliorer la maîtrise du produit et faciliter la collaboration avec les équipes Pennylane. Tu aideras les partenaires à passer d’une relation de distribution ou de prescription à une collaboration active, structurée et créatrice de valeur.

 

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

Tu piloteras le développement d’un portefeuille de partenaires intégrateurs, de la stratégie de compte jusqu’à l’exécution des plans d’action :

  1. Développer les comptes partenaires, en alignant les dirigeants, responsables commerciaux et équipes opérationnelles autour d’objectifs communs.

  2. Accélérer le business Resell et Cosell, en animant les opportunités, en améliorant leur qualité et en aidant les partenaires à faire progresser leurs cycles de vente.

  3. Faire monter les équipes partenaires en compétence, grâce à des démonstrations, des formations et un accompagnement commercial concret.

  4. Créer une dynamique de croissance sur le parc existant, en identifiant les opportunités de déploiement, de migration et d’équipement des clients des intégrateurs.

  5. Faire rayonner les apprentissages du terrain, en partageant les résultats, les besoins partenaires et les leviers qui fonctionnent avec l’équipe Partnerships et les autres équipes internes.

 

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

1. Construire et déployer les plans de croissance des partenaires

  • Comprendre le modèle économique, l’organisation, les priorités et le potentiel de chaque intégrateur.

  • Construire avec les dirigeants et responsables commerciaux des plans de compte ambitieux, assortis d’objectifs et d’étapes concrètes.

  • Identifier les leviers de croissance adaptés à chaque partenaire : développement du parc, nouveaux projets, campagnes ciblées, événements ou actions conjointes.

  • Mobiliser les sponsors et les équipes terrain pour ancrer le partenariat dans les pratiques commerciales et opérationnelles.

  • Prioriser ton temps et les ressources internes en fonction du potentiel et de l’impact attendu.

2. Animer le business Resell et Cosell

  • Créer et entretenir une relation de confiance avec les décideurs, les équipes commerciales et les consultants du partenaire.

  • Suivre le pipeline Resell et Cosell, assurer la qualité des opportunités et rendre le forecast fiable.

  • Aider le partenaire à qualifier les besoins, structurer les opportunités et mobiliser les bons interlocuteurs Pennylane.

  • Coordonner les actions avec les Account Executives et clarifier les rôles sur les cycles de vente partagés.

  • Détecter les risques, débloquer les situations et accélérer les opportunités pertinentes jusqu’à leur conclusion.

3. Développer le parc et les opportunités chez les clients des intégrateurs

  • Identifier avec le partenaire les segments de clients et les cas d’usage prioritaires.

  • Construire des plans d’action pour équiper ou faire migrer les clients du parc lorsqu’une opportunité pertinente existe.

  • Aider le partenaire à organiser la prospection, la qualification et le suivi des projets issus de son réseau.

  • Participer à des rendez-vous clients, démonstrations ou événements lorsque cela peut accélérer le business ou renforcer la relation.

  • Suivre l’impact des actions engagées et capitaliser sur les approches qui produisent des résultats.

4. Former et rendre les équipes partenaires plus autonomes

  • Maîtriser la proposition de valeur et les principaux cas d’usage de Pennylane afin de réaliser des démonstrations convaincantes.

  • Former les équipes commerciales du partenaire à présenter la valeur de la solution, au-delà des seules fonctionnalités.

  • Aider les consultants et équipes opérationnelles à comprendre les conditions d’un déploiement réussi et à orienter les clients vers les bons interlocuteurs.

  • Préparer les partenaires à leurs rendez-vous, événements clients et temps forts commerciaux.

  • Adapter ton accompagnement aux profils et au niveau de maturité des équipes du partenaire.

5. Être présent sur le terrain et faire vivre la relation

  • Assurer une présence physique régulière auprès des partenaires prioritaires, notamment lors de revues d’activité, de rendez-vous dirigeants et d’actions commerciales.

  • Préparer et animer des revues de partenariat qui débouchent sur des décisions, des responsables et des prochaines étapes claires.

  • Entretenir un réseau de contacts au-delà de l’interlocuteur principal afin de sécuriser la continuité du partenariat.

  • Identifier tôt les signaux de risque, les irritants et les sujets nécessitant un arbitrage.

  • Représenter Pennylane auprès des partenaires avec exigence, réactivité et transparence.

6. Collaborer en interne et contribuer à la stratégie Partnerships

  • Coordonner les plans partenaires avec les équipes AE, Marketing, Ops, Produit et les équipes d’accompagnement concernées.

  • Faire remonter des retours terrain précis sur les besoins des intégrateurs, les objections, les évolutions de marché et les opportunités commerciales.

  • Proposer des initiatives marketing, commerciales ou produit pour accélérer la croissance des partenaires.

  • Partager les bonnes pratiques et les succès avec l’équipe afin de contribuer à la performance collective.

  • Maintenir des informations fiables dans le CRM et respecter les processus de vente et de suivi partenaires.

     

Profil recherché :

Compétences incontournables :

  • Tu as une expérience confirmée en vente indirecte B2B, gestion de comptes partenaires ou développement de réseaux de revendeurs et d’intégrateurs;

  • Tu as idéalement au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans un environnement logiciel ou SaaS B2B ; une expérience plus senior sera appréciée pour gérer des partenaires stratégiques et des cycles complexes;

  • Tu sais élaborer et piloter des plans de croissance avec des interlocuteurs de niveau direction et des équipes opérationnelles;

  • Tu as une approche commerciale orientée résultats, sais piloter un pipeline et transformer les analyses en actions concrètes;

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les rendez-vous terrain, les négociations, les présentations et les démonstrations produit;

  • Tu sais engager plusieurs parties prenantes chez un partenaire et construire une relation de confiance dans la durée;

  • Tu es proactif, créatif et résilient : tu sais prendre des initiatives et maintenir une dynamique même lorsque les résultats prennent du temps;

  • Tu es rigoureux dans le suivi des opportunités, le forecast et l’utilisation du CRM;

  • Tu apprécies le travail en équipe et sais collaborer avec des fonctions commerciales, marketing, produit et opérations;

  • Tu maîtrises le français et peux participer à des échanges professionnels en anglais.

     

Atouts appréciés

  • Une connaissance des solutions de comptabilité, finance, gestion, ERP ou logiciels de gestion pour les PME;

  • Une expérience auprès d’intégrateurs, de revendeurs, de VAR ou d’éditeurs logiciels B2B.

  • Une bonne compréhension des écosystèmes de distribution logicielle et des enjeux de déploiement chez les clients;

  • Une expérience de gestion de grands comptes partenaires, de plans de migration de parc ou de cycles Resell et Cosell.

     

Ce que nous recherchons surtout :

Au-delà de ton expérience, nous recherchons une personne qui :

  • Sait créer rapidement de la confiance et de la crédibilité auprès de dirigeants et d’équipes terrain;

  • Aime être au contact des partenaires et transforme cette proximité en actions commerciales mesurables;

  • Sait conjuguer vision stratégique du compte et exécution opérationnelle au quotidien;

  • Est à la fois autonome, coachable et généreuse dans le partage de ses apprentissages avec l’équipe;

  • A envie de contribuer à la croissance d’un réseau historique tout en faisant évoluer ses pratiques.

 

Process de recrutement :

  1. Screening Talent Acquisition — 45 min : motivation, expérience en partenariats logiciels, connaissance de l’écosystème et disponibilité pour les déplacements.

  2. Entretien Hiring Manager — 45 min : réalisations concrètes, gestion de portefeuille, activation et développement de partenaires, approche terrain et collaboration.

  3. Étude de cas — environ 1 h : analyse d’un portefeuille d’intégrateurs, proposition d’un plan de croissance, priorisation du pipeline Resell/Cosell et présentation d’une approche de démonstration ou d’enablement.

  4. Entretien final — environ 45 min : vision du canal, contribution stratégique, collaboration transverse et adéquation avec les ambitions de Pennylane.

 

🎁 Ce que l’on peut t'offrir :

🏥 Une mutuelle parmi les meilleures sur le marché (Alan Blue et Alan Mind)

🍜 Des tickets restaurants (Carte Swile)

🏝 Entre 6 et 12 jours de RTT supplémentaires aux 5 semaines de congés payés

🧑‍💻 Un budget dédié chaque mois pour tous nos Pennylaners, favorisant le travail depuis la maison ou en espace de coworking

🏢 Une facilité d’accès à nos bureaux, situés à quelques minutes de Saint Lazare en plein cœur de Paris

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

 

Pour t'épanouir chez Pennylane, il faudra:

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

 

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

 

Information importante à destination des candidat(e)s

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

 

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

 

Encourageant la diversité, équité et inclusion sous toutes ses formes, Pennylane offre un environnement de travail inclusif, bienveillant et propice à l’épanouissement, dans nos bureaux et en remote. Nous nous engageons à fournir les mêmes chances à tous nos candidats, indépendamment de leurs origines sociales et ethniques, genres, religions, orientations sexuelles ou handicaps.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à :
Notre data policy

title: Partner - Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness, London
descriptionHtml:
Associate Partner/Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness
London, UK

About Ekimetrics

Ekimetrics transforms how organisations make critical business decisions. We combine our Eki.Decisions platform with embedded experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science, connecting decisions across business domains to drive real, scalable and lasting impact. Our dual purpose is Competitiveness and Sustainability, because lasting leadership is built on both.

With a full in-house team and offices in Paris, London, New York, Hong Kong and Shanghai, we are committed to responsibility and frugality in AI, and to staying loyal to our values and DNA.

The opportunity

Marketing budgets are under the microscope, CFOs want proof, and AI is rewriting how performance is measured. Ekimetrics sits at the centre of that shift. Since 2006, we have helped some of the world’s leading brands turn Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) and AI-powered measurement into confident investment decisions.

As an Associate Partner, MMM & Marketing Effectiveness, you will be a senior leader of our London office. You will own a portfolio of strategic clients, shape how we grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business in the UK and build the next generation of Ekimetrics talent. You will work alongside the London General Manager and be trusted with increasing autonomy and strategic ownership.

What you will do

Lead strategic clients and world-class MMM delivery
  • Lead a portfolio of strategic, multi-account clients, or a major programme for a Tier 1 client, as Key Account Manager.
  • Define and drive the road map for each programme, from MMM and marketing effectiveness through to commercial and business-wide effectiveness, using our solutions model and the Eki.Decisions platform.
  • Safeguard scientific quality: robust MMM and econometrics, causal inference, incrementality and experimentation, and models clients can understand and trust.
  • Turn model outputs into decisions: budget optimisation, scenario planning and forecasting that change how clients allocate their investment.
  • Steer the delivery excellence, impact and profitability of your portfolio, securing the right teams for every programme.
  • Build and manage relationships with key media, platform and technology partners to drive innovation and growth across our accounts.
  • Share best practice and reusable assets across the Ekimetrics community.

Grow the business

  • Build long-term, trusted relationships with CMOs, CFOs and commercial leaders, securing renewals and positioning Ekimetrics as their strategic partner.
  • Identify and convert growth opportunities across your accounts, extending the value we deliver as client needs evolve.
  • Lead pitches and RFPs to win new logos and keep a strong pipeline.
  • Be the face of Ekimetrics in the market: speak at conferences and client forums, and lead thought leadership on the future of measurement, including AI and GenAI.
Build the team and the UK office
  • Lead by example, managing and coaching a team through regular 1:1s, performance reviews and talent assessments.
  • Play a key role in recruiting, developing and retaining top talent in London, and in succession planning for the office.
  • Contribute to our upskilling strategy with the Eki Academy team, and help shape the strategy of Ekimetrics globally and in the UK.
  • Champion our culture and values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Generosity and Enjoyment.

What success looks like

Given the strategic nature of this role, this advert provides an overview of its scope and expectations. Detailed objectives, KPIs, commercial targets and strategic priorities are confidential and will be discussed with shortlisted candidates at the appropriate stage.

  • A portfolio of strategic accounts that delivers measurable client impact, strong delivery standards and sustainable commercial growth.
  • Trusted senior client relationships that lead to renewals, broader partnerships and long-term value.
  • Healthy profitability, supported by disciplined management of scope, resources and delivery.
  • A strong contribution to new business, through the origination and conversion of opportunities.
  • A visible market presence that strengthens Ekimetrics’ reputation and opens doors.
  • An engaged, high-performing team, with developing leaders and clear succession opportunities.
  • A meaningful contribution to the direction and performance of the UK business.

About You

Ideally, you have:

  • Extensive experience leading strategic client relationships and complex programmes in consulting or a comparable professional services environment, typically gained over 15 or more years.
  • Accountability for the commercial performance of a portfolio, including revenue growth, profitability and resource decisions.
  • Deep expertise in marketing effectiveness and MMM, with a track record of turning analytical work into decisions at senior client level.
  • Strong grounding in econometrics and statistical modelling, with the technical judgement to challenge assumptions, guide specialists and safeguard scientific quality.
  • A clear understanding of how complementary approaches—including incrementality testing, experimentation and attribution—support a coherent measurement strategy.
  • An informed perspective on the role of AI and data science in marketing effectiveness and business decision-making.
  • Strong knowledge of the UK market and an established network, with the credibility to build senior relationships and create commercial opportunities.
  • A track record of advising CMOs, CFOs, Chief Commercial Officers or Chief Data Officers, securing renewals and expanding strategic partnerships.
  • Experience originating and winning new business, including leading pitches, RFPs and commercial negotiations.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to translate ambition into priorities, align resources and manage commercial trade-offs.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn complex evidence into a clear recommendation and influence executive decisions.
  • A track record of developing high-performing teams and future leaders, alongside contributions to recruitment and succession planning.
  • The confidence to take ownership and make decisions autonomously, combined with a collaborative approach across clients, teams and geographies.
  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Statistics, Econometrics, Data Science, Economics, Applied Mathematics, Marketing Analytics or a related field, and fluent English.
  • An entrepreneurial outlook and the motivation to help shape a growing UK business within an international organisation.

Why join us?

At Ekimetrics, your ideas truly matter. We embrace an entrepreneurial spirit and encourage you to push boundaries to achieve meaningful impact. We thrive on collaboration, learning and growing together, through personalised career paths, challenging projects and mentorship and we believe in enjoying what we do.

In 2023, Ekimetrics obtained the “mission-driven company” status, reflecting our commitment to CSR, and we are part of the French Tech 120, the group of top French scale-ups recognised for their potential to become international leaders.

What we offer

  • A highly competitive package comprising base salary, sales and individual performance bonuses, a £5,000 corporate bonus and equity, so you share in the success you help build. Detailed bonus arrangements will be discussed during the recruitment process.
  • A seat at the table: direct influence over the future of Ekimetrics in the UK, with the autonomy and backing to grow our MMM and marketing effectiveness business.
  • The opportunity to advise leading brands on consequential investment decisions and work at the forefront of AI-powered decision-making.
  • An international community of in-house experts in marketing, commercial effectiveness and data science.
  • Private medical cover with Vitality, alongside benefits including GP access, physiotherapy, mental health support, consultant care, optical and dental cover, and worldwide travel insurance.
  • Life assurance at four times salary, critical illness cover at twice salary, and a 4% matched pension contribution.
  • 25 days’ holiday plus bank holidays, rising with tenure to up to 30 days.
  • Wellbeing support through our employee assistance programme, including counselling, physiotherapy and unlimited GP access.
  • Continuous development through certifications, online learning, training and knowledge-sharing sessions, including the Eki.Academy catalogue and the Climate School.
  • A vibrant community, with team socials, offsite seminars, hackathons, recognition schemes and perks including discounted gym memberships and retail discounts.
  • Modern premises in the heart of London and flexible hybrid working.

As an employer, Ekimetrics offers equal employment opportunities to all, regardless of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability, or age. Ekimetrics strives to develop an inclusive work environment that reflects diversity within its teams.

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Manufacturing runs on fragmented data: machines, sensors and decade-old systems that don't talk to each other. Data sits in departmental silos, knowledge lives in people's heads, and AI can't unfold its potential in point solutions that don't deliver. At Manex AI, we build the missing layer. Our platform handles manufacturing data at scale, models the factory ontology and builds agentic applications that reason and act across it.

We're a fast-growing team in Munich, backed by Lightspeed and BlueYard, with engineers from top companies and leading enterprise manufacturers as customers. We ship fast, work close to the shopfloor, and we don't ship things we're not proud of.

title: People & Admin Ops.
descriptionHtml:
🩺 Why Prévenir

Prévenir is a new Occupational Health and Prevention Service (SPSTI) in the Île-de-France region.

Our ambition is to rethink occupational health in order to improve its impact on employees’ lives and the experience of healthcare professionals, leveraging Alan’s technology.

Our first medical centre has opened at 117 Quai de Valmy, 75010 Paris, and this is just the beginning!

👉 To learn more about what day-to-day life is like at Prévenir, click here.

⭐ The role, concretely

Are you excited about building, structuring and scaling HR operations in a company that's just getting started? You will join Prévenir at a very early stage and help build the foundations of our People and administrative operations as the company scales. This role is particularly suited to someone who has already experienced a fast-growth environment, whether in a start-up, scale-up or during a 0-to-100 journey.

We're in the early chapters: this isn't about running existing processes — it's about creating them from scratch so they hold up at much larger scale. The role brings a product mindset to People operations, where every key moment of the employee experience is carefully designed, with a constant focus on simplicity and automation. You'll work closely with Lucie, who makes the final calls depending on topic complexity and supports you as you grow into autonomy.

Your time is split between:

  • Employee journey: onboarding, probation-period tracking, setting up and running performance reviews, feedback processes, and monitoring team engagement.

  • Documentation & operational efficiency: writing clear, user-centric documentation, spotting friction, simplifying or automating recurring processes. You leverage AI to multiply the impact of your work.

  • People admin: leave and absence management, payroll back-and-forth, contracting and employee administrative follow-up, onboarding formalities and affiliations (health/provident insurance, occupational health), GDPR compliance.

  • Operational finance: expense reports, preparing and sending accounting documents to Impulsa, preparing routine filings (including VAT).

Over time, this person will take ownership of payroll management in coordination with our accounting partner, with training and support.

👤 The profile we're looking for

Essential:

  • At least 5-6 years of experience in People Ops, very hands-on, and comfortable with admin topics (e.g., managing the relationship with an accounting firm)

title: Post-doctorat en conception d’accélérateurs de calcul pour IA embarquée sur FPGA
descriptionHtml:
Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Dans le cadre du projet STRIKEER, qui vise à améliorer la robustesse des systèmes de réception GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite Systems) vis-à-vis du brouillage et du leurrage, nous recrutons une post-doctorante ou un post-doctorant au sein de notre département MEE (Mathematical and Electrical Engineering).

En collaboration avec l’équipe du projet, la société ARKANE et ArianeGroup, vous aurez pour mission principale de convertir les traitements hybrides IA/DSP développés dans le projet en versions embarquables sur FPGA. Vous intégrerez et optimiserez une architecture hybride IA/DSP temps réel sur FPGA Zynq UltraScale+, en tenant compte des contraintes SWaP (taille, poids, consommation) des systèmes embarqués sur drones et lanceurs. Enfin, vous validerez sur cible les traitements embarqués (FPGA-In-the-Loop), implémenterez une première chaîne CRPA hybride complète et en assurerez la documentation, la traçabilité et la valorisation scientifique.

✔️ Vous avez de l’expérience en implémentation de réseaux de neurones quantifiés sur FPGA (Brevitas, FINN, hls4ml…), en traitement numérique du signal, systèmes GNSS/CRPA et plateformes SoC Zynq UltraScale+ (validation FPGA-In-the-Loop).

✔️ Vous faites preuve de rigueur scientifique, d'organisation, d'une forte autonomie et d'un esprit d'initiative. Vous aimez travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire et vous avez d'excellentes qualités de communication écrite et orale en français et en anglais.

title: Praktikum: Founder's Associate
descriptionHtml:
Über die Stelle

Kein Bock auf einen Job in einem Unternehmen, das es wegen KI in einem Jahr eh nicht mehr gibt? Was es dann noch geben wird: geile Snacks. Die ersetzt dir keine KI.

Genau daran arbeiten wir. SNACKL ist der herzhafte Proteinsnack, mit dem wir Deutschland eine neue Snack-Kultur geben wollen. Unterstützt werden wir von dem besten Food-VC Deutschlands, und sind auf steilem Wachstumskurs.

Bei uns verschwindest du nicht in einer Abteilung, sondern sitzt direkt neben den Gründern und siehst, wie ein Food-Startup von innen funktioniert. Als Founder’s Associate bist du unser Generalist: Du springst dorthin, wo es gerade brennt, und übernimmst Projekte von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung, egal ob Website, Marketing, Operations oder Finance. Heute baust du eine neue Landingpage, morgen vibe-codest du eine App für unsere internen Prozesse, übermorgen schreibst du Skripte für Meta-Ads und darfst beim Dreh selbst mit vor der Kamera (Wenn du es möchtest).

Wir suchen keinen Spezialisten, sondern jemanden, der Probleme löst, Verantwortung übernimmt und Dinge zu Ende bringt.

Womit du Wirkung erzielt

  • Website & Tech: Du baust und optimierst unseren Shopify-Shop mit, setzt neue Seiten und Features um und scheust dich nicht vor ein bisschen Code, auch mit Hilfe von KI.
  • Prozesse & Automatisierung: Du findest Abläufe, die noch manuell laufen, und baust sie smarter auf, von internen Tools bis zu automatisierten Workflows.
  • Wachstum & neue Kanäle: Du findest heraus, wo SNACKL als Nächstes hin sollte, rechnest es durch und bringst es an den Start.
  • Operations & Logistik: Du behältst Bestände, Nachbestellungen und Fulfillment im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Snacks zuverlässig bei Kunden und Partnern ankommen.
  • Finance & Analyse: Du unterstützt bei Reportings, Kalkulationen und Auswertungen und lernst, Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen zu treffen.
  • Founder Projects: Du übernimmst strategische Sonderprojekte direkt mit dem Gründerteam, von Events bis zur Vorbereitung neuer Vertriebskanäle.

Dein Profil

  • Generalist: Du hast Lust auf viele Themen gleichzeitig und arbeitest dich schnell in Neues ein, ob Excel-Modell, Shopify-Theme oder Content-Konzept.
  • KI-affin: Du nutzt Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT nicht nur für Texte, sondern um echte Arbeit schneller und besser zu erledigen. Erste Erfahrungen mit Vibe Coding, Automatisierung oder bauen eigener Apps sind ein großes Plus.
  • Strukturiert: Du schaffst Ordnung im Chaos, denkst in Prozessen und behältst auch bei mehreren Baustellen den Überblick.
  • Zahlenverständnis: Du hast keine Angst vor Zahlen und verstehst, was hinter einer Marge oder einer Conversion Rate steckt.
  • Echte Motivation: Du hast den Drive, Themen eigenverantwortlich voranzutreiben, und willst in einem Early-Stage Startup wirklich etwas bewegen.

Das passt zu dir, wenn...

  • ... du lieber viele verschiedene Dinge machst, als dich auf eine Aufgabe zu beschränken.
  • ... du Verantwortung suchst und auch in der „Startup-Chaos-Phase“ selbst Struktur schaffst.
  • ... du lieber schnell umsetzt und testest, als monatelang am „perfekten“ Konzept zu feilen.
  • ... du dir vorstellen kannst, später selbst zu gründen, und dir genau das aus nächster Nähe anschauen willst.

Das passt eher nicht, wenn...

  • ... du klare 9-to-5-Strukturen und ein fertiges Handbuch für jede Aufgabe brauchst.
  • ... du dich auf ein Fachgebiet spezialisieren willst und keine Lust auf Abwechslung hast.
  • ... dir Aufgaben „unter deinem Niveau“ zu schade sind, denn bei uns packt jeder überall mit an.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Output over Presence: Wir entscheiden nach Ergebnissen. Wir halten Hierarchien flach, Meetings kurz und das Tempo hoch.
  • Steile Lernkurve: Du bekommst Einblick in wirklich alle Bereiche eines Early-Stage Food Startups, von Produktion über Marketing bis Finanzierung, und lernst direkt vom Gründerteam.
  • AI-first Arbeiten: Du lernst, wie man mit modernen KI-Tools in kurzer Zeit Websites, Apps, Prozesse und Kampagnen baut, ein Skill, der dir überall Türen öffnet.
  • Community & Spirit: Du wirst Teil eines ambitionierten Teams, das den Snack-Markt nachhaltig verändern wird.

Rahmenbedingungen

Ort: Berlin (Hybrid möglich)

Anstellungsart: Praktikum (Pflicht- oder freiwilliges Praktikum, Teil- oder Vollzeit, idealerweise 3–6 Monate)

Start: Ab sofort / nach Absprache
