Du schaust gemeinsam mit dem Kunden auf die Ad-Zahlen und entscheidest daraus, welche Creator und welcher Content als Nächstes kommen. Dazu kommen Awareness-Kampagnen. Außerdem planst du Social-Content für deine Kunden: Du verstehst, welche Trends gerade funktionieren, und übersetzt sie strategisch für die Marke und ihre Zielgruppe. Selbst im Ads-Manager steuerst du nur bei einzelnen Kunden. Das musst du nicht schon perfekt können, das lernst du bei uns.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Content-Planung: Du planst Social-Content für deine Kunden und richtest ihn an Marke, Ziel und Zielgruppe aus.

  • Trends & Strategie: Du erkennst früh, was auf TikTok und Instagram funktioniert, und übersetzt Trends strategisch für deinen Kunden und seine Zielgruppe.

  • Creator-Einkauf: Du findest passende Creator, buchst sie und verhandelst Honorare, Nutzungsrechte und Paid Usage (Spark Ads, Whitelisting) eigenständig.

  • Briefing: Du brieftst Creator so, dass der Content als Ad funktioniert, prüfst Skripte und stimmst dich mit unseren Produktionen ab.

  • Content zu Ads: Du entscheidest, welche Assets als Dark oder Spark Ad laufen, und lieferst sie an den Kunden aus.

  • Auswertung: Du liest die Ad-Zahlen (CPM, CTR, Hold Rate, Kosten pro Neukunde) und die Kommentarspalten und leitest daraus die nächste Creator-Auswahl ab.

  • Ad-Steuerung: Bei vereinzelten Kunden planst, schaltest und optimierst du die Kampagnen auf Meta und TikTok selbst.

  • Kundenkontakt: Du stellst Ergebnisse vor und vertrittst deine Empfehlungen beim Kunden.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • 2–3 Jahre Erfahrung im Creator- oder Influencer-Marketing, gern auf Agenturseite oder im Creator-Programm einer Marke.

  • Du hast Creator selbst ausgewählt, gebucht und Honorare oder Nutzungsrechte verhandelt.

  • Du verfolgst Social-Trends und kannst begründen, warum ein Format zu einer Marke und ihrer Zielgruppe passt.

  • Du weißt, warum ein Creator-Video als Ad funktioniert (Hook, Hold Rate, CTR), und hast schon mit Ad-Zahlen gearbeitet, egal ob du selbst geschaltet hast oder eng mit einem Performance-Team.

  • CPM, CTR, ROAS und Conversion-Rate liest du nicht nur, du triffst damit Entscheidungen.

  • Du wohnst im Raum Köln oder ziehst her.

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und fließendes Englisch.

Schön, wenn du schon selbst im Meta- oder TikTok-Ads-Manager gearbeitet hast, Dark und Spark Ads umgesetzt hast und mit Pixel und Conversions API vertraut bist.

Benefits

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Verantwortung: Du kaufst für einen unserer größten Accounts Creator eigenständig ein und entscheidest mit, wer als Nächstes gebucht wird.

  • Growth: Raum für deine Entwicklung in Richtung Senior oder Unit-Verantwortung. Wer bei uns wächst, bekommt Perspektive: Verantwortung als Führungskraft im Team oder fachlich im eigenen Thema.

  • Hybrid: flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice und Office, mittwochs ist unser Office Day.

  • Team: kurze Entscheidungswege und Sparring direkt mit den Gründern.

  • Equipment und Perks: MacBook, modernes Office im Herzen von Köln, Jobticket, regelmäßige Teamevents.

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf und zwei, drei Sätze zu einer Creator-Buchung, die du selbst verhandelt hast: wofür, zu welchen Konditionen, was dabei herauskam. Wir melden uns innerhalb von 2 Werktagen.

title: Propulsion Design Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission:

As a Propulsion Design Engineer, you will join the Propulsion team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ propulsion system. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the electric propulsion system and guide the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, and manufacturing drawings.

You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.

The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of one of the most advanced electric propulsion systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Mature the propulsion system installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).

  • Design and detail mechanical components, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.

  • Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

  • Prepare and release detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards. Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system.

  • Assess system, interface and certification requirements and translate them into robust and practical design solutions.

  • Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability.

  • Perform engineering assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation.

  • Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements.

  • Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration

  • Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals.

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

  • At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in a design engineering role on an EASA/FAA Part 23/25 aircraft development program.

  • Experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or international equivalent.

  • Practical experience with the design and integration of aircraft powerplant systems. Experience with electric aviation or electric propulsion systems is an asset.

  • Strong proficiency in CAD software, preferably CATIA V5/V6, including experience in part design, generative shape design, sheet metal design, assembly design, and drafting.

  • Sound knowledge of mechanical component design, aerospace materials, standard hardware and manufacturing methods, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, assembly and inspection requirements.

  • Understanding of design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly principles.

  • Ability to develop and assess installation designs while balancing functional, structural, environmental, certification, manufacturing and maintainability considerations.

  • Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach and attention to detail.

  • A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and the ability to work effectively in a multicultural team.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.

  • Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.

We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist.

 

Why us?

  • Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.

  • We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.

  • Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.

  • Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.

  • Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.

  • Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.

  • Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.

  • Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.

  • Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.

  • Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.

  • Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

VÆRIDION was founded in 2021 to transform regional air travel with the Microliner, a 100% electric commercial aircraft. By delivering the most energy-efficient aircraft, we are building the future where clean, safe, and affordable electric aviation seamlessly connects people and businesses. We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

title: QA Lead - Data Platform (TL1)
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol or London

Level: TL1

Team: Quality

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Shira Tsinovich

 

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.

 

About Kaluza

 

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

 

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

 

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.

 

What you’ll do


As the QA Lead across Data you will work closely with the Data Org, setting the testing approach and quality standards for its products and platforms.

You will be the quality partner for data delivery teams, advising on testing and quality assurance across the software delivery lifecycle. You will work with Data Engineering, Product teams, and clients to make sure changes meet the defined quality bar before they reach client environments.

This is an individual contributor role with no line management responsibilities. You will influence through expertise, relationships, and evidence.

  • Define and own the test strategy and test plans for the Data Org, deciding what is tested and how, based on risk, criticality, and impact to the business and clients.

  • Create and deliver test plans for complex data systems, covering functional, transformation, schema, and ETL/migration testing, plus end-to-end coverage across data and engineering teams.

  • Set the quality gates that determine whether a change is fit to be promoted to client environments, and assess release readiness against milestones.

  • Ensure defects are logged, triaged, prioritised, and tracked to resolution in accordance with Quality standards, and drive root-cause analysis on recurring or high-impact issues.

  • Select and maintain the tools and frameworks used for testing, with automated checks running in CI/CD.

  • Work with delivery teams, programme teams, and clients to support queries on test data and releases, and to maintain client confidence through clear, professional communication.

  • Influence engineers, data analysts, and leadership to adopt a test-first mindset and own the quality of their products, and hold a firm line on quality standards.

  • Report on test progress, quality trends, and risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and raise delivery risks and blockers early.

  • Maintain documentation of quality standards, test coverage, and decisions, with transparency on known issues and risks.

  • Act as the subject matter expert on data testing and data quality practices, including data quality checks (completeness, accuracy, consistency, uniqueness, validity, timeliness).

What you’ll bring

  • Proven QA and testing experience: Strong knowledge of QA strategies, processes and methodologies, including defining and executing test plans, test cases and test scripts for complex software applications.

  • Agile, test-first delivery: Experience in cross-functional Agile teams with a test-first mindset, managing priorities, scope and risk to maximise testing impact across distributed engineering organisations.

  • Data testing and SQL: Working knowledge of data testing methods (data quality checks, schema validation, transformation testing, ETL/migration testing), plus SQL proficiency for querying and profiling large datasets to diagnose quality issues.

  • Quality metrics and reporting: Experience building quality metrics, dashboards and reporting for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Collaboration and communication: Strong stakeholder management and verbal and written communication skills, working with development, product and client teams at all levels of management, including client engagement.

  • Influence and coaching: Ability to influence and negotiate across engineering, product and leadership, hold a firm line on quality standards, and coach engineers and product managers to own the quality of their products.

  • Client Delivery: experience working directly with client teams to define and report quality metrics, and to introduce quality improvement plans.

  • Nice to have: Test automation framework experience; defining quality gates in CI/CD or release pipelines; AI tools for identifying and fixing data issues; data testing and observability tooling; familiarity with data governance, data contracts and GDPR; and Python and visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Looker).

Our Values

 

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

 

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.

 

Our Perks

 

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app

Come as you are

 

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

 

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Quality Assurance Inspector (All Genders)
descriptionHtml:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners  with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.

We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.

WHY JOIN US

  • The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
  • You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
  • We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Our Production Quality team in Thessaloniki is the technical shield protecting the integrity of STARK’s next-generation autonomous systems. Operating directly on the production floor, we partner with assembly leads, technicians, and engineering teams to stand up resilient, high-yield manufacturing processes. We bridge precise structural mechanical builds with complex, high-reliability aerospace-grade electronics. We value absolute technical precision, structured problem-solving, and the proactive ownership required to safeguard zero-defect manufacturing standards.

YOUR MISSION

As our Quality Assurance Inspector, you will be the final gatekeeper of production standards on our assembly floor. Utilizing your combined knowledge of mechanical and electronics engineering, you will continuously review active assembly lines, verify build documentation, and ensure all mandatory inline steps are executed flawlessly. You will take end-to-end ownership of on-floor quality checks—collaborating closely with Manufacturing Engineers to identify assembly gaps, block defective parts, and update localized Control Plans so our processes are continuously improved.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK

  • Conduct rigorous inline quality checks on active production lines, verifying that electro-mechanical sub-assemblies, wire harnesses, and avionics conform exactly to design schematics.
  • Review assembly lines to identify physical gaps, actively collaborating with Manufacturing Engineers to implement tooling, jig, or process improvements.
  • Define, update, and maintain dynamic Control Plans (CPs) for inline assemblies and final products based on real-time assembly data.
  • Block defective products immediately, physically isolating and managing quarantined materials on the floor.
  • Initiate and coordinate technical reworks, providing on-floor guidance to technicians and verifying that repaired systems meet original engineering standards before re-release.
  • Perform final quality checks and outgoing document reviews before delivery, recording deviations in the QMS and creating precise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION

  • Education: Vocational diploma or technical degree in mechatronics, electronics, mechanical assembly, or a related field.
  • Experience: 3+ years as a Quality Inspector, QA Specialist, or Lead Assembler in aerospace, automotive, or defense.
  • Technical Skills: Strong practical understanding of both electronics (wiring, connectors) and mechanics (tolerances, fasteners, blueprints).
  • Process Review & Control Plans: Proven ability to spot floor assembly gaps, collaborate with Manufacturing Engineers, and execute dynamic Control Plans (CPs).
  • NCR Ownership & Languages: Experience managing non-conformances in QMS/ERP with professional working proficiency in English and Greek.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Active certifications in IPC-A-610 and IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards.
  • Familiarity with flight-critical avionics systems (flight controllers, power distribution boards, telemetry) or military-grade hardware, tactical defense systems, and UAS.
  • Familiarity with ERP/QMS platforms (SAP QM, JIRA, CAQ) and basic training in Lean manufacturing, Kaizen, or Six Sigma.

If you're interested in building the future of European Defence with us, and you see yourself reflected on the description above, please send us your CV in English. We're looking forward to meeting you!

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

title: Regional Director, Client Engagement
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets, the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion. Debt markets are vast, global and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 350+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We are bringing Client Engagement together as a single global function under our Global Head of Client Engagement. We are hiring Regional Directors to lead it on the ground. You will own retention, adoption and growth for your region (EMEA or the Americas), lead a team of Client Engagement Managers across a tiered coverage model, and turn client insight into action across the business.

This is a role for a proven CS or AM leader who wants to scale a function. You will inherit a strong foundation, shape the next stage, and be accountable for commercial outcomes: gross and net revenue retention, product adoption, and the health of our most important client relationships.

What You’ll Work On

Every day is different, but here is the kind of work you will lead:

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead, coach and develop a regional team of Strategic CEMs, Senior CEMs and Client Engagement Managers across the whole region, and the managers beneath you as the team grows.

  • Run a tiered coverage model: Strategic CSMs for our most important accounts, Senior CSMs for key accounts, and CSMs for the wider base. Define clear roles, service levels and career paths at each level.

  • Hire, onboard and train to a rapid growth plan, with a strong bench of internal successors.

Retention, Adoption & Growth

  • Own regional gross revenue retention (GRR), with clear early-warning signals and remediation plans for at-risk accounts.

  • Drive seat-level adoption: activate and re-activate users, build champion networks, and embed 9fin in each client’s daily workflow.

  • Lead adoption of our newest products, including 9fin AI and Private 9fin, with client-specific programmes and measurable usage goals.

  • Design role and client-specific adoption metrics that forecast usage trends, so the team drives usage proactively.

  • Partner with Account Management and Relationship Managers on renewals and expansion, with clear ownership at each stage of the client lifecycle.

Strategy & Operating Model

  • Translate the global Client Engagement strategy into a regional plan, with the playbooks, success plans and lifecycle programmes to execute it.

  • Use health scoring and usage data to decide where the team spends its time, and to move accounts between coverage tiers as their needs change.

  • Report regularly on regional KPIs to global leadership: retention, adoption, health, renewals and expansion pipeline.

Voice of the Client

  • Represent clients in conversations with Product, Engineering, Data and Editorial, backing requests with evidence such as the accounts affected, the ARR at stake and the workflow impact.

  • Work with our Forward Deployed team on strategic accounts, setting shared success criteria and feeding what you learn back into the product.

  • Build executive relationships with senior stakeholders at your region’s most important clients.

Operational Excellence

  • Use Salesforce, our analytics tools and client engagement platforms to make the team more proactive, with automation where it frees up time for high-value work.

  • Keep playbooks, client communications and dashboards current, and create feedback loops that improve the client experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 3 months: a clear picture of your region’s accounts, risks and team, and a regional plan agreed with the Global Head of Client Engagement.

  • Within 6 months: accounts assigned and covered under the tiered model, with health scoring in use and a visible improvement in early-warning response.

  • Within 12 months: measurable gains in regional retention, adoption and AI and Private 9fin usage, and a team with the capacity and leadership depth to keep scaling.

Requirements

This role will be a great fit if you have:

Experience & Expertise

  • 8+ years in Customer Success, Account Management or related client-facing roles in Capital Markets, Enterprise B2B SaaS or Financial Data, including 3+ years leading teams.

  • Experience managing AMs, CSMs, AEs or building the layer of leadership beneath you, ideally across more than one region or client segment.

  • A track record of scaling or structuring a CS or AM function through a period of fast growth.

  • Strong understanding of global financial markets, and credibility with buyside, sellside and advisory clients.

Commercial Acumen

  • Proven success driving retention, adoption and expansion in enterprise accounts, ideally accountable for a portfolio of $50m in ARR.

  • Comfort being measured on GRR, NRR and adoption, and designing the KPIs, dashboards and forecasting that support them.

  • Experience working alongside sales and account management on renewals and expansion, with clear ownership between teams.

Leadership & Communication

  • Excellent people leadership: you coach, develop and hold a high bar for high-performing teams.

  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders both inside 9fin and at clients.

  • The judgement to prioritise competing demands and to use data to decide where the team focuses.

Bonus Points

  • Existing relationships in the Leveraged Finance, Debt Capital Markets or Restructuring community.

  • Experience in a high-growth fintech or data provider, or with seat-based professional data products.

  • Experience driving adoption of AI products or working with embedded or forward deployed teams.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, product analytics and client engagement platforms.

Why Join Us?

You will join a fast-moving, ambitious team helping to power the largest financial market in the world. This role offers the chance to lead a regional Client Engagement team at a pivotal moment: with a clear global strategy, a product that clients rely on daily, and the mandate to shape how we retain and grow our client base for years to come.

Benefits

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Financial & Insurance

  • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

  • Equity

  • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

  • Private Medical Insurance

  • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

  • Group Life Assurance

  • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

Time off

  • 25 holiday days per year

  • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

  • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • AI experimentation budget of £800 (UK) per employee to trial AI tools

  • Quarterly team socials

  • Summer and Winter company social events

 

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Regional Sales Director, Strategic Enterprise - UK
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara's UK Enterprise business is one of our fastest-growing segments globally. We've scaled rapidly over the past several years — consistently outpacing the broader business — and we're now at an inflection point where we need to pair that momentum with operational rigour to sustain growth at scale.

This Regional Sales Director role is central to that next chapter. You'll lead a team of six Senior Enterprise Account Executives and Client Directors selling into some of the UK's largest and most complex organisations, spanning transportation, logistics, infrastructure, utilities, and field services.

The team is performing — but we want to turn strong results into a repeatable, scalable engine. That means bringing structure, coaching discipline, and a proven enterprise playbook without losing the pace and builder energy that got us here.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the performance, development, and day-to-day leadership of a team of Senior Enterprise AEs, driving net new logo acquisition and expansion across a defined set of strategic UK accounts
  • Coach your team through complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles where average contract values regularly reach seven figures over multi-year terms
  • Build and run a structured operating rhythm - pipeline reviews, deal inspection, forecasting discipline - while getting close enough to the detail to add value at the deal level
  • Develop your reps' ability to access economic buyers, build multi-threaded relationships, and position Samsara's expanding product portfolio against a customer's most critical business priorities
  • Pressure-test deal qualification, challenge assumptions, and help your team navigate the complexity of selling into large UK enterprises - this isn't a role where you sit above the deals
  • Build the commercial muscles - cross-sell, multi-product attach, stakeholder mapping - that will drive durable growth as we expand our footprint across the UK's largest accounts
  • Partner closely with the AVP of Strategic and Enterprise Sales UK, your peer RSDs, and cross-functional teams including Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to ensure your team has the support it needs to win
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Hire, develop and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • Proven experience as a frontline or second-line sales leader in B2B enterprise technology, with direct responsibility for team quota attainment
  • Track record of coaching Account Executives through complex, multi-quarter sales cycles with average deal sizes of £250K+ ACV, but with experience of seven figure ACV deals
  • Experience selling into large, multi-stakeholder organisations where procurement, legal, and multiple business units are involved in the buying decision
  • Demonstrated ability to build and enforce a structured sales operating cadence — pipeline generation, deal qualification, forecasting accuracy, and stage progression
  • Strong commercial instinct for multi-product or platform selling, where the value proposition spans multiple use cases and buyer personas

An ideal candidate also has:

  • Experience at a high-growth technology company that was scaling its enterprise go-to-market in the UK or EMEA — ideally where you helped build or refine the playbook rather than inheriting an established one
  • A coaching-first leadership style with a track record of developing AEs from good to exceptional, not just managing top performers
  • Experience managing forecast accuracy as a discipline, not just an output — particularly in an environment where leadership investment decisions depend on the reliability of your calls
  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, scaling organisation where not everything is perfectly defined yet, and where you're expected to build process while delivering results
  • A blend of strategic thinking and tactical intensity — you can set a multi-year account strategy and also jump into a deal review and tell a rep exactly where their qualification is weak

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

title: Regulatory Counsel
descriptionHtml:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We are looking for a Regulatory Counsel to join our Legal team to oversee global regulations governing physical AI and ensure comprehensive compliance across our growing product lines. You will serve as a regulatory advisor to many cross-functional teams, managing regulatory reporting and mitigating compliance risks in the rapidly evolving physical AI landscape.

 

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Analyze, interpret, and advise on global laws and regulations that affect physical AI and intelligent vehicles, including automated driving and ADAS rules (NHTSA, FMVSS, state AV frameworks, UNECE regulations, EU type approval), vehicle software and cybersecurity standards (UN R155/R156, ISO 21434, ISO 26262, SOTIF), AI governance laws (EU AI Act, US state AI laws), privacy and data access regimes, and related defense and export control requirements

  • Serve as a regulatory advisor to product, engineering, sales, and cross-functional teams, translating requirements into practical guidance and into the toolchain, Vehicle OS, and software development lifecycle

  • Draft and review comments on proposed regulations, written feedback on proposed legislation, responses to agency requests for information, and trade association submissions

  • Scope regulatory requirements for prospective partnerships, customer programs, and new markets, and support deal teams on regulatory terms in commercial agreements

  • Own regulatory reporting and agency filings, and build the internal processes and controls that keep them accurate and on time

  • Support responses to regulatory inquiries, audits, and information requests, in coordination with Public Policy, Security, Privacy, and outside counsel

We're looking for someone who has:

  • A J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing

  • 4 to 8 years of regulatory experience in-house, at a law firm, in government, or at a trade association, with substantive depth in administrative law, agency rulemaking, and compliance

  • Hands-on experience analyzing and drafting comments on proposed regulations or legislation

  • Experience advising on at least one of: vehicle safety regulation, autonomous vehicle or ADAS regulation, or export controls and defense compliance

  • The ability to explain complex legal requirements clearly to engineers, product managers, salespeople, and policy professionals, and to write memos and submissions that a regulator or legislator would find persuasive

  • Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, a practical and solutions-oriented approach, and the organization to run several matters at once under deadline

Nice to have:

  • Prior in-house experience at an autonomous vehicle (AV), OEM, or Tier 1 automotive supplier

  • A technical or engineering background to deeply understand autonomy product architecture and capabilities

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Applied Intuition pay ranges reflect the minimum and maximum intended target base salary for new hire salaries for the position. The actual base salary offered to a successful candidate will additionally be influenced by a variety of factors including experience, credentials & certifications, educational attainment, skill level requirements, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We are looking for a Regulatory Counsel to join our Legal team to oversee global regulations governing physical AI and ensure comprehensive compliance across our growing product lines. You will serve as a regulatory advisor to many cross-functional teams, managing regulatory reporting and mitigating compliance risks in the rapidly evolving physical AI landscape.

 

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Analyze, interpret, and advise on global laws and regulations that affect physical AI and intelligent vehicles, including automated driving and ADAS rules (NHTSA, FMVSS, state AV frameworks, UNECE regulations, EU type approval), vehicle software and cybersecurity standards (UN R155/R156, ISO 21434, ISO 26262, SOTIF), AI governance laws (EU AI Act, US state AI laws), privacy and data access regimes, and related defense and export control requirements

  • Serve as a regulatory advisor to product, engineering, sales, and cross-functional teams, translating requirements into practical guidance and into the toolchain, Vehicle OS, and software development lifecycle

  • Draft and review comments on proposed regulations, written feedback on proposed legislation, responses to agency requests for information, and trade association submissions

  • Scope regulatory requirements for prospective partnerships, customer programs, and new markets, and support deal teams on regulatory terms in commercial agreements

  • Own regulatory reporting and agency filings, and build the internal processes and controls that keep them accurate and on time

  • Support responses to regulatory inquiries, audits, and information requests, in coordination with Public Policy, Security, Privacy, and outside counsel

We're looking for someone who has:

  • A J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing

  • 4 to 8 years of regulatory experience in-house, at a law firm, in government, or at a trade association, with substantive depth in administrative law, agency rulemaking, and compliance

  • Hands-on experience analyzing and drafting comments on proposed regulations or legislation

  • Experience advising on at least one of: vehicle safety regulation, autonomous vehicle or ADAS regulation, or export controls and defense compliance

  • The ability to explain complex legal requirements clearly to engineers, product managers, salespeople, and policy professionals, and to write memos and submissions that a regulator or legislator would find persuasive

  • Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, a practical and solutions-oriented approach, and the organization to run several matters at once under deadline

Nice to have:

  • Prior in-house experience at an autonomous vehicle (AV), OEM, or Tier 1 automotive supplier

  • A technical or engineering background to deeply understand autonomy product architecture and capabilities

Compensation at Applied Intuition for eligible roles includes base salary, equity, and benefits. Base salary is a single component of the total compensation package, which may also include equity in the form of options and/or restricted stock units, comprehensive health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance coverage, 401k retirement benefits with employer match, learning and wellness stipends, and paid time off. Note that benefits are subject to change and may vary based on jurisdiction of employment.

Anstellung: Festanstellung mit vielen Freiheiten dank Gleitzeitmodell; zudem auch flexibles Lohnmodell möglich mit Gewinnbeteiligung, bei selbstbestimmter Abrechnung und eigener Gestaltung des Caseload

Start: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

Warum Oviva?

In der Schweiz beschäftigen wir rund 150 Mitarbeitende, darunter Psychotherapeut:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen und Ärztinnen und Ärzte. Gemeinsam bieten wir eine integrierte Behandlung für Menschen mit Adipositas und anderen metabolischen Erkrankungen an, die Ernährung, Bewegung, Psychotherapie und, wo medizinisch sinnvoll, medikamentöse Therapie verbindet. Unsere eidgenössisch anerkannten Psychotherapeut:innen arbeiten eng mit dem Behandlungsteam zusammen, damit emotionale Belastung und Essverhalten gemeinsam angegangen werden. Bei Oviva prägen flache Hierarchien, Gestaltungsspielraum und grosse Flexibilität bei der Arbeitszeit unsere Zusammenarbeit.

Die Stelle

Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang. Unsere Patientinnen sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patientinnen mit gewichts- und ernährungsbedingten Grundproblemen benötigen Unterstützung bei diversen psychischen und neurodivergenten Herausforderungen, wie etwa ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depressionen oder Angststörungen. Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch.

  • Du arbeitest eng und interdisziplinär in einem multiprofessionellen Team (u.a. mit Ärztinnen) zusammen, um eine umfassende Betreuung zu gewährleisten.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne, digitale Psychotherapie bei Oviva aussieht.

  • Du bringst Deine Expertise als Psychotherapeut:in ein, um Versorgung neu zu denken und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

Dein Profil

  • Eidg. anerkannte Psychotherapeut/in

  • Abgeschlossenes klinisches Jahr in einer Institution der SIWF Kategorie A, B oder C

  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit

  • Deine fundierte psychotherapeutische Kernkompetenz ist genau das, was wir suchen – ein zusätzliches, spezifisches Vorwissen im Bereich Ernährung oder Gewicht wird nicht vorausgesetzt.

Was Dich bei Oviva erwartet

  • Wirkung mit Sinn: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die moderne Gesundheitsversorgung revolutioniert und ganzheitliche Therapieansätze fördert.

  • Dynamische Kultur: Ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und Veränderung gefördert werden.

  • Regelmässige Inter- und Supervision, intern und extern: Du wirst unmittelbar durch eine*n erfahrene*n Fachpsychologin/Fachpsychologen in die Arbeit eingeführt und in regelmässigen 1:1 Gesprächen sowie Intervisionen in deiner Arbeit begleitet. Zudem erhältst du die Möglichkeit, an regelmässigen Supervisionen mit externen Expert*Innen in unserem Berufsfeld teilzunehmen und dich dort aktiv einzubringen.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

  • Familienfreundliche Anstellungsbedingungen, hohe Life-Work-Balance: Durch unser Gleitzeitmodell und unsere Home Office Möglichkeiten kannst du dir deine therapeutische Arbeitszeit einteilen, wie es für dich am besten in dein Leben passt.

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung. Weitere Informationen findest Du auf unserer Homepage: https://oviva.com/ch/de/psychotherapie/.

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen: Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich.

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür, eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiterinnen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Wir begrüssen und ermutigen Bewerberinnen mit allen Hintergründen und Identitäten einschliesslich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Nationalität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, Fähigkeiten, Religion und sozioökonomischen Status. Wir suchen aktiv nach Kandidatinnen, die eine einzigartige Perspektive mitbringen, um uns beim Aufbau eines stärkeren, inklusiven Teams zu helfen.

Oviva engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidatinnen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen.

descriptionHtml:
Take on the business and back-end operations that keep Kairos running: finances, payments, HR, compliance, and systems, plus support for our programs and Pathfinder groups.

Note: This role description is a first draft. Scope, salary, and responsibilities may evolve as our plans develop over the coming weeks, and we’ll keep you in the loop about any changes if you apply.

 

About Kairos

Kairos is a nonprofit accelerating talent into AI safety and policy. In just over two years, we’ve trained 1,200+ people through our flagship programs:

  • SPAR: The largest AI safety research fellowship, with 800+ mentees per round mentored by researchers from Anthropic, Redwood Research, RAND, MIT, the UK AI Security Institute, and others.

  • Generator Residency: In partnership with Constellation, a platform for generalist talent to pitch, build, and ship projects that build capacity and infrastructure across the AI safety ecosystem, with advisors from METR, Redwood Research, AI Futures Project, and more.

  • Global Challenges Project: A workshop series introducing promising students to careers in AI safety and biosecurity, run several times a year across Oxford, Boston, and Berkeley.

  • Pathfinder Fellowship: Helping grow the global network of AI safety university groups from a few dozen to nearly 100, with $9.5M in funding over the next two years to support their work.

We see ourselves as a portfolio of highly impactful projects in a fast-evolving field. Over the next six months, we expect to double in size and launch several new initiatives addressing critical gaps in the ecosystem.

 

The Role

We’re looking for a Generalist (Operations) to do the wide range of things that keep Kairos running in the background. The bulk of the role is core business and back-end operations: paying vendors, supervising accountants, supporting bookkeeping and our audit, figuring out how to employ and onboard people, and keeping us compliant. Alongside that, you’ll support our Pathfinder groups, process grants, build internal systems and automations, and pitch in on program ops.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Build systems and automations. Spot the operational work that shouldn’t be done by hand and automate it, so you and the team can spend time on the things that actually need judgment.

  • Run our finances and back-end operations. Pay vendors and contractors, supervise accountants, support bookkeeping and our annual audit, handle the logistics of employing people (payroll, benefits, onboarding and offboarding), and help keep us compliant. You won’t need to be an expert on day one, but you’ll learn to own these functions.

  • Process grants and payments. Run grant processing across Pathfinder and our other programs, make payments to individuals and organizations, and manage expense processing.

  • Pitch in on program ops and whatever else needs doing. Inbox triage, problem-solving on program logistics, and the occasional program-ops crunch where we need the hands.

 

Who You Are

  • Smart, agentic, and able to figure things out. A lot of this role is picking up unfamiliar processes (a new accounting task, a compliance requirement, a group’s odd request) and just working out how to do them well. We care about this more than about specific prior experience.

  • Great at automation and tooling. You instinctively reach for a better system rather than resigning yourself to doing things by hand, and you use AI and automation tools to get more done, complementing rather than replacing your own judgment. The best person in this role makes much of the repetitive work disappear.

  • Eager to help, and able to be assertive. You like unblocking people and improving their experience. You can be gentle but honest with a rejected applicant, and politely firm with an overly demanding one.

  • Organized and on top of things. You keep careful track of to-dos and information. When you drop a ball, it’s on purpose.

  • Strong writer and communicator. You’re clear and concise, and you think through your messaging from the reader’s perspective.

  • Mission-aligned. You care about making advanced AI go well, and you’re comfortable operating in the AI safety ecosystem and its culture.

While not required, we especially value:

  • Some experience in finance, accounting, HR, nonprofit compliance, event planning, or other business operations or nonprofit administration (but we’re glad to have you learn these on the job)

  • Strong automation and AI-tooling chops

  • Context on AI safety and the broader ecosystem

 

Why Work With Us

  • You’ll be working toward reducing risks from advanced AI, potentially the most important challenge of our time. The programs you’ll support influence hundreds of future AI safety and policy professionals.

  • Few ops roles are this broad. You’ll touch grants, finance, compliance, systems, and programs, and build unusually wide operating experience fast.

  • You’ll get to shape the role around your interests, with a say in which skills you build and which functions you take on.

  • We’re building a world-class team, so you’ll be in good company. Work alongside people from METR, Coefficient Giving, Rethink Priorities, and CEA who share your commitment to impact.

  • Collaborate regularly with leading AI safety researchers, policy professionals, funders, and organizers.

 

What We Offer

  • Base salary: $95,000–$190,000, depending on experience and location, with potential for additional compensation for exceptional candidates

  • Location: Access to office space in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston; optional coworking elsewhere. If you work from an AI safety office in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston, we cover food, lunches, and office expenses.

  • Benefits: Flexible working hours, highly competitive health insurance, dental and vision coverage, generous vacation policy, and professional development budget

  • Team retreats: We host all-team retreats three times a year to connect in person, collaborate, and build team culture.

 

Logistics

  • Start date: Flexible, though we generally expect new hires to be able to start within a couple of months of applying

  • Remote, with expected travel 3-6 times a year for conferences and events, predominantly in the US

  • We’d also be happy for you to work out of any of the AI safety hubs in San Francisco, Berkeley, London, or Boston, though we have a light preference for people to work out of Berkeley.

  • We prefer candidates who can attend meetings in the ET time zone (though our team currently spans GMT-8 to GMT+1).

  • We may be able to provide visa sponsorship to the US, depending on the circumstances (especially, but not exclusively, O-1As).

 

Our Culture

We’re a small, high-trust team motivated by the urgent challenge of making advanced AI go well. We try hard to figure out where we’re wrong, which means we say uncomfortable things to each other and change our minds fairly often. We value collaborative truth-seeking, a scout mindset, agility, and an alliance mindset with the broader ecosystem.

We also believe meaningful work should be enjoyable. We support each other’s well-being, celebrate wins, and maintain a healthy sense of humor even when the work is hard.

 

Application Process

  1. Application form (10–20 mins)

  2. Screening call (15 mins)

  3. Take-home assignment (1.5–3 hours, paid)

  4. Interview (45 mins)

  5. Reference checks

  6. Work trial (3–4 days, paid - this can be flexibly scheduled around your other commitments)

  7. Offer

If you’re excited about this role but unsure whether you meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. If you’re interested in multiple roles, apply to the one that best fits your skills and interests, and note in your application the other roles that you’d like to be considered for.

 

Questions? Reach out at Know someone who might be a good fit? If your referral gets hired and completes 6 months with us, we’ll pay you a $5,000 referral bonus. Learn more here.

Compensation: $95K – $190K

title: Head of Engineering Services (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Shopware ist eine international führende Open-Commerce-Plattform für ambitionierte Unternehmen im digitalen Handel. Mit einem API-first-Ansatz, maximaler Flexibilität und einer starken Community schaffen wir zukunftsorientierte E-Commerce-Lösungen. Unsere 450 Mitarbeitenden in ganz Europa teilen eine Leidenschaft für Innovation, Offenheit und Teamgeist.

Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Head of Engineering Services (m/w/d), der für die Leitung mehrerer Engineering-Teams innerhalb unseres Services-Bereichs verantwortlich ist. In dieser Rolle stellst du sicher, dass jedes Team befähigt wird, unabhängige SaaS-Services für unsere Kunden zu erstellen, zu betreiben und zu pflegen, und förderst dabei operative Exzellenz und hohe Servicequalität. Du schaffst außerdem ein kollaboratives Umfeld, in dem Teams Tools, Infrastrukturpraktiken und Wissen sowohl intern als auch mit der breiteren Open-Source-Community teilen können.

Diese Position kann vor Ort, hybrid oder auch vollständig remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder in ausgewählten europäischen Ländern, in denen wir registriert sind, ausgeführt werden. Dein Arbeitsort wird im Voraus vereinbart und bildet die Grundlage deines Arbeitsvertrags.


  • Leadership & Management: Du führst, mentorst und unterstützt mehrere Engineering-Teams, die für die Bereitstellung unserer SaaS-Services für unsere Kunden verantwortlich sind.

  • Operational Excellence: Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Services höchsten Anforderungen an Performance, Verfügbarkeit, Skalierbarkeit und Sicherheit entsprechen. Dafür etablierst du entsprechende Standards und Prozesse, sorgst für kontinuierliches Monitoring und treibst proaktive Verbesserungen voran.

  • AI & Engineering Transformation: Du gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer Engineering-Organisation durch den gezielten Einsatz von KI entlang des gesamten Software Development Lifecycles (SDLC), um Produktivität, Qualität und Kosteneffizienz nachhaltig zu steigern.

  • Shared Infrastructure: Du treibst die Entwicklung einer gemeinsamen Infrastruktur sowie einheitlicher Anwendungsstandards über verschiedene Teams hinweg voran. Damit stellst du sicher, dass unsere Services konsistent entwickelt, bereitgestellt und betrieben werden.

  • Agile & DevOps Practices: Du förderst eine agile und DevOps-orientierte Kultur innerhalb der Teams und stellst sicher, dass kontinuierliche Integration, Bereitstellung und Verbesserung fest in der Entwicklung und im Betrieb unserer Services verankert sind.

  • Interne & externe Zusammenarbeit: Du förderst den teamübergreifenden Austausch von Tools, Frameworks und Best Practices – sowohl innerhalb von Shopware als auch mit unserer Community. So ermöglichst du es auch unserem Ökosystem, auf gemeinsame Technologien und Standards zurückzugreifen.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Abteilungen wie Product und Operations zusammen, um Engineering-Initiativen mit unseren Unternehmenszielen abzustimmen und sicherzustellen, dass die Anforderungen unserer Kunden berücksichtigt werden.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Fundierte Führungserfahrung: Du verfügst über umfangreiche Erfahrung in der Führung von Engineering-Teams, idealerweise mit einem Schwerpunkt auf der Bereitstellung von SaaS-Services in Cloud-Umgebungen.

  • AWS-Expertise: Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse der AWS-Cloud-Infrastruktur mit und hast praktische Erfahrung in der Bereitstellung und Verwaltung von Services mit Terraform und Kubernetes.

  • Technisches Know-how: Du verfügst über tiefgehende Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Cloud-Architektur, Infrastrukturautomatisierung und Containertechnologien.

  • Erfahrung mit KI-Transformation: Du hast bereits erfolgreich gezeigt, wie du Teams über den Einsatz von KI-gestützter Programmierung hinaus zu einem KI-basierten Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) führst. Dazu gehören die Automatisierung von Entwicklung, Testing und Qualitätssicherung, die Etablierung geeigneter Governance-Strukturen sowie nachweisbare Verbesserungen hinsichtlich Produktivität, Qualität und Kosten.

  • Strategische Denkweise: Du bist in der Lage, strategische Initiativen für gemeinsame Tools, Infrastruktur und Best Practices zu entwickeln und umzusetzen, die sowohl unseren internen Teams als auch dem gesamten Ökosystem zugutekommen.

  • Kommunikations- und Führungskompetenz: Du überzeugst durch ausgezeichnete Kommunikations- und Führungsfähigkeiten und hast bereits erfolgreich die Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen Teams sowie mit externen Stakeholdern gefördert.

  • Community Engagement: Du begeisterst dich für Open Source und möchtest die Community aktiv unterstützen, indem du Best Practices, Tools und Infrastrukturkonzepte mit unserem Ökosystem teilst.

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Unternehmenskultur: Offene Kultur, flache Hierarchien, Eigeninitiative wird gefördert.

  • Arbeitsverträge: Unbefristete Anstellungen bieten langfristige Sicherheit.

  • Flexibilität: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Full-Remote-Verträge.

  • Ausstattung: Freie Wahl der Arbeits-Hardware.

  • Onboarding: Gut strukturiertes Onboarding mit Unterstützung durch einen persönlichen "Buddy".

  • Arbeitsumfeld: Inspirierendes Umfeld mit engagierten Kollegen und einer dynamischen Gemeinschaft.

  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Vielfältige Chancen für persönliches Wachstum und Entwicklung.

  • Zusatzleistungen: Attraktive Benefits wie betriebliche Altersvorsorge, Gesundheitsprogramme und regelmäßige Teamevents.

... und vieles mehr!
Einen detaillierten Einblick bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Deine Ansprechperson für diese Stelle ist Josephine Scheffler, die dir bei Fragen gerne zur Verfügung steht!

title: Implementation Manager - German Speaking (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Was wir tun: Wir entwickeln die innovativste, zukunftsorientierteste und am stärksten KI-gestützte Plattform für Energiemanagement. Von der Ressourcenoptimierung bis hin zu herausragenden, kosteneffizienten Kundenerlebnissen: Mit modernen Kundeninformationssystemen (CIS), Abrechnung, Messdatenmanagement, CRM und KI-gestützter Kommunikation treibt Kraken die nächste Innovationswelle in der Energiebranche voran.

Warum wir das tun: Die Energieversorgung der Zukunft wird anders aussehen als die, die wir heute kennen. Wir müssen über unsere Zukunft nicht nur nachdenken, sondern sie aktiv gestalten. Jetzt.

Seit über vier Jahren lizenzieren wir Kraken und unterstützen Unternehmen bei ihrer Transformation. Dabei übertragen wir nicht nur ihren Kundenstamm auf unsere Kraken-Plattform, sondern verändern auch ihre Betriebsmodelle und Arbeitsweisen. In dieser Zeit hat unser Team wegweisende Migrationen in der Branche vorangetrieben und neue Maßstäbe dafür gesetzt, wie Unternehmenstransformation aussehen kann.

🏠 Deine Rolle bei uns:

Du wirst Teil des Client-Delivery-Teams bei Kraken und begleitest europäische Kunden auf ihrem Weg durch die technologische Transformation. Dabei unterstützt du langfristige Migrationsprojekte.

Als Client Delivery Lead verantwortest du einen technologischen Fachbereich, beispielsweise Abrechnung, Finanzen oder Kommunikation, innerhalb unserer Kundenprojekte. Dabei geht es entweder um die Migration auf unsere Kraken-Plattform oder um die Betreuung langfristiger technologischer Anforderungen. Du arbeitest eng mit den technischen und operativen Teams von Kraken sowie mit dem Kunden zusammen, um die jeweiligen Projekt- und Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

Als Client Delivery Lead musst du genau verstehen, wie Kraken funktioniert. Du analysierst die vom Kunden gemeldeten Probleme und Anforderungen und konkretisierst passende Lösungen, um bestehende und neue Funktionen optimal zu nutzen. Du bringst Technologie, Menschen und Prozesse zusammen, um innovative Verbesserungen für unsere Kunden zu ermöglichen. Außerdem unterstützt du den Kunden dabei, Arbeitsweisen einzuführen, die zum Entwicklungsansatz von Kraken passen. Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Produktmanagern und Entwicklern zusammen, bringst Entwicklungsanforderungen ein und bildest die Schnittstelle zum Kunden.

🚀 Dafür übernimmst du Verantwortung:

  • Du betreust die Beziehungen zu deinen Ansprechpartnern auf Kundenseite, häufig Product Owner und fachlich Verantwortliche.

  • Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für technische Weiterentwicklungen sowie für die Eskalation und Lösung von Problemen in deinem jeweiligen Fach- oder Produktbereich.

  • Du bist die zentrale Wissensquelle dafür, wie Kraken funktioniert und wie wir die Kraken-Plattform bereitstellen.

  • Du sichtest und priorisierst eingehende Anfragen und kommunizierst die Prioritäten der Kunden intern.

  • Du fasst Kundenanforderungen, relevante Rahmenbedingungen und Zeitpläne zusammen und vermittelst sie intern, um die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Kraken-Plattform zu ermöglichen.

  • Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei der Umsetzung von Produktfunktionen.

  • Du regst Kunden dazu an, technische Entwicklung neu zu denken, und vertrittst unseren Ansatz der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung und Bereitstellung mit Überzeugung.

Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Fachrolle ohne Personalverantwortung. Dein Arbeitsstandort liegt entweder in Berlin, München oder komplett remote in Deutschland; deine Projekte können in unterschiedlichen Ländern angesiedelt sein. Reisebereitschaft wird vorausgesetzt.

Wir sind eine agile Organisation mit flachen Hierarchien und möchten das auch bleiben. Wir suchen aufgeschlossene Menschen, die mit Unklarheiten und einem sich ständig verändernden Umfeld gut umgehen können. Um bei uns erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du eigeninitiativ handeln und bereit sein, selbst mit anzupacken, um Probleme zu lösen. Dabei gehst du regelmäßig über deinen üblichen Aufgabenbereich hinaus, um unsere Kunden und unsere Organisation voranzubringen.

Du stehst hinter dem Kraken-Ansatz zur Technologieentwicklung, der auf Einfachheit, Kundennutzen und Effizienz beruht, und begleitest die beteiligten Interessengruppen durch den Veränderungsprozess.

Du bist bereit, bestehende Überzeugungen zu hinterfragen, unterschiedliche Perspektiven einzunehmen und bei Bedarf auch über deinen eigenen Verantwortungsbereich hinauszugehen, um den Kunden zu unterstützen.

Wir entwickeln Kraken für alle: eine universelle Plattform, bei der gemeinsam genutzte Weiterentwicklungen einen größeren Nutzen schaffen und die grüne Energiewende ermöglichen. Als Pioniere auf diesem Gebiet begeistert uns, wie Kraken das Leben unserer Kunden verändern kann. Wir sind überzeugt, dass Kraken die beste Lösung ist – sowohl für mehr Effizienz als auch als Werkzeug im Kampf gegen die Klimakrise. Wenn du diese Überzeugung teilst, bist du bei Kraken Tech genau richtig.

🧠 Das bringst du mit:

  • In dieser Position steht die Erfüllung der Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden für dich im Mittelpunkt. Wir suchen Menschen mit ausgeprägter Problemlösungskompetenz und einer durchweg positiven, lösungsorientierten Einstellung. Wenn du Herausforderungen gerne annimmst und den Ehrgeiz hast, erfolgreich zu sein, passt diese Position zu dir! Deine Haltung: „Jedes Problem hat eine Lösung. Neue Herausforderungen sind spannend, weil wir durch sie jeden Tag besser werden. Und je größer die Herausforderung, desto größer das Erfolgserlebnis.“

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten und/oder als Product Owner.

  • Erfahrung mit agilen Umsetzungsmethoden.

  • Erfahrung im Produktmanagement und mit Customer Journeys.

  • Ein solides Verständnis von Technologie und den damit verbundenen Trends.

  • Hervorragende Kommunikations-, Team- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten.

  • Überzeugungskraft und die Fähigkeit, traditionelle Denkweisen zu hinterfragen.

  • Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit umfangreichen, komplexen Projekt- und Umsetzungspipelines für Kunden.

  • Geduld und Eigeninitiative: Unsere Kunden durchlaufen tiefgreifende Veränderungen, die Zeit brauchen und unser Verständnis erfordern.

  • Gutes Zeitmanagement und eine tatkräftige, ergebnisorientierte Arbeitsweise.

  • Beratungserfahrung ist von Vorteil.

  • Fließende Englisch- und Deutschkenntnisse.

  • Vorerfahrung in Buchhaltung und Abrechnung oder im Zahlungsverkehr sowie Kenntnisse in FI/CO sind von Vorteil.

Da wir ein internationales Unternehmen sind, bitten wir dich, deinen Lebenslauf auf Englisch einzureichen und die Fragen in deiner Bewerbung auf Englisch zu beantworten.

title: Lead Product Designer (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship.

Role overview

UX is our number one priority, and we need a design leader who consistently turns design into business outcomes. As Lead Product Designer, you set the quality bar for our app, own our design system and drive our biggest product bets from first idea to shipped result. You are hands-on: you prototype, you craft, you ship.

You will report directly to our Head of Design and work with product and engineering every day. You will be the design partner who keeps the whole product consistent and high quality, together with our Lead UX Writer and a Senior Product Designer.

title: Research Scientist: Pre-Training
descriptionHtml:
About Enact

The next defining technological breakthrough will be in the physical world. We stand at a historical inflection point: bringing general-purpose intelligence into robotics.

At Enact we rethink the entire robotic tech stack from model architectures and data pipelines, to the actuators and sensors that feed the model. Pushing beyond pure vision and language approaches, we build a proprioceptive nerve system, and the cortex that makes sense of it, to solve dexterity through whole-body force-awareness and deploy robots for thousands of tasks in industry and beyond.

We are shaping a company where brilliant and unconventional people thrive together on solving the hardest challenges of our time. We are truth seekers. We reason from first principles, test our beliefs against reality, and trust that the best ideas can come from anyone. We move fast. We care deeply about our work and colleagues and are driven by passion to change the status quo.

If this resonates, we're excited to hear from you.

In This Role

You will build the base intelligence layer for robotics, training large-scale force-aware foundation models to unlock dextrous manipulation, generalizing across tasks and environments.

  • Design and execute large-scale pretraining runs for robot foundation models, defining the architectures, objectives, and training curricula that push AI-driven manipulation beyond pixels to actions.

  • Own experiments end-to-end, from data specification through training to real-robot evaluation, to understand scaling laws, data quality effects, and architecture tradeoffs.

  • Build datamixes and evaluation sets to train and assess robots on novel, high-precision tasks, across real-world and simulated settings.

  • Research methods for improving sample efficiency and robustness, ensuring learned policies generalize reliably from training to real-world deployment.

What We're Looking For

  • Deep experience developing large-scale predictive or generative models — including RSSM-style, JEPA, transformer, or diffusion/flow-based architectures.

  • Strong probability, statistics, and ML fundamentals, paired with the ability to design rigorous experiments and separate real signal from noise or bugs in experimental data.

  • PhD or equivalent research experience with a proven record of research accomplishments in machine learning, computer vision, data-science, robotics and other related fields

  • Strong fundamentals in ML computing frameworks like PyTorch or JAX, with familiarity in optimizing for performance and efficiency at scale.

  • Motivated to see general-purpose robotic intelligence deployed in the real world.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Prior experience working with real robot hardware

  • Led or made significant contributions to multi-node, multi-GPU distributed training efforts.

  • Experience designing or scaling data collection, annotation and mixing pipelines

  • Track record of open-source contributions or released models/datasets.

  • Publications at top robotics or ML venues (CoRL, RSS, ICRA, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR).

What we offer

  • The opportunity to make a real impact working on some of the biggest challenges of our time

  • A fast-paced learning environment alongside an outstanding, driven team

  • Ownership from day one, with the ability to iterate quickly and see your impact firsthand in an early-stage startup

  • Visa sponsorship & relocation benefits to hire the best in the world

  • A world-class in-person setup in central Zürich, with excellent prototyping, robotics, and technical infrastructure for hands-on builders

  • Competitive compensation and meaningful equity participation
