title: Responsable Métrologie – Transport de Biologie H/F/X
descriptionHtml:
TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

• Réduire les non-conformités température ayant un impact contractuel ou financier (pénalités, litiges de facturation), suivies via le tableau de bord dédié

title: Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

About DTA

DTA is WPP’s global data products and technology company. We bring together technology, data and analytics to help agencies and clients transform the value of data.

Our platform, Open Media Studio, is an AI-enabled media and data platform built for the next era of advertising. Our 1,000-plus team of thinkers, builders, creators and problem-solvers works across 20 markets worldwide.

The opportunity

We’re looking for a hands-on Security Engineer to help design, build and operate secure cloud platforms, data pipelines and data-sharing solutions. These capabilities support our internal product teams and deliver data to clients—either in client-owned cloud environments or in our own.

The role is GCP-first, with security patterns that can be applied across AWS and Azure. You’ll help embed security into infrastructure, identities, data products and AI-enabled services from the start—not bolt it on later.

As AI agents connect to data and systems through technologies such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP), our security model needs to account for machine identities, tool permissions and automated actions. You’ll help build the controls that make these services safe to use, including authentication, authorisation, monitoring and protection against risks such as prompt injection, tool misuse and data leakage.

You’ll work closely with Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Security Operations, Privacy, Legal, Marketing and Client Delivery teams. The goal is to make the secure approach the easiest approach—and to deliver reliable, well-governed data to our clients.

What you’ll do

Secure cloud platforms and automation

  • Build and improve secure cloud foundations in GCP, including resource hierarchies, organisation policies, VPC Service Controls, private connectivity, customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK) and centralised logging.
  • Develop reusable Terraform modules and project factories so teams can provision, test and redeploy secure environments consistently.
  • Apply policy-as-code in CI/CD, use keyless pipelines through workload identity federation, and automate detection and remediation of configuration drift.
  • Help establish equivalent security patterns in AWS and Azure.

Protect AI agents and MCP services

  • Help design and evolve secure patterns for MCP hosts, clients, servers, gateways and registries.
  • Build or operate MCP gateways and registries with approved-tool allowlisting, tool-level authorisation, rate limits and auditable records of tool calls.
  • Implement OAuth 2.1/OIDC authorisation using short-lived, scoped and audience-bound tokens; avoid token passthrough and require human approval for high-impact actions.
  • Help secure MCP services hosted on Cloud Run or GKE, using controls such as Identity-Aware Proxy and prompt or response screening.
  • Threat-model and help defend against prompt injection, tool poisoning, unauthorised tool changes, confused-deputy attacks and data exfiltration through chained tool calls.
  • Help secure the agent and connector supply chain through vetting, signing, versioning, scanning and sandboxing.

Engineer identity and access controls

  • Implement identity patterns for people, workloads and agents across Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, including federation, SSO, SCIM, Conditional Access and phishing-resistant MFA.
  • Extend identity governance to service accounts, API keys, workload identities and AI agents, using Saviynt or a comparable identity governance platform.
  • Support clear ownership, lifecycle management and regular access reviews for non-human identities.
  • Apply zero-standing-privilege principles through just-in-time elevation, short-lived credentials and automated access revocation.
  • Assess emerging capabilities such as Microsoft Entra Agent ID and Okta Cross App Access.

Protect data and enable secure sharing

  • Build data transformation pipelines and governed data products using dbt, SQL and Terraform.
  • Apply controls such as data classification, lineage, model contracts, policy tags, masking, row-level security and least-privilege access.
  • Help deliver data securely to clients and partners through BigQuery Analytics Hub, cross-cloud storage transfers and API integrations.
  • Support secure ingestion, cleansing, enrichment and transformation, with scoped access, encryption, audit logging and monitoring at each hand-off.
  • Develop secure data-sharing patterns, including data clean rooms and consent-aware pipelines.
  • Help prevent sensitive data from leaking into agent prompts, context windows, logs or third-party models, and ensure agents access curated data rather than unrestricted raw tables.

Secure social and marketing platforms

  • Bring brand social accounts, advertising platforms and martech tools under central identity control using Cerby or a comparable solution.
  • Support secure onboarding and offboarding, credential rotation, enforced MFA and time-limited, auditable access for agencies, freelancers and creators.
  • Treat social content—including comments, direct messages, reviews and mentions—as untrusted input.
  • Design guardrails so agents cannot combine access to private data, untrusted content and the ability to publish externally without appropriate safeguards.
  • Work with Marketing and Communications teams to detect and respond to account takeovers, impersonation and advertising-account fraud.

Improve detection, response and secure delivery

  • Send cloud, identity, MCP, model-safety and social-platform logs to the SIEM.
  • Build detections as code and develop SOAR playbooks that can revoke tokens, disable agents, quarantine MCP servers and rotate credentials, with human approval for high-impact actions.
  • Create golden paths, reference implementations and runbooks that help delivery teams build securely and independently.
  • Contribute to threat-modelling sessions, red-team exercises, design reviews and audit-readiness activities.
  • Help map controls to relevant standards and automate evidence collection.
  • Share knowledge and mentor less experienced engineers.

What you’ll bring

Experience and technical skills

  • Seasoned experience in cloud infrastructure, platform, data or security engineering, including hands-on GCP experience in production.
  • Strong practical GCP skills, such as IAM, organisation policies, networking, VPC Service Controls, Cloud Run or GKE, and BigQuery.
  • Working knowledge of comparable security capabilities in AWS and Azure.
  • Strong Terraform experience, including reusable modules, environment and state management, testing, CI/CD and policy-as-code.
  • Experience engineering identity controls with Microsoft Entra ID and/or Okta, including SSO, SCIM, Conditional Access, MFA and privileged or just-in-time access. Familiarity with Saviynt or another IGA platform is expected.
  • Hands-on SIEM and SOAR experience, including onboarding log sources, developing detections and building response playbooks.
  • Practical understanding of MCP and agent security. This could come from production work, open-source contributions or well-developed proofs of concept.
  • Experience with dbt and SQL for data transformation or data products, and a working understanding of data-layer controls such as classification, masking, row-level security and access grants.
  • Experience delivering data to clients or partners across organisational or cloud boundaries, using services such as BigQuery Analytics Hub, GCS, S3, Azure Blob Storage or APIs.
  • Coding ability in Python, Go or TypeScript for automation, tooling or MCP server development.
  • Familiarity with social, advertising or marketing platforms and the security challenges involved in managing brand accounts and non-SSO applications.

How you work

  • You build securely by default and consider how systems could be misused from the outset.
  • You automate repeatable work, test what you codify and look for ways to make secure delivery easier.
  • You balance risk, usability and delivery needs, and can explain when a solution is not ready—and what would make it safe to proceed.
  • You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical colleagues and can explain security risks in plain language.
  • You document decisions and create practical standards, golden paths and runbooks.
  • You measure outcomes, learn from incidents and feedback, and improve controls over time.
  • You collaborate inclusively, seek different perspectives and support the development of colleagues.

Security and regulatory frameworks

You’ll be familiar with relevant security, privacy and AI frameworks, such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF 2.0, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, CIS Benchmarks, UK GDPR/GDPR and the EU AI Act.

Certifications

You should hold—or be willing to achieve after joining:

  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect within six months.
  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud Security Engineer within 12 months.

WPP will fund exam fees and provide dedicated study time.

Nice to have

  • Experience operating MCP servers or gateways in production, or contributing to open-source agent or security tooling.
  • Google Security Operations or Microsoft Sentinel experience, particularly detection-as-code practices.
  • Kubernetes or service-mesh security experience, including workload identity, policy controllers or mTLS.
  • Software supply-chain security experience, such as SLSA, Sigstore/cosign, SBOMs or Binary Authorization.
  • Privacy engineering or AI assurance experience, including data clean rooms, consent management, pseudonymisation or AI red-teaming.
  • Familiarity with MITRE ATLAS, OWASP GenAI guidance or AI security testing.
  • Agency, media or consumer-brand experience, particularly in environments requiring multi-client data segregation.
  • Further relevant certifications, such as Google Professional Security Operations Engineer, Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer, HashiCorp Terraform Associate, Microsoft SC-300/AZ-500, Okta Certified Professional, AWS Certified Security – Specialty or CCSP.

Life at WPP Media

Our work is powered by a commitment to Be Extraordinary: investing in our people and supporting transformational creativity. We Lead Optimistically, champion growth and development, and create opportunities for colleagues to build connections and learn across WPP Media and WPP’s global network.

We aim to create an open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and can progress. Employee resource groups, in-office events and opportunities to share ideas help bring our teams together. WPP Media also offers a comprehensive benefits package; specific benefits vary by location.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer. We consider applicants without discrimination and are committed to an inclusive workplace. Teams typically work in the office around four days a week to support collaboration and connection. If you need an accommodation or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team.

This is a UK-based role. Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

title: Security Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
Location: Bristol or London, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)
Level: Engineering Manager (PL1)
Team: Information & Cyber Security, within Platform & Security Engineering
Salary: £70,000 – £87,000 + discretionary bonus
Contract: Permanent
Reporting to: Head of Information Security

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

You’ll join the Information & Cyber Security team, a core part of our Platform & Security Engineering organisation. Security at Kaluza isn’t a silo, so you’ll work closely with colleagues across security engineering, identity and access management, platform engineering and enterprise technical services.

As Security Operations Lead, you’ll own and grow the Security Operations function, leading a team across the UK and Australia. You’ll be the senior escalation point for security incidents, a calm and authoritative presence under pressure, and the person who keeps our operational security evolving to meet new threats, including those that come with being an AI-enabled business.

  • Lead the team: Build, mentor and manage the performance of a Security Operations team across the UK and Australia, creating an environment of continuous learning, clear ownership and psychological safety

  • Evolve incident response: Develop our incident response processes, especially around AI, maintain playbooks and standard operating procedures, and run exercises that build team confidence when it matters most

  • Hunt threats: Proactively hunt for threats before they become incidents, and work with penetration testers, red teams and bug bounty programmes to find weaknesses, then partner with security engineering and technology teams to close gaps

  • Own detection and tooling: Own our security monitoring and detection capability, including SIEM, EDR and threat intelligence platforms, driving the tooling roadmap, tuning detections to cut noise, and championing automation

  • Report on what matters: Define and own Security Operations KPIs and KRIs, and give senior stakeholders clear reporting on the health of the function, including mean time to detect, mean time to respond and coverage trends

  • Support compliance and governance: Make sure our security operations posture supports our regulatory and contractual obligations, acting as a key stakeholder in audits, assessments and customer security reviews, and working closely with Legal, Compliance and Privacy


What you’ll bring

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Experience managing and mentoring engineers and/or operations specialists

  • Expertise in incident response, with hands-on experience leading major incidents

  • Experience in threat intelligence and hunting, proactively seeking threats in complex, cloud-native environments

  • A good working understanding of adversarial techniques (MITRE ATT&CK and similar frameworks), and how you keep up to date

  • Genuine curiosity about the security risks introduced by AI systems, such as model abuse, prompt injection and data exfiltration

  • Familiarity with modern security operations tooling

  • Experience automating repeatable processes rather than relying on manual effort

You’ll also be:

  • An experienced leader with a track record of building and developing security operations teams across multiple geographies and time zones, who leads by example and creates clarity in ambiguous situations

  • Someone teams look to when things get difficult: composed, structured and decisive

  • Able to communicate risk clearly and confidently to audiences from engineers to executives

  • Able to show how you’ve built strong relationships across engineering, product and compliance

  • Able to set out a vision and strategy for how security operations will mature, and win buy-in from your team and stakeholders

  • Keen to drive compliance and NFR improvements that balance information security and commercial goals

  • Ready to challenge the status quo and find ways to make security more efficient and effective with AI

Skills (SFIA): We use the SFIA framework to assess and develop everyone in security roles. Levels run from 1 to 7.

Essential:

  • Level 5: Incident management, threat intelligence, vulnerability assessment, security operations, penetration testing, specialist advice

  • Level 4: Performance management

  • Level 3: Information security

Desirable: Vulnerability research (Level 5), information assurance (Level 5), emerging technology monitoring (Level 4), professional development (Level 4)


Our values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday [plus/including bank holidays], plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you. If you need any adjustments during the process, just let us know.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn, or read our Applicant Data Protection Policy.

A senior individual contributor role: you design, build, and operate production-grade AI systems - agents and assistants, shared frameworks, knowledge bases, and the integrations that connect them to company systems - and own solutions end-to-end, from understanding a function's workflow with its champions through deployment, measurement, and iteration.

You bring engineering rigour to a fast-moving space: the systems you ship must be reliable, observable, safe, and worth their cost.

You will also help raise the bar for AI-assisted engineering across Kpler and mentor less experienced engineers in the crew. To begin with, the emphasis will be on delivering Kpler's company-wide AI adoption plan; the scope is expected to broaden as internal AI usage matures.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate AI systems for internal functions — agents, assistants, and automations — owning them end-to-end from design through production operation.

  • Build the shared foundations of the crew's platform: frameworks, knowledge-base pipelines, evaluation tooling, and reusable integrations with company systems.

  • Work directly with functional champions to understand their workflows, identify high-leverage automation opportunities, and turn them into deployed solutions.

  • Implement security guardrails and responsible-AI practices in everything shipped: access control, data privacy, auditability, and human-in-the-loop where it matters.

  • Make systems measurable: instrument adoption, quality, cost, and time savings, and use the data to iterate.

  • Keep owned systems reliable, observable, and maintainable - including production incident response and RCA.

  • Contribute to the AI software factory for engineering: rules, skills, and agents that codify Kpler's engineering standards, and AI-assisted development practices across crews.

  • Provide clarity through documentation, proposals, and runbooks; share knowledge across the crew and company.

  • Mentor other engineers in the crew and contribute to hiring and onboarding.

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems end-to-end.

  • Hands-on experience shipping LLM-powered features, agents, or AI tooling to production (not just prototypes).

  • Strong integration experience: third-party SaaS APIs, internal services, data pipelines.

  • Solid grounding in system design, APIs, databases, and application architecture.

title: Senior Associate, GTM Marketing
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

As Senior Associate, GTM Marketing, you'll partner with product, S&O and other stakeholders to bring launches to market, owning full-funnel, multi-channel campaigns for specific product lines or business segments. You'll turn complex product capabilities into clear messaging, compelling content and go-to-market strategies, and use data to track performance, optimise user acquisition and measure ROI.

What you'll do

  • Coordinate launches: Partner with product, S&O and marketing, acting as the central point of coordination for campaign delivery. Your focus will be GTM activity in the marketing space.
  • Own delivery: Run campaign plans from briefing to launch, tracking milestones, dependencies and deadlines across multiple campaigns at once. Spot risks early and hold stakeholders accountable for their actions.
  • Communicate clearly: Turn plans into clear, actionable updates for commercial teams, and build and run merchant communication plans, including email campaigns, sign-up reminders and operational guidance.
  • Enable sales: Create high-quality sell-in materials such as Google Slides decks, email templates and campaign toolkits. Build landing pages on the Partner Website and make sure all assets are accurate, on-brand and hosted on Seismic ahead of launch.
  • Manage stakeholders: Build strong relationships across marketing, commercial and cross-functional teams. Influence them to involve GTM early, challenge timelines constructively and keep everyone aligned through regular check-ins.
  • Keep improving: Support post-launch evaluations and find ways to improve GTM content, processes and how marketing and commercial teams work together.

About you

Essential

  • Product marketing experience at a fast-paced company
  • Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation and influencing skills
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, able to tailor messaging for different audiences
  • Experience managing multiple cross-functional projects in parallel
  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail, and comfortable with ambiguity
  • A creative mindset with an eye for design and engaging content

Nice to have

  • Experience in GTM, commercial or marketing functions
  • Experience with merchant or partner communications
  • Experience building landing pages using a website content management system
  • Familiarity with Seismic or similar sales enablement platforms

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🧠 Build a career, not just a role Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

title: Senior Associate/Pricing & Market Access (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates is a leading global consulting firm that provides economic, financial, and business management expertise to major law firms, corporations and governments around the world. CRA advises clients on economic and financial matters pertaining to litigation and regulatory proceedings, and guides corporations through critical business strategy and performance-related issues. Since 1965, clients have engaged CRA for its combination of industry experience and rigorous, fact-based analysis that provides clients with clear, implementable solutions to complex business concerns. 

Position Overview

CRA’s Life Sciences practice helps pharmaceutical, biotechnology, diagnostics and medical device companies achieve optimum performance across key aspects of their business, including innovation, commercial success, organization, and reputation, all for the long-term benefit of patients, clinicians, employees, and shareholders. We work with life sciences businesses directly as well as with their legal counsel, industry associations, government organizations, and advocacy groups from the earliest stages of research into new therapy areas, through product development, to the delivery of products that will achieve commercial success and fulfill the expectations of our clients and their key stakeholders.

Senior Associates at CRA work on project teams with senior and junior consultants on a variety of client engagements across industries. Senior Associates conduct advanced strategic analysis and assist in the management of consulting projects. They serve as a project manager, direct the work of others, oversee analysis, manage mid-level client relationships, and/or communicate project results. Staff at this level are expected to work independently with minimal supervision.

To be successful in this role, you must be able to effectively plan and manage the execution of smaller projects or significant sub-tasks on larger, more complex projects, conceptualize and analyse issues, and perform or direct a wide variety of analytical tasks. We also highly value a strong work ethic, creativity, a positive attitude, and a high level of energy. At this time, we are specifically seeking consultants with strong knowledge of pricing and access systems in Europe and globally. Typical Senior Associate responsibilities include:

  • Independently identify/design analytic tasks and contribute to the development of overall analytic framework for consulting projects;
  • Interface with client representatives to communicate developments and present results;
  • Draft reports or presentations, or sections of reports or presentations;
  • Contribute to project planning and budget management efforts;
  • Provide training and technical supervision to less-experienced staff, including reviewing their analyses and providing coaching/direction;
  • Contribute to business development efforts and draft client proposals.

Desired Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in life sciences (e.g., biology, biotechnology, biochemistry, pharmacology, chemistry etc.) or a relevant analytical degree, with significant work experience;
  • 3-6 years previous consulting experience;
  • Strong skills in quantitative and qualitative analysis methods and techniques;
  • Proven staff and project management skills;
  • Client interaction, facilitation, presentation, budgeting, and project planning skills;
  • Strong knowledge of pricing and market access issues in the European markets (and globally);
  • Occasional travel required.

To Apply

To be considered for this position, we require the following:

  • Resume – please include current address, personal email and telephone number;
  • Cover letter – please describe your interest in CRA and how this role matches your goals.

Career Growth and Benefits 

  • CRA’s robust skills development programs, including a commitment to offering training annually through formal and informal programs, encouraging you to thrive as an individual and team member. Beginning with skill building, training continues with technical training, presentation skills, internal seminars, and career mentoring and performance coaching from an assigned senior colleague. Additional leadership and collaboration opportunities exist through internal firm development activities.
  • We offer a comprehensive total rewards program including a superior benefits package, wellness programming to support physical, mental, emotional and financial well-being, and in-house immigration support for foreign nationals and international business travelers.

Work Location Flexibility

CRA creates a work environment that enables our colleagues to benefit from being together in the office to best deliver on our promise of career growth, mentorship and inclusivity. At the same time, we recognise that individuals realise a range of benefits when working from home periodically. We currently expect that individuals spend at least 3 to 4 days a week working in the office (which may include traveling to another CRA office or to client meetings), with specific days determined in coordination with your practice or team.

Responsible AI Use in Recruiting

We believe that recruiting is fundamentally a human process, and we are committed to a hiring process that is consistent, transparent, and people-focused. While AI and other technology-enabled tools help our team operate more efficiently, we strive to provide every candidate with a personalized, thoughtful, and high-touch experience. As CRA invests significant human effort to find qualified members for our teams, we expect candidates to invest corresponding human effort to learn about CRA, prepare thoughtful application materials, and engage with our interviewers. Read more about appropriate hiring manager, recruiting team, and candidate AI at CRA on our website.  

Our Commitment to Equal Employment Opportunity

Charles River Associates is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

______________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Über Charles River Associates

Charles River Associates ist eine führende globale Beratungsfirma, die wirtschaftliche, finanzielle und betriebswirtschaftliche Expertise für große Anwaltskanzleien, Unternehmen und Regierungen weltweit bietet. CRA berät Kunden in wirtschaftlichen und finanziellen Angelegenheiten im Zusammenhang mit Rechtsstreitigkeiten und behördlichen Verfahren und unterstützt Unternehmen bei kritischen Geschäftsstrategien und leistungsbezogenen Fragen. Seit 1965 engagieren Kunden CRA aufgrund der Kombination aus Branchenerfahrung und rigoroser, faktenbasierter Analyse, die klare, umsetzbare Lösungen für komplexe Geschäftsprobleme bietet.

Stellenübersicht

Die Life Sciences Practice von CRA hilft Pharma-, Biotechnologie-, Medtech- und Digital-Health-Unternehmen, optimale Leistungen in wichtigen Geschäftsbereichen wie kommerzielle Strategie, Preisgestaltung und Zugang, Innovation, Organisationsstruktur, Politikanalyse, medizinische Angelegenheiten, Stakeholder-Management und Marketing zu erzielen – alles zum langfristigen Nutzen von Patienten, Ärzten, Mitarbeitern und Aktionären. Wir arbeiten direkt mit Life-Sciences-Unternehmen sowie mit deren Rechtsberatern, Industrieverbänden, Regierungsorganisationen und Interessengruppen zusammen.

Senior Associates bei CRA arbeiten gemeinsam mit erfahrenen und jüngeren Consultants in Projektteams an einer Vielzahl von Kundenprojekten in unterschiedlichen Branchen. Sie führen anspruchsvolle strategische Analysen durch und unterstützen bei der Steuerung von Beratungsprojekten. Dabei übernehmen sie die Projektleitung, koordinieren die Arbeit anderer Teammitglieder, verantworten Analysen, betreuen Kundenbeziehungen auf mittlerer Ebene und/oder kommunizieren Projektergebnisse. In dieser Position arbeiten Sie weitgehend selbstständig und eigenverantwortlich.

Für eine erfolgreiche Tätigkeit in dieser Position sollten Sie in der Lage sein, kleinere Projekte oder wesentliche Teilaufgaben größerer und komplexerer Projekte effektiv zu planen und zu steuern, Fragestellungen zu strukturieren und zu analysieren sowie ein breites Spektrum analytischer Aufgaben selbst durchzuführen oder anzuleiten. Darüber hinaus legen wir großen Wert auf eine ausgeprägte Arbeitsethik, Kreativität, eine positive Einstellung und ein hohes Maß an Engagement.

Aktuell suchen wir insbesondere Consultants mit fundierten Kenntnissen der Pricing- und Market-Access-Systeme in Europa und weltweit.

Aufgaben

  • Sie identifizieren und konzipieren eigenständig die erforderlichen Analysen und wirken an der Entwicklung des übergreifenden analytischen Ansatzes für Beratungsprojekte mit.
  • Sie stehen im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, informieren sie über den Projektfortschritt und präsentieren Ergebnisse.
  • Sie erstellen Berichte und Präsentationen oder übernehmen die Ausarbeitung einzelner Abschnitte.
  • Sie wirken bei der Projektplanung und der Steuerung von Projektbudgets mit.
  • Sie unterstützen weniger erfahrene Teammitglieder bei ihrer fachlichen Weiterentwicklung, prüfen deren Analysen und geben ihnen fachliche Anleitung und Feedback.
  • Sie bringen sich in die Geschäftsentwicklung ein und wirken bei der Erstellung von Angeboten für Kunden mit.

Gewünschte Qualifikationen

  • Bachelor- oder Masterabschluss im Bereich Life Sciences, z. B. in Biologie, Biotechnologie, Biochemie, Pharmakologie oder Chemie, oder in einem relevanten Studiengang mit analytischem Schwerpunkt sowie einschlägige Berufserfahrung
  • 3 bis 6 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Beratung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse und Erfahrung in der Anwendung quantitativer und qualitativer Analysemethoden
  • Nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Mitarbeiterführung und im Projektmanagement
  • Erfahrung im direkten Kundenkontakt, in der Moderation und Präsentation sowie in der Budget- und Projektplanung
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse zu Pricing und Market Access in europäischen und internationalen Märkten
  • Deutschkenntnisse von Vorteil
  • Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Bewerbung

Um für diese Position berücksichtigt zu werden, reichen Sie bitte die folgenden Unterlagen ein:

  • Lebenslauf – bitte geben Sie Ihre aktuelle Adresse, eprsönliche E-Mail-Adresse und Telefonnummer an;
  • Anschreiben – Bitte beschreiben Sie Ihr Interesse an CRA und wie diese Rolle zu Ihren Zielen passt.

Karriereentwicklung und Benefits

  • CRA bietet Ihnen vielfältige Möglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterentwicklung. Dazu gehören jährliche formelle und informelle Weiterbildungsangebote, die Ihre individuelle Entwicklung ebenso fördern wie Ihre Zusammenarbeit im Team. Das Angebot reicht von Trainings zur Weiterentwicklung Ihrer fachlichen und persönlichen Kompetenzen über Präsentationstrainings und interne Seminare bis hin zu individuellem Karriere-Mentoring und Performance-Coaching durch eine erfahrene Kollegin oder einen erfahrenen Kollegen. Darüber hinaus bieten interne Initiativen die Möglichkeit, zusätzliche Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen und sich aktiv in die Weiterentwicklung von CRA einzubringen.
  • Wir bieten Ihnen ein umfassendes Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket mit attraktiven Zusatzleistungen. Dazu gehören Angebote zur Förderung Ihres körperlichen, mentalen, emotionalen und finanziellen Wohlbefindens sowie interne Unterstützung bei Einwanderungs- und Visaangelegenheiten für internationale Mitarbeitende und Geschäftsreisende.

Flexibilität am Arbeitsplatz

CRA schafft ein Arbeitsumfeld, das es unseren Kollegen ermöglicht, von der Zusammenarbeit im Büro zu profitieren, um unser Versprechen von beruflichem Wachstum, Mentoring und Inklusivität bestmöglich zu erfüllen. Gleichzeitig erkennen wir an, dass Einzelpersonen eine Reihe von Vorteilen genießen, wenn sie periodisch von zu Hause aus arbeiten. Derzeit bitten wir Mitarbeiter, im Durchschnitt 3 bis 4 Tage die Woche im Büro zu arbeiten (was Reisen zu einem anderen CRA-Büro oder zum Standort eines Kunden einschließen kann). Zu bestimmten Zeiten des Jahres (z.B. Feiertagsperioden) werden zusätzliche Remote-Arbeitsoptionen für diejenigen angeboten, deren Arbeitsverpflichtungen dies zulassen, obwohl unsere Büros für diejenigen, die dort sein möchten oder müssen, geöffnet bleiben.

Verantwortungsvoller Einsatz von KI im Recruiting

Bei CRA verstehen wir Recruiting als eine Tätigkeit, bei der Menschen eine zentrale Rolle spielen. KI und andere digitale Tools unterstützen uns zwar dabei, effizienter zu arbeiten, ersetzen jedoch nicht den persönlichen Austausch mit unseren Bewerberinnen und Bewerbern. Entsprechend erwarten wir auch von Kandidatinnen und Kandidaten, dass sie sich persönlich mit CRA und ihrer Bewerbung auseinandersetzen und sich auf die Gespräche mit uns vorbereiten. Weitere Informationen zum angemessenen Einsatz von KI im Recruiting bei CRA finden Sie auf unserer Website.

Unser Engagement für Vielfalt

Charles River Associates ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit bietet. Im Rahmen unseres Fokus auf Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion arbeiten wir daran, einen fairen und konsistenten Einstellungsprozess sicherzustellen. Wir feiern Vielfalt und sind für ein inklusives Arbeitsumfeld engagiert.

Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

descriptionHtml:

You want to work at the frontier of high‑performance autonomous systems.

Join us at CDDS to bring high-speed kinetic interceptor drones into the hands of armed forces, law-enforcement agencies, and critical-infrastructure operators.

CDDS specializes in developing low-collateral kinetic interceptors designed to neutralize malicious drones (Mavics, FPV racers and fast fixed wings). Our solutions are built for precision and safety, minimizing risk to surroundings while effectively countering unauthorized or threatening unmanned aerial systems. We work at the cutting edge of counter-drone technology, delivering reliable protection for critical assets and environments.

Your Mission

You will develop our presence across the Bundeswehr and wider national-security ecosystem, shape growth priorities with leadership, and turn operational needs into funded opportunities, trials, procurement programmes, and contracts. What You Bring

  • 3+ years of experience in defence business development, capture management, public-sector sales, government acquisition, or military procurement.

title: Senior Business Development Manager (m/w/d) Automotive & Industrie
descriptionHtml:
Senior Business Development Manager (m/w/d) – Automotive & Industrie | Deutschland & China

QMH Consulting GmbH · Norderstedt / Remote · Vollzeit · ab sofort

Über uns

QMH Consulting unterstützt seit über zehn Jahren OEMs, Tier-1- und Tier-2-Zulieferer sowie technologieorientierte Industrieunternehmen bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Qualitätsorganisationen, Produktionsprozesse und internationalen Lieferketten.

Unsere Schwerpunkte liegen in den Bereichen Qualitätsmanagement, Lieferantenentwicklung, Audits, Operational Excellence, FMEA, Trainings und der operativen Lösung komplexer Qualitätsprobleme.

Mit unseren Teams in Deutschland und China verbinden wir technische Beratungskompetenz mit internationaler Umsetzungserfahrung. Wir begleiten europäische Unternehmen bei ihren Lieferanten und Produktionsstandorten in China und unterstützen chinesische Hersteller dabei, die Anforderungen europäischer OEMs zu erfüllen.

Mit ASRAD, unserer eigenen Methodik für risikobasierte System- und Prozess-Assessments, bieten wir zudem einen eigenständigen Ansatz zur Bewertung und Weiterentwicklung industrieller Qualitätsprozesse.

Für den gezielten Ausbau unseres Geschäfts suchen wir einen erfahrenen Senior Business Development Manager (m/w/d), der bestehende Kundenbeziehungen strategisch weiterentwickelt, neue Geschäftspotenziale erschließt und anspruchsvolle Beratungs- und Dienstleistungsprojekte erfolgreich gewinnt.

Deine Aufgaben

Du übernimmst Verantwortung für die strategische Geschäftsentwicklung und den Vertrieb unserer technischen Beratungs- und Dienstleistungen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf OEMs, Tier-1-/Tier-2-Zulieferern sowie Industrieunternehmen in Deutschland – insbesondere mit internationalen Lieferketten und Geschäftsbeziehungen nach China.

Dabei kombinierst du die Betreuung strategischer Bestandskunden mit einer aktiven, systematischen Neukundengewinnung.

  • Strategische Neukundenakquise: Du identifizierst und gewinnst neue Kunden aus Automotive, Maschinenbau, Elektronik, Medizintechnik, weiteren technologieorientierten Industrien und der Verteidigungsindustrie.

  • Key Account Management: Du betreust und entwickelst unsere wesentlichen Bestandskunden, erkennst neue Bedarfe und baust langfristige Kundenpartnerschaften auf.

  • Business Development: Du entwickelst neue Zielbranchen und Kundenpotenziale, insbesondere bei OEMs, Zulieferern und mittelständischen Industrieunternehmen mit 500 bis 5.000 Mitarbeitenden.

  • China-Europe Business: Du identifizierst Geschäftsmöglichkeiten bei Unternehmen mit Produktionsstandorten, Lieferanten oder Geschäftsbeziehungen in China und positionierst QMH als internationalen Beratungspartner.

  • Netzwerkaufbau: Du nutzt dein bestehendes Netzwerk auf Entscheiderebene und baust gezielt Kontakte zu Qualitätsleitung, Werksleitung, Einkauf, Lieferantenentwicklung und Geschäftsführung aus.

  • Vertriebsprozess & Abschluss: Du führst Kundengespräche, qualifizierst Projektbedarfe, entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Senior-Beratern passende Lösungen und steuerst Verhandlungen bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.

  • Angebots- und Projektmanagement: Du koordinierst die Entwicklung von Angeboten für Assessments, Beratungsprojekte, Lieferantenentwicklung, Trainings und Rahmenverträge und stellst eine strukturierte Übergabe an unsere Projektteams sicher.

  • CRM & Pipeline Management: Du entwickelst einen systematischen Business-Development-Prozess in HubSpot mit definierten Zielkunden, Ansprechpartnern, Vertriebsaktivitäten, Pipeline und Forecast.

  • Marktbearbeitung: Du verbindest moderne Vertriebsinstrumente wie CRM, Social Selling und datenbasierte Kundenansprache mit persönlichen Kundenbesuchen, Messen und Fachveranstaltungen.

  • Strategische Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit der Geschäftsführung, unserem Vertriebsinnendienst, Marketing und unseren Consulting-Teams in Deutschland und China zusammen.

Du verantwortest die Entwicklung deiner Kunden und Vertriebschancen eigenständig und leistest einen direkten Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Wachstum von QMH.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens fünf Jahre erfolgreiche Erfahrung im B2B-Lösungsvertrieb, idealerweise im Automotive-Umfeld, in der Zulieferindustrie oder im Vertrieb technischer Beratungs-, Engineering- und Qualitätsdienstleistungen

  • Nachweisbare Vertriebserfolge in der eigenständigen Neukundengewinnung, Kundenentwicklung und im Abschluss erklärungsbedürftiger Dienstleistungen

  • Erfahrung mit Projektvolumina zwischen 30.000 und 500.000 € sowie die Fähigkeit, bisherige Vertriebserfolge anhand konkreter Kennzahlen zu erläutern

  • Ein bestehendes Netzwerk oder belastbare Zugänge zu Entscheidern bei OEMs, Tier-1-/Tier-2-Zulieferern, Industrieunternehmen oder Unternehmen der Verteidigungsindustrie

  • Fundiertes Verständnis industrieller Qualitätsprozesse und idealerweise Kenntnisse in VDA 6.3, IATF 16949, APQP/PPAP, FMEA oder Lieferantenmanagement

  • Erfahrung mit internationalen Lieferketten oder Geschäftsbeziehungen nach China bzw. Asien sowie interkulturelles Verständnis

  • Ausgeprägte Hunter-Mentalität, Eigeninitiative, Verhandlungsgeschick und Abschlussstärke

  • Erfahrung im strategischen Key Account Management und in der Entwicklung langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit HubSpot oder vergleichbaren CRM-Systemen sowie Erfahrung mit Social Selling und datenbasierter Kundenansprache

  • Unternehmerisches Denken, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, Vertriebsaktivitäten eigenständig zu priorisieren

  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse; Chinesischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil

  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands von ca. 40–50 %, gelegentliche Reisen nach China sowie Führerschein Klasse B

Du erfüllst nicht jeden einzelnen Punkt? Wir freuen uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung, wenn du relevante Vertriebserfahrung, ein gutes Industrienetzwerk und die Motivation mitbringst, unser Geschäft aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.

Was dich bei QMH erwartet

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein Jahresgehalt zwischen 55.000 und 75.000 € brutto sowie eine leistungsabhängige Provision ohne Deckelung

  • Firmenwagen: Ein Dienstwagen, auch zur privaten Nutzung

  • Flexible Arbeitsgestaltung: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, mobiles Arbeiten und eine vollständige Home-Office-Ausstattung

  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel: Firmenlaptop und Firmenhandy

  • Mobilität: Vergünstigungen für öffentliche Verkehrsmittel sowie kostenlose Parkmöglichkeiten am Standort

  • Persönliche Entwicklung: Individuelle Weiterbildungen, fachliche Qualifizierungen und Mentoring

  • Direkte Verantwortung: Eigenständige Gestaltung deines Vertriebsgebiets mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung

  • Starke Unterstützung: Fachliche Rückendeckung durch erfahrene Senior-Berater sowie organisatorische Unterstützung durch unseren Vertriebsinnendienst

  • Internationale Perspektive: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Team in China und die Möglichkeit, internationale Kundenbeziehungen aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Attraktives Leistungsportfolio: Anspruchsvolle Beratungs- und Ingenieurdienstleistungen, eigene Methoden und Referenzen bei namhaften Industriekunden

  • Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, kollegiale Zusammenarbeit und regelmäßige Teamevents

  • Erholung und Sicherheit: Bezahlte Krankheitstage und zusätzliche Urlaubsleistungen gemäß unseren betrieblichen Regelungen

Deine ersten Monate bei QMH

In deinen ersten Wochen lernst du unser Leistungsportfolio, unsere Kundenstrukturen und unsere internen Vertriebsprozesse kennen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit der Geschäftsführung, dem Vertriebsinnendienst und unseren erfahrenen Senior-Beratern zusammen.

Du analysierst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen, übernimmst erste strategische Accounts und identifizierst neue Geschäftspotenziale in deinen Zielbranchen.

Parallel entwickelst du deine Vertriebspipeline in HubSpot, aktivierst dein bestehendes Netzwerk und führst erste Kundengespräche sowie konkrete Projekt- und Angebotsverhandlungen.

Unser gemeinsames Ziel ist, dass du eigenständig Kundenbeziehungen entwickelst, neue Projekte gewinnst und den Ausbau unseres Geschäfts in Deutschland und an der Schnittstelle zu China aktiv vorantreibst.

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Du möchtest nicht nur bestehende Vertriebsprozesse verwalten, sondern neue Märkte erschließen, strategische Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und messbare Geschäftserfolge erzielen?

Du verfügst über ein starkes Netzwerk in der Industrie, verstehst komplexe technische Dienstleistungen und weißt, wie man aus Kundenbedarfen langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen entwickelt?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Gestalte mit uns die Zukunft von QMH Consulting – in Deutschland, China und darüber hinaus.

title: Senior Cloud Architect
descriptionHtml:
At Ripple, we’re building a world where value moves like information does today. It’s big, it’s bold, and we’re already doing it. Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

Are you interested in pioneering and breaking new ground in large-scale financial data processing? Then this role might be for you. Join the Ripple Treasury Reconciliation team where you’ll be solving complex problems and having fun while passionately discussing (and arguing) with your team members!

About the Reconciliation team

Ripple Treasury Reconciliation platform sits at the heart of how the world's largest financial institutions and enterprises close their books and bring more control to their financial processes. Our vision is to create a completely new user experience with financial tools that have no equals on the market. With users first in mind and driven by technology.

As part of Ripple, we're backed by the scale and ambition of a company reshaping global finance, giving our team the resources to modernize the mission-critical product while still moving with the speed and ownership of a smaller engineering group. If you want your code to directly touch how billions of transactions get reconciled every day, this is that kind of role. 

What we are looking for

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Architect to own the infrastructure of our growing Reconciliation platform.You'll set the direction, architecture and design for our platform, focusing on performance, stability, security and how to integrate newer technologies. You will also be setting the technical direction and standards for our team while working alongside senior infrastructure engineers who own day-to-day execution and operational work.

This is a hands-on architecture role, not a pure strategy or management position. You'll write core foundational code and build reference implementations, but the bulk of routine implementation work belongs to the team. Your value is in judgment: knowing where to invest based on business direction, designing for scalability and lower long-term maintenance burden, and raising the technical ceiling of the team.

What you'll do:

  • Set and own infrastructure architecture direction. Drive architecture, scalability, and performance decisions across the platform. 
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to senior infrastructure engineers by reviewing designs, unblocking hard problems, and playing a key role in deepening the team's expertise.
  • Establish infrastructure standards and patterns for the team to create a high benchline for quality, performance and maintenance of the system.
  • Stay hands-on: prototype, build critical-path components, and get into the code where it matters while routine implementation and day-to-day operational work is owned by the senior engineers.
  • Make and be accountable for infrastructure tradeoff decisions with long-term cost, scalability, or maintainability implications.

What you'll bring:

  • BS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and owning large-scale distributed infrastructure, including a track record of owning architecture decisions yourself, with 3+ years serving as a technical lead and mentoring engineers.
  • Deep expertise with AWS & Kubernetes. Minimum 3+ years experience with each.
  • Expertise in Linux and Windows server environments, with strong experience building and maintaining cloud infrastructure on AWS and Azure.
  • Proficiency with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform and ArgoCD, and scripting languages including Bash and Python.
  • Experience with data infrastructure and processing technologies such as Spark and MSSQL. Experience building the systems that power high-volume transactional workloads, ideally in finance space. Cybersecurity experience is a plus.
  • A track record of building infrastructure that scales, stays available, and remains secure, using Agile practices to ship reliably.

About you:

  • You work openly and collaboratively with diverse teams, and you're energized by driving engineering excellence through better standards, processes, and shared knowledge.
  • You welcome constructive feedback, actively inviting debate and rigorous discussion around your architectural ideas to deliver optimal outcomes.

This role is architecture-led, not implementation-led — we're looking for someone who has owned and been accountable for infrastructure design decisions, not someone whose primary experience is executing infrastructure designed by others. This is also a technical leadership role, not a people-management position. 

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

  • The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders
  • A learning environment where you can dive deep into the latest technologies and make an impact.  A professional development budget to support other modes of learning.
  • Thrive in an environment where no matter what race, ethnicity, gender, origin, or culture they identify with, every employee is a respected, valued, and empowered part of the team.
  • In-office collaboration for moments that matter is important to our culture, and we give managers and teams the flexibility to decide which 10+ days a month they come in. 
  • Bi-weekly all-company meeting - business updates and ask me anything style discussion with our Leadership Team
  • We come together for moments that matter which include team offsites, team bonding activities, happy hours and more!

Take Control of Your Finances

  • Competitive salary, bonuses, and equity
  • Competitive benefits that cover physical and mental healthcare, retirement, family forming, and family support
  • Employee giving match
  • Mobile phone stipend

Take Care of Yourself

  • R&R days so you can rest and recharge
  • Generous wellness reimbursement and weekly onsite & virtual programming
  • Generous vacation policy - work with your manager to take time off when you need it
  • Industry-leading parental leave policies. Family planning benefits.
  • Catered lunches, fully-stocked kitchens with premium snacks/beverages, and plenty of fun events

title: Senior Data Scientist
descriptionHtml:

  • Comfort working with blockchain data, or strong evidence of the aptitude to ramp up quickly on blockchain data structures and protocols.

  • A demonstrated ability to take ownership of projects: decomposing requirements, driving them to completion, and proactively seeking clarity from stakeholders.

  • An analytical, open-minded approach to problem solving – comfortable navigating ambiguity and willing to dive into problems outside your day-to-day scope.

Python

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • 5+ years of professional experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or Platform Engineering, with a proven track record of designing and scaling highly available production environments
  • Strong hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, including upgrades, networking and troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of cloud infrastructure (AWS) combined with experience operating bare-metal or self-hosted environments

Proven experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible) and modern container build or GitOps workflowsStrong problem-solving skills and the ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between reliability, scalability, and maintainabilityExperience collaborating across engineering and product teams to deliver secure and robust infrastructure solutionsDeep understanding of Linux operating systems and strong programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) focused on automation and tooling.

Nice to have – and what would make you exceptional:

  • Experience operating GPU workloads on Kubernetes or Machine Learning infrastructure
  • Familiarity with specialized Kubernetes ecosystem tools such as FluxCD, Rancher, or RKE2.
  • Experience working with large-scale video/streaming workflows or AWS media services
  • Experience managing and scaling messaging or event-streaming systems (e.g., Kafka)
  • Experience operating and optimizing relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL)
  • Experience building internal developer platforms or self-service tooling for engineering teams

WHAT YOUR SUCCESS WILL LOOK LIKE

  • In 6 months time… You know our clusters and pipelines, handle incidents and upgrades on your own, and have shipped your first improvements to reliability, automation or security. You contribute confidently to architecture discussions.
  • In 12 months time… You own major parts of the platform, have delivered measurable improvements (faster deployments, better observability, stronger security), and help shape the roadmap of our hybrid cloud.

WHY CATAPULT?

  • We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life.
  • We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary.
  • We work in a collaborative yet challenging environment to consistently improve our performance, which in turn impacts our customers' performance.
  • Our workforce spans more than 20 countries. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness.
  • We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.

Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!

Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.

All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.

title: Senior Director of Collector Relations, Europe
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

About the Team

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

Role Summary

The Senior Director of Collector Relations for Europe will fill a newly created role, reporting to the Global Head of Collector Relations at Fanatics Collectibles. This is a highly influential, relationship-driven position responsible for cultivating and managing relationships with high-net-worth collectors, strategic partners, and organizations across the European region. The role requires a deep understanding of European market dynamics and a passion for providing bespoke experiences to collectors. The successful candidate will lead the development of regional strategies and teams to drive engagement and loyalty among the most valuable customers in the collectibles industry. This is a full time role, in the designated office 5 days per week. 

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain authentic, trusted relationships with high-end collectors and regional partners throughout Europe.
  • Encourage participation from high-net-worth individuals in the European collectibles ecosystem while implementing loyalty initiatives that enhance engagement.
  • Establish and manage a regional team dedicated to delivering concierge-level service and curated experiences for collectors.
  • Partner with sports leagues, teams, and organizations across European markets to create exclusive, once-in-a-lifetime experiences.
  • Monitor market trends to identify and onboard new high-value clients across the region.
  • Contribute to the development and regional execution of customer loyalty programs to elevate the overall collector experience.

Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree or relevant certifications are a plus.
  • Proven track record of managing relationships with high-net-worth individuals in Europe.
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to connect authentically with diverse collector personas across multiple European cultures and languages.
  • Experience developing and managing consumer loyalty or VIP programs is highly desirable.
  • Deep interest in sports and European sports culture (e.g., football, Formula 1, rugby, cricket), with the ability to activate relevant partnerships.
  • Familiarity with sports cards and collectibles is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and grow relationships with influential, high-profile clients.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and leadership skills, with a collaborative and culturally aware approach.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Strong communication, influencing, and presentation skills to effectively engage with internal and external stakeholders across diverse European markets.

The above list of job duties is not exclusive or exhaustive and the post holder will be required to undertake such tasks as may reasonably be expected within the scope and grading of the post. 

Subject to applicable laws, Fanatics Collectibles may choose to run a background check.

By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy.

title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:

In this position, you will be responsible for low-level and high-level software in CesiumAstro’s products through all phases of the development process. As a CesiumAstro software team member, you will be responsible for software designs from concept through production, including product roadmaps, block diagrams, detailed design and coding, analysis, test, qualification, and in-orbit support. The ideal candidate will have development experience at nearly every level of the software stack, including microcontrollers, low-level drivers, board support packages (BSP), end-use applications, and user interfaces. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience in software testing and high-reliability qualification, as well as software engineering and software project management practices.

The successful candidate will present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.


SUMMARY OF RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Design and implement software for embedded devices and systems, from requirements to production and commercial deployment
  • Design, develop, code, test, debug and document system software
  • Review code and system designs
  • Analyze code for efficiency, stability and scalability
  • Integrate and validate new product designs
  • Support software quality assurance and optimize I/O performance
  • Provide post-production/in-orbit customer support
  • Interface with hardware design and development engineers
  • Assess third party and open-source software

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering
  • Minimum of 5 years of industry experience in software development.
  • Experience in hands-on development and troubleshooting of embedded hardware. API design for interfacing with FPGAs.
  • Experience with products for aerospace applications
  • Programming experience in C or C++
  • Experience in embedded systems design with preemptive, multitasking real-time operating systems (experience with real-time Linux is desirable)
  • Familiarity with software configuration management tools, defect tracking tools, and peer review
  • Excellent knowledge of real-time system coding techniques, IP protocols, interfaces, and hardware subsystems
  • Excellent understanding of multi-threaded applications and resource management
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Adequate knowledge of reading electronics schematics and component data sheets
  • Experience with ARM processors and fully-featured microcontrollers
  • Experience in design and development of a Software Development Kit (SDK)

    • WHAT WE OFFER
  • The opportunity to help establish CesiumAstro’s European office and grow our Munich team.
  • High-impact role with direct exposure to leading EU space programs.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A collaborative, innovative environment shaping the future of space communications.
