title: Senior Engineer I, Total Product Support
descriptionHtml:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.  

Job’s mission

As a Senior Engineer, Total Product Support at ASM, you will take ownership of highly visible technical projects and drive them from planning through execution and delivery. Acting as the central point connecting engineering teams, operations, and customers, you will ensure that technical solutions are developed, tested, implemented, and supported successfully.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong engineering foundation who enjoys bringing people together, solving problems, and turning technical requirements into clear actions. You do not need to be the subject matter expert in every technical area, but you should be comfortable working with engineers, understanding complex technical concepts, asking the right questions, and keeping projects moving forward.

What you will be working on

  • Lead and coordinate technical projects from initial planning through execution, customer delivery, and program close-out.
  • Develop execution plans, define priorities, coordinate resources, and ensure key project milestones and deliverables are achieved.
  • Act as the central point of coordination between engineering teams, technical specialists, operations, management, and customers.
  • Drive the build and qualification phase of technical solutions, including coordinating in-house testing, additional test equipment, technical evaluations, and readiness for customer implementation.
  • Work closely with engineers to understand technical challenges, determine where additional expertise or consultation is required, and drive issues toward resolution.
  • Coordinate directly with customers to understand requirements, provide transparent project updates, and support successful technical implementation.
  • Monitor project progress, identify risks and roadblocks early, and communicate openly when plans, deliverables, or timelines are at risk.
  • Analyze project and test outcomes, coordinate follow-up activities, and ensure programs are properly completed and transitioned into customer support.
  • Steer operational activities across multiple stakeholders while maintaining accountability for overall project execution.
  • Provide clear and concise reporting on high-visibility projects to stakeholders and management.

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Materials Science, or another relevant technical discipline.
  • A solid engineering foundation and the ability to understand and communicate technical concepts across different engineering disciplines.
  • Strong project coordination skills with the ability to plan, organize, and drive activities from start to finish.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the confidence to work with engineers, managers, and customers.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a proactive and hands-on approach to solving problems.
  • Ability to identify risks, communicate challenges transparently, and escalate issues when necessary rather than waiting for problems to resolve themselves.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, processes, and technical environments.
  • High energy, adaptability, and a strong “can-do” mentality.
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

What sets you apart

  • Experience working in semiconductor equipment, high-tech manufacturing, mechanical/electrical systems, or another complex engineering environment (not required).
  • Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams and translating between technical specialists, operations, management, and customers.
  • Relevant professional, internship, research, or project experience demonstrating the ability to coordinate technical work and drive execution is an advantage.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the confidence to challenge assumptions, raise concerns, and create alignment across different stakeholders.
  • A structured approach to project execution combined with the flexibility to adapt when technical priorities change.
  • Comfortable taking accountability for highly visible projects where clear and timely communication is essential.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally, typically 1–2 times per year, depending on project and customer needs.

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

title: Senior Finance & Strategy Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation, and growth drives everything we do. Our Finance team shapes the company's future by directing capital to high-impact investments, developing robust financial strategies, and ensuring we deliver long-term value while pursuing our ambitious mission. If you thrive in fast-paced environments and want to model the future of a global tech brand—this is the team for you.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager to join our Finance & Strategy team. In this role, you’ll play an integral part in building our business strategy, ensuring we make the most efficient investment and capital allocation decisions to accelerate our global growth.

Get to know our Finance team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

Here’s what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Strategic Decision Support: Partner with stakeholders across the business to develop new investment decision-making frameworks and drive strategy in a dynamic environment.

  • Growth vs. Profitability: Own complex models and analyses to help the business strike the optimal balance between aggressive growth and long-term profitability.

  • Custom Financial Modelling: Lead high-impact modelling exercises to support key initiatives, sizing new opportunities and building business cases for innovative products.

  • KPI Analysis: Track and analyse key financial and business KPIs to uncover trends, assessing current and future risks while identifying new market opportunities.

  • Process Innovation: Lead special projects to automate and scale our forecasting and reporting tools, ensuring our methodologies evolve alongside the business.

  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with operators and departmental leaders to develop new policies and ensure day-to-day execution aligns with our financial targets.

What You’ll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Finance Leadership: Significant experience (typically 8+ years) in strategic finance, corporate finance, or investment banking, ideally within a high-growth tech environment.

  • Team Development: Proven track record of managing and mentoring teams; you are passionate about building a high-performing "gold standard" finance function.

  • Influencing Power: The ability to earn the trust of senior leaders and influence strategic thinking across a matrixed organisation.

  • Technical Mastery: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills with the ability to build robust, complex financial models that distill data into digestible insights.

  • Budget Ownership: Experience owning forecasts and budgets for major functional areas, working directly with operators to hit performance targets.

  • Data Agility: Proficiency in SQL (or a strong willingness to learn) to manipulate large datasets and uncover hidden business insights.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!

Still, we’re optimistic about the power of millions of scientists working together to tackle them. We provide scientists with the help and support they need by connecting them to the world’s most active scientific community.

We've built a platform that gives the world's scientists the tools and services they need to connect, collaborate, and advance their research. Over 25 million members from 193 countries use ResearchGate to share, discover, and discuss research.


Objective of the role

We're looking for an enthusiastic frontend engineer with the skills and ability to turn great ideas into reality. You should have an in-depth understanding of current web technologies and front-end development, and be passionate about creating a great user experience. Your input will help us grow and maintain our React front-end.

Join a team that encourages you to explore, learn, and go beyond, while seeing your work lead to actionable results. Put your creative problem-solving and development skills into action and make a positive impact on science and society. This is a full-time position based in Germany.

At present, our team is working on making ResearchGate a great platform for publishers to connect with existing and future authors.

Your immediate colleagues will consist of JavaScript and PHP engineers, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, a UX Designer, and a UX Writer. Our team places great value on our collaborative and communicative work culture and we eagerly anticipate integrating a new Engineer into this environment.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Senior Frontend Engineer

Remote (UK-based) | Full-Time

About Us

Reactive Markets is the 2026 OTC Trading Platform of the Year (Risk.net). Our network handles over $75 billion in daily trading volumes across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency, connecting 60+ of the world's leading liquidity providers.

We build trading systems that operate at the edge of what's technically possible — where nanoseconds matter and a dropped message costs real money. Our engineering team is small, senior, and deeply invested in the craft of building cutting edge, reliable, high-performance systems.

The Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack engineer to build the trading platform our clients use every day. Despite the "frontend" name, this is not a UI-only role — our Frontend team works across the whole application stack in TypeScript and Rust, from the trader-facing interfaces down to the services behind them. It's distinct from our Backend team, who own the low-latency C++/Go trading engine.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who takes on the hardest problems and delivers them under their own steam. You'll own complex, ambiguous, performance-critical work end-to-end — designed, built, tested, deployed, and supported in production. You lead through code, craft, and mentoring, setting the technical example the rest of the team calibrates to. This is not a role where you write code and throw it over a wall: our engineers own the full lifecycle, and when something breaks, you're part of the team that investigates and fixes it.

Occasional hours outside the normal working day are required for production releases, scheduled maintenance windows, and Level 3 support during critical incidents. We keep this to a minimum and recognise the commitment — but owning a production trading platform means being there when it matters.

What You'll Work On

  • Complex full-stack features in TypeScript and Rust — from trader-facing interfaces to the application services behind them

  • Real-time market-data presentation and high-throughput, low-latency application code across FX, Equities, and Cryptocurrency

  • React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar) for demanding, data-dense trading interfaces

  • Distributed systems and real-time data over REST, WebSockets, and network protocols

  • Architecture and solution design for the hardest technical problems the team faces

  • Observability and monitoring — dashboards, alerting, and metrics that make frontend behaviour visible

  • Production systems that handle real money — reliability is not optional

What We Need

Technical:

  • Strong full-stack engineering ability with deep TypeScript / JavaScript (ES6+) (5+ years)

  • Solid experience with React and reactive state management (RX, MobX, or similar)

  • Working knowledge of Rust, or the clear appetite and ability to get there — it's part of our stack

  • Strong grasp of distributed systems, API design, and real-time data (REST, WebSockets, network protocols such as TCP/UDP and binary protocols)

  • Comfortable reasoning about architecture and making defensible technical trade-offs

  • Python for scripting, automation, and tooling is a bonus

  • Git and Linux fundamentals

  • Experience in financial services or trading technology is a plus but not essential

How you work:

  • You ship. You're delivery-focused — you iterate, you improve, you get things into production

  • You run with things. Give you an ambiguous, complex problem and you drive it to done without being managed through it. Senior here means trusted, not just experienced

  • You have range. You're not just strong in the familiar parts of the stack — you pick up the unfamiliar and hold your own on the hardest work

  • You own it. When you build something, you take responsibility for its behaviour in production. You respond to incidents (15-minute acknowledgement SLA during working hours), investigate issues, and close the loop

  • You raise the bar. You review peers' work thoughtfully, mentor the engineers around you through the craft, and set a standard others calibrate to

  • You write things down. Documentation is not an afterthought — it's how we scale knowledge across a distributed team. If it's not written down, it doesn't exist

  • You communicate. We're a distributed team across multiple time zones. Clear, proactive communication — especially when things go wrong — is essential

  • You embrace AI tooling. We use AI tools (Claude, Gemini) to amplify our engineering capability — from code review and debugging to incident investigation and documentation. You don't need to be an expert, but you should be curious and willing to learn

What You Get

  • Real problems —trading systems where performance is measured in microseconds, not user clicks

  • An excellent team — senior engineers who care about craft, collaborate openly, and hold each other to high standards

  • Ownership — small teams, clear accountability, direct impact on the platform and our clients

  • Competitive package — up to 30 days leave + bank holidays, private health insurance, pension, life insurance, dental/optical cashback, cycle to work, socials and offsites

  • Remote-friendly — work from home with flexibility. We trust our people to deliver

  • Sustainable pace — we work hard, but we don't burn people out. Balance is how we stay sharp

  • Growth — career progression to senior roles, performance specialisation, or technical leadership. We invest in people who invest in us

We believe in transparency, honest feedback, and writing things down. We celebrate delivery, not activity. We frame AI as empowering people — removing toil, amplifying capability, enabling higher-value work.

We aim to build systems that don't depend on the heroics of individuals to maintain and support — systems and processes that are resilient, documented, and sustainable.

Our Hiring Process

We keep our process focused and respectful of your time. Our process follows three stages.

Stage 1: Initial Conversation with Talent Acquisition
Format: Video call, ~30-45 minutes

Stage 2: Hiring Manager Conversation with the relevant team lead or hiring manager
Format: Video call, ~60 minutes

Stage 3: Technical Interview with two members of the relevant engineering team
Format: Video call, interactive session, ~60 minutes

What to expect in each stage will be explained by Talent Acquisition if you're invited to interview. Throughout the process, we aim to keep momentum with no unnecessary delays between stages, and feedback typically comes within a few business days.

*Please note that depending on availability, Stage 2 and 3 may swap around.

How to Apply

Please apply directly via this job posting — all applications, including those submitted via LinkedIn, are managed through our applicant tracking system, so you'll always land in the same place regardless of where you found this role.

 

Right to Work: Candidates must have the existing right to work in the UK. We are not currently able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Equal Opportunities: Reactive Markets is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Reasonable Adjustments: If you need any adjustments or support during the application or interview process, please let us know — we're happy to accommodate.

Data Protection: By applying, you consent to Reactive Markets processing your personal data for recruitment purposes, in line with our privacy policy.

title: Senior Infrastructure Engineer – Azure, Active Directory & Hybrid Infrastructure (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Salary: €60,000–80,000 gross per year, depending on experience | Permanent | Immediate start | Remote within Germany or Switzerland (proximity to our Bexbach site is a plus)

You want full ownership of a group's Azure and hybrid environment: not just tickets, but the architecture, the governance, and the direction it takes? Then help shape the infrastructure behind an international niche world leader in Omega-3 technology.

Why join us?

  • 🎯 Real ownership: You shape our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, drive technical decisions and take responsibility for its future development.

  • 🌍 Remote-first: Work remotely from Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site and other group locations.

  • 🤝 International collaboration: Join a small, hands-on Group IT team working closely with security, application teams and IT colleagues across our global sites.

  • 🚀 Meaningful transformation: Play a key role in consolidating acquired IT environments and building a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.

  • 📚 Growth opportunities: Benefit from individual career and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.

About us – in brief

Headquartered in Bexbach, Germany, KD Pharma Group is a mid-sized, internationally active company and one of the world's few manufacturers of Omega-3 concentrates with a purity of up to 99.5%.

Our expertise is built on a dedicated focus on Omega-3 fatty acid research, advanced purification technologies and manufacturing. With facilities and operations across Europe, the Americas and Asia-Pacific, we serve customers worldwide.

Following a period of international growth through acquisitions, our focus is now on integrating and modernizing our IT environments to create a consistent, secure and scalable global infrastructure.

Your Role – What You'll Own

You will take hands-on ownership of our Azure and hybrid infrastructure, helping us move from independently managed site environments towards a standardized and centrally governed global IT platform.

Working closely with the Group Director of IT, our security function, application development team and local IT colleagues, you will combine technical architecture with practical implementation.

Your Responsibilities

  • Infrastructure rationalisation: Simplify our distributed server estate, both on-premises and in Azure. Retire or replace unsupported systems, consolidate infrastructure and reduce technical debt across our sites.

  • Active Directory & identity: Drive the consolidation and modernization of our Active Directory environments. Manage hybrid identity across Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID, including directory synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.

  • Azure platform: Design, operate and continuously improve our Azure and hybrid environment, covering compute, networking, storage and core infrastructure services. Provide the application development team with the environments they need.

  • Device management: Manage devices and applications across the group through Microsoft Intune, establishing consistent configuration, enrollment and security policies across all sites.

  • Application delivery: Evaluate and implement the right delivery method for each application, starting with reducing our reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.

  • Governance and cost management: Establish clear Azure standards, policies and resource tagging. Ensure transparency of cloud spending and continuously optimize infrastructure costs.

  • Resilience and monitoring: Ensure backup, disaster recovery and monitoring solutions are reliable, regularly tested and provide early warning of potential issues.

  • Security partnership: Work closely with our security function to strengthen infrastructure security, implement appropriate controls, maintain patch compliance and resolve identified vulnerabilities.

  • Infrastructure modernization: Review our existing infrastructure and determine which workloads should remain on-premises, move to Azure or be decommissioned.

What You Bring

We are looking for a hands-on infrastructure specialist who can independently manage and improve complex Microsoft environments. You combine strong technical expertise with the ability to drive infrastructure improvements across multiple locations.

Must-have – Essential Requirements

The following skills and experience are essential for this position:

Azure & Hybrid Infrastructure

  • Strong hands-on experience designing, operating and maintaining Microsoft Azure infrastructure, including compute, networking (VNets, NSGs, VPN Gateway and ExpressRoute) and storage.

  • Proven experience managing on-premises Windows Server environments alongside Microsoft Azure in a hybrid infrastructure.

  • Practical PowerShell scripting skills for automation, administration and infrastructure management.

Infrastructure Modernization

  • A proven track record of rationalizing infrastructure and reducing technical debt, including server consolidation, migration projects and replacing unsupported systems.

  • Strong Windows Server administration skills, including server lifecycle management, upgrades and migrations.

  • Practical experience with Hyper-V and/or VMware virtualization environments.

Identity & Access Management

  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID in hybrid environments.

  • Practical experience with identity synchronization, Conditional Access and Multi-Factor Authentication.

  • Experience managing and improving identity security and access controls.

Endpoint Management

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune in enterprise environments, including device enrollment, configuration policies and application deployment.

Resilience, Security & Monitoring

  • Practical experience with enterprise backup, disaster recovery and infrastructure monitoring solutions, ideally Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery and Azure Monitor.

  • Experience implementing infrastructure security improvements, including privileged access management, patch management, system hardening and vulnerability remediation.

Communication & Collaboration

  • Confidence working independently and across international teams and locations.

  • Ability to explain technical concepts and architectural decisions to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Good written and spoken English. German is an advantage.

  • Willingness to travel occasionally to our Bexbach site and other group locations.

Please note: This is a specialized infrastructure engineering role requiring proven hands-on experience with Azure, hybrid Microsoft environments and infrastructure modernization. The mandatory requirements listed above are essential for this position. Candidates without practical experience in these core areas are unlikely to be considered.

Nice-to-have – Additional Experience

The following skills are beneficial but not essential:

  • Active Directory domain or forest consolidation and migration projects.

  • Azure Virtual Desktop, particularly migrating users and applications to alternative delivery methods.

  • Azure governance and cost management, including Azure Policy, resource tagging and Microsoft Cost Management.

  • Azure Arc for managing on-premises servers.

  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Defender for Identity or Microsoft Sentinel.

  • Experience supporting application development teams, e.g. Azure App Service, Azure DevOps or GitHub.

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC), such as Bicep or Terraform.

  • Experience working in regulated environments, preferably pharmaceutical manufacturing or GxP.

  • Microsoft certifications such as AZ-104, MD-102 or SC-300.

Your First 12 Months

Your initial focus will be on delivering measurable improvements across our global infrastructure:

  • Assess and develop a roadmap for standardizing our Azure and hybrid infrastructure.

  • Review and rationalize our existing server environments, replacing unsupported systems and reducing technical debt.

  • Review our Active Directory and hybrid identity architecture and initiate consolidation where required.

  • Strengthen centralized endpoint management through Microsoft Intune.

  • Establish consistent Azure governance, resource standards and cost transparency.

  • Improve infrastructure security, monitoring, backup and disaster recovery.

  • Evaluate application delivery solutions and reduce unnecessary reliance on Azure Virtual Desktop.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first working: Work remotely within Germany or Switzerland, with occasional visits to our Bexbach site.

  • Competitive compensation: Annual gross salary of €60,000–80,000, depending on experience.

  • Additional payments: Christmas and vacation bonuses.

  • Company pension scheme: Support for your long-term financial security.

  • Career development: Individual training and development opportunities in an internationally operating company.

  • Employee benefits: Free water and coffee, as well as company products at employee prices.

  • Team culture: Regular team events and opportunities to connect with colleagues across the group.

📍 Location: Remote within Germany or Switzerland (Bexbach proximity is a plus)

📅 Start date: As soon as possible

⏳ Employment type: Permanent, full-time

Ready to Shape Our Global IT Infrastructure?

We are looking for someone who wants to take ownership, make things better and deliver real technical improvements.

Send us your application – no perfectly polished cover letter required. We are interested in your experience, your technical expertise and what you can bring to our team.

title: Senior IoT Engineer (all genders) – Embedded Linux · Python · Yocto
descriptionHtml:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Senior IoT Engineer (all genders), you join our Devices team and bridge both worlds: you own our Yocto-based Linux software platform and actively build the Python application services running on top of it. Python is your daily driver, but you go down to C/C++, drivers, and the kernel whenever hardware requires it. Neither pure BSP-only engineers nor high-level-only developers will be happy here - this is a true hybrid hands-on role.

Right now, we are building a new generalized Linux based platform for our next-generation hardware, harmonizing the software across all device types and making fleet health visible in real time. You do this in a profitable Munich scale-up with more than 250 people in five European locations: the pace of a fast-growing company and the stability to build things properly.

As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process.

WHAT TO EXPECT

  • Next-Gen OS Image: Design and build our new Yocto-based Linux image for the next hardware generation, and drive the migration of our fleet onto it.

  • Hardware Abstraction: Harmonize the software across scanners, payment terminals and screens into one maintainable codebase.

  • Fleet Updates: Design OS and application updates that never brick a device: A/B partitions, staged rollouts and clean versioning across hardware variants.

  • Fleet Observability: Build monitoring that shows the health of every device in real time, from memory leaks to network stability and hardware metrics.

  • Debugging: Find root causes across kernel, drivers, networking, memory and application code, on devices hundreds of kilometers away.

  • Technical Guidance: Bring senior judgment into architecture discussions with our IoT Platform, Backend and AI teams, document decisions and mentor engineers.

INSPIRE US BY

  • Embedded Linux Expertise: Hands-on experience building and maintaining embedded Linux products that are deployed in the field, ideally at fleet scale, and confidence working with Linux internals, GNU tools, and Bash

  • Background: Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or equivalent practical experience

  • Yocto Experience: Proven experience building, customizing, and maintaining Linux images using Yocto

  • Python Development: Strong Python skills – Python will be your primary development language in this role

  • Systems Programming: Strong programming skills in at least one systems language such as C++, Rust, Go, or Java

  • Operating System & Debugging: Solid understanding of Linux internals, bootloaders, systemd, drivers, kernel concepts, networking, and Docker, plus hands-on experience with debugging tools such as GDB, tcpdump, Valgrind, UART, and JTAG

  • Senior Mindset: You clarify requirements before designing a solution, consider the impact on other teams, and are comfortable making and defending technical decisions

  • Communication: You explain complex technical topics clearly and in a structured way, in fluent English (C1)

EXTRA POINTS FOR

  • Experience operating large-scale IoT fleets

  • Knowledge of industrial hardware, cameras, AI accelerators, modems, or network devices

  • Experience with computer vision, edge AI, or machine learning

  • Familiarity with MQTT and Protocol Buffers (ProtoBuf)

  • German language skills

What we offer

  • Flexibility & Responsibility: Your workday, your performance – Our hybrid model empowers you to focus from home, get fresh perspectives during workation, and connect in person during our Anchor Days (Tuesday to Thursday)

  • Productive Environment: Brainfood deluxe – Whether it's portafilter coffee, Bella&Bona online cafeteria, fresh fruit or our muesli bar – your wellbeing fuels your performance

title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (Power Electronics)
descriptionHtml:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a Senior Mechanical Design Engineer, you will turn our power electronic modules into a robust, compact and safe product. You will design how the SiC-based power modules, magnetics, busbars and cooling come together into one unit, working closely with our power electronics, magnetics and thermal engineers.

Instead of handing your designs over for someone else to build, you take them all the way: you calculate them, build and assemble the prototypes yourself in our workshop, and take the design from first prototype to a product ready for series production.

This role is for you if…

you've designed the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems and know your way around creepage, clearance and insulating plastics. You back your designs with solid calculations, and you're as comfortable with a screwdriver in the workshop as with CAD at your desk.

This role isn't for you if…

your experience is in classic mechanical design only, such as gears, gearboxes or pumps, or you prefer to stay at your desk while someone else builds your prototypes. It's also not a fit if you need technicians for assembly or established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design the mechanical integration of power electronic modules into the SST: enclosures, holders, fixtures and jigs, and interfaces to the busbar system, with a modular design approach.

  • Model and design electro-mechanical parts and assemblies, including plastics, sheet metal, insulation systems, magnetic components and cooling system interfaces.

  • Ensure electrical safety through the design on both the medium-voltage and low-voltage side: creepage and clearance distances, CTI and material selection, electrical isolation and sealing.

  • Design for manufacturing, assembly and test from the first concept, working with suppliers on processes such as injection molding, sheet metal and machining.

  • Own the DFMEA for your designs and drive the resulting actions into the design.

  • Validate designs with structural FEA, including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis, before they are released for production, and correlate the results with test data.

  • Build and assemble prototypes and test assemblies hands-on in our workshop, together with the engineering team, using additive manufacturing where it speeds things up.

  • Collaborate with other engineers to take designs from concept through prototype to series production.

  • Share your expertise and support other engineers on best practices in mechanical engineering.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical engineering or a related field.

  • 4+ years of full-time industry experience in mechanical design, with a focus on the mechanical integration of power electronics or other electronic systems.

  • Proven experience applying DFM and DFA to your own designs, with parts and assemblies that made it into production.

  • Hands-on experience leading or actively contributing to DFMEAs.

  • Strong experience with structural FEA (e.g. ANSYS), including static, modal, shock and vibration analysis. You set up the models yourself and use the results to drive design decisions.

  • Solid knowledge of creepage, clearance, CTI, insulation coordination and electrical safety (e.g. IEC 60664-1, IEC 62477-1), ideally up to medium voltage.

  • Solid experience designing with polymers/plastics, ideally for electronics integration.

  • Proficiency in 3D CAD (e.g. SolidWorks), GD&T and tolerance stack-up analysis.

  • Hands-on experience building and assembling prototypes in a professional setting.

  • Experience with environmental, reliability and safety standards for power delivery products.

  • Basic understanding of electrical design fundamentals; familiarity with PCBAs and PCBA components.

  • Strong organization, written and verbal communication skills.

  • Fluent English; German is a plus.

  • Eligible to work in Switzerland (Swiss or EU/EFTA citizenship, or a valid Swiss work permit).

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with industrialization: taking hardware from prototype to series production and designing with series production in mind from the start (tooling such as injection molds, supplier involvement, cost and process capability).

  • Experience with high-volume manufacturing and automated assembly processes.

  • Experience with additive manufacturing (e.g. SLA, SLS, FDM) for prototypes, fixtures and jigs, ideally including insulating or flame-retardant materials.

  • Experience with PFMEA, DFT and DFR.

  • Experience with insulation design for medium voltage, including partial discharge.

  • Experience with liquid cooling integration or CFD.

Benefits

  • Equity + competitive salary.

  • Unique technology and market opportunity – design the hardware of a new product category for the energy transition.

  • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

title: Senior Partner Account Executive, UK - Insurance

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the Role:

We are looking for a strategic and results-driven Senior Partner Account Executive to launch, scale, and optimise partnerships across our ecosystem with a focus on insurance carriers and brokers. Samsara's telematics and dashcam technology already help thousands of customers improve safety and reduce risk - this role will accelerate those benefits by developing high-impact partnerships that drive mutual growth.

You will be the face of Samsara to insurance executives, building scalable programmes that directly influence customer acquisition, retention, and loss cost improvement. If you thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, are motivated by measurable business impact, and enjoy turning ideas into reality, this is your opportunity to make a difference.

Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role.

In this role you will:

  • Own and grow our relationships with insurance carriers, brokers and MGAs in the UK
  • Design and run partner programmes that drive customer acquisition, retention and loss-cost improvement - and the Samsara revenue that comes with them
  • Map accounts with partners, pick joint targets and bring Samsara sales into the deals
  • Build the playbook: how we qualify, onboard and scale insurance partnerships

You should apply if:

  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your partners are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live. Samsara's top employees do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You want to develop the playbook, not just follow one: Our partner ecosystem is young. You'll define how we take partners to value - from first conversation to joint customers - and build the model that lets those partnerships deliver maximum value for Samsara at scale.

Minimum requirements for the role:

An ideal candidate also has:

Why Join Samsara?

  • Work with the best: Join a high-performance, mission-driven team that values collaboration, innovation, and results.
  • Grow with us: We're scaling rapidly, which means new challenges, learning opportunities, and career advancement.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. Flexible Working

Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. title: Senior People Partner - Content
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The opportunity

Our People Partners are the eyes and ears of the organisation, embedded within their functional areas to be a sounding board for leaders, support managers and enable teams to thrive. The People Partnering team operate on a strategic and tactical level, ensuring the people elements are in place for teams to effectively deliver their strategic objectives (think org design, upskilling, succession planning) whilst also offering one on one support, both structured and ad hoc, to those who need it most.

We're hiring an experienced, driven Senior People Partner to partner with our Chief Content Officer and the Content (Editorial, Legals, Credit, Distressed) team. Content is scaling fast across the UK and US, and we need a Senior People Partner who can move at pace, get to grips with what the team actually does, and hold their own with senior editorial and analytical leaders.

You'll be fully embedded in the Content team, with a real voice in leadership meetings, editorial rituals and off-sites. You'll know the leads, managers and rising talent well enough to catch the people issues long before they show up in engagement scores or exit interviews.

Every day is different, but here's an example of the kind of things you'll work on:

Strategic

  • Trusted advisor to your leaders: You'll be the first person Content leadership calls on anything people-related: the confidant, sounding board and thought partner they think alongside, not the person they update after the fact. That kind of trust is earned over time, through showing up and being willing to have the harder conversation when it matters.

  • Right hand person to the CCO: You know how he thinks about content and his organisation, and are confident acting as his proxy with his leaders to get them to where they need to be.

  • Locked in on what the team is trying to achieve: You know Content's goals, what its leaders and teams do. You bring solutions, not just observations, and follow them through to completion.

  • Fully embedded in your team: You're in the rituals, Slack channels and meetings that matter, so you've got a real read on how the team actually works. You cut through the noise to name the actual issue and get it resolved quickly and respectfully.

  • Catching things early: You join the dots across 1:1s, skips, engagement data and your own observations to surface people risks while they're still small and easy to fix. You coach leaders and managers to build the same instinct.

  • Org design: You advise on org shape, spot gaps and flag future risk areas. You make sure the right people are doing the right jobs at the right level as Content scales across regions and coverage.

  • Talent management: You know who the key talent is and you work with leaders to develop, stretch and reward them. You support leaders to identify their successors and build the development plans that get them ready. You work proactively with the Talent team on the pipelines for roles you can already see coming.

  • Learning & development: You spot where Content teams need to grow — editorial craft, analytical rigour, management skill, leadership development — and you lead the training that plugs the gap. A big part of that is upskilling managers to handle people issues themselves, early and well, rather than escalating them to the CCO. You diagnose early, source or build the right thing, and hold a bar for what impact should look like once it's landed.

  • Reward: You use solid data to inform our salary bands and keep compensation fair across the team, with D&I front of mind. You coach leaders and managers through promotion and salary reviews so decisions are thoughtful, equitable and defensible.

  • Performance: You help leaders and managers get the best out of their teams, surfacing blockers, coaching through them, and making sure feedback and training actually land. You hold a high bar yourself and help leaders hold one too.

  • Hands up for the bigger stuff: You take on projects that improve the People function as a whole, not just your patch. You scope them properly, influence stakeholders, manage the risks and dependencies, and ship on time.

Tactical

  • Employee Relations (ER): Following UK employment law, navigating all employee relations within your business area, including but not limited to: managing Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), resolving claims and grievances in line with policy, probation management, maternity and paternity cases, flexible working requests, conflict management and mediation, and any other employee-to-employee issue that comes up, both formally and informally.

  • Embedding people products: Working with the wider Partnering team to embed our people products and systems, delivering training, championing adoption and being the go-to person for questions. Delivering product feedback to the wider team on a regular basis.

  • Data: Pulling and analysing the right data to help managers and leaders make good calls and adding the context that turns numbers into something your leaders can actually use.

  • Wellbeing support: 1:1 support to employees when they need it, and making sure they know what mental and physical health support is on offer. Supporting managers through those conversations too.

  • Cultural ambassador: Working with leaders and managers to reinforce the right behaviours in teams. Being a role model yourself for our values and ways of working, especially as the London office grows.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Take real accountability for pushing back on leaders — not just flagging a concern and moving on, but staying with it until the right decision gets made.

  • Can confidently challenge executives and their most senior leaders when it matters, as a true partner rather than a service function.

  • Are properly curious about the business you support. You'll want to understand how Content produces its analysis, what makes a great desk, and what separates a good journalist from a world class one. You ask questions until you get to the real answer.

  • Are a strong influencer, able to help others look at things from different perspectives and understand the 'why' behind decisions. Comfortable pushing back on leaders and managers when needed, and know when to step back and let them make their own call.

  • Have significant experience partnering with content, editorial, research or analyst teams and can speak their language credibly.

  • Have a bias to action: you see what needs doing and pick it up, rather than waiting to be asked.

  • Use data to back your decisions and see what's coming, not just to describe what's already happened.

  • Care about data integrity and have solid experience with the day-to-day people processes and onboarding a high-trust team relies on.

  • Have a strong grasp of UK employment law and awareness of New York employment law to reach the right, compliant call in tricky ER situations autonomously. Sharp on policies and procedures.

  • Can context-switch frequently and comfortably hold strategic and tactical work in the same day.

  • Are a strong team player who partners closely with your fellow People Partners, Talent Partners and the wider People and Talent team so 9finners get the best experience of us collectively.

  • Can operate autonomously and at pace in a fast-moving scale-up.

Key Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in HR, preferably in fast-paced environments (tech, fintech, or start-ups)

  • Knowledge of UK employment laws and regulations

  • Excellent organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously

  • Familiarity with HRIS and ATS software (we use HiBob, Lattice and Ashby)

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; ability to interact with candidates, employees, and external stakeholders in a professional and approachable manner

  • A people-first mindset with the ability to build strong relationships and offer guidance to employees at all levels

  • Flexible and able to thrive in a fast-moving, dynamic start-up environment

  • Proactive and collaborative approach

  • A genuine interest in employee well-being and fostering a supportive, inclusive culture

Compensation & Benefits

Finance & Insurance

  • Competitive base salary

  • Equity options

  • Pension with 9fin contributing 3% (employee contributions are uncapped)

  • Private health insurance with dental and vision

Time Off

  • 25 vacation days per year

  • Local public holidays (with option to exchange for alternative days)

  • Work abroad for up to 3 months per year

  • 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

  • Enhanced parental leave and flexible working arrangements

Growth & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

  • Bi-annual team socials

  • Summer and Winter company-wide events

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

At 9fin we are dedicated to building and promoting a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can reach their full potential and truly belong. We recognize that building diverse teams enables a more creative and productive environment. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be who we’re looking for — either for this role, or perhaps another.

title: Senior PHP Backend Developer
descriptionHtml:
About Shiftbase

At Shiftbase, we build workforce software that helps people get work done. Thousands of teams across Europe rely on our platform every day to plan work, track time, and manage leave, freeing them from unnecessary admin so they can focus on what matters and what sparked their business.

As we continue to grow in customers, usage and product ambition, the demands on our platform grow with us. Our backend needs to scale in quality, reliability and speed of change. That’s why we’re investing heavily in modernising our platform, building a foundation that allows us to move faster, deliver better experiences, and support the next phase of Shiftbase’s growth.

About the role:


As a Senior Backend Engineer, you are a key driver of both product delivery and platform modernisation. You work on the core of our backend, improving reliability, performance and scalability, with the explicit goal of turning Shiftbase from a platform people enjoy into a platform they love.

You help evolve a mature monolithic codebase into a more modular, testable and future-proof architecture. By modernising the foundation of the product, you directly enable better user experiences, faster iteration and higher overall product quality.

What you'll do

Drive technical excellence

  • Design and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions for complex features and system components

  • Make informed architectural decisions that balance pragmatism with long-term vision

  • Set the bar for technical craft through your contributions and code reviews

  • Own complex technical initiatives from design through production, breaking them into testable increments

Build for reliability and scale

  • Define comprehensive testing strategies for complex features, championing quality within the team

  • Debug and resolve complex issues across multiple components, improving system observability

  • Apply security best practices throughout the development lifecycle

  • Contribute to monitoring, alerting and system health improvements

Enable team growth

  • Mentor engineers with targeted technical guidance and feedback

  • Support onboarding and enable a collaborative, knowledge-sharing environment

  • Help shape delivery practices and improve team velocity through data-informed decisions


What we're looking for

Core technical expertise

You have deep backend engineering experience with complex, high-scale systems. We don't expect expertise in everything listed below. We value engineers who've built depth and breadth through genuine curiosity and a drive to solve real problems. These are examples of competencies that matter in this role:

  • Modern PHP & architectural patterns: Experience with hexagonal architecture, domain-driven design, or similar patterns that emphasize domain modeling over framework magic. You can build maintainable systems without relying on framework shortcuts.

  • SQL & database design: Comfort writing raw SQL (not just ORM abstractions) and working with complex relational schemas particularly around time-sensitive data like scheduling, timesheets and payroll where integrity and performance are critical.

  • Legacy modernisation experience: You've gradually evolved mature systems rather than pursuing big-bang rewrites. You know when to modernize strategically vs. leaving working code untouched, and understand the balance between progress and stability when serving thousands of customers.

  • Monolith to services: Experience breaking down monoliths with good judgment about when distribution solves real problems (deployment bottlenecks, team autonomy) vs. when it adds unnecessary complexity.

  • Testing in legacy contexts: Practical experience with unit and integration testing, particularly incrementally improving coverage in existing systems.

This might be your dream job if…

✅ You enjoy modernising a mature platform and turning legacy code into something you’re proud of

✅ You get energy from breaking down a monolith and shaping a more modular, service-oriented architecture

✅ You care about product quality, not just “shipping code”.

✅ You like improving reliability, performance and developer experience as much as adding new features

✅ You enjoy working closely with product and frontend to make better technical and product decisions

This probably isn’t your dream job if…

⛔️ You only want to work on greenfield projects and avoid legacy systems altogether

⛔️ You’re uncomfortable refactoring existing code or making incremental improvements

⛔️ You prefer being handed fully-defined solutions rather than helping shape them

⛔️ You’re looking for a role where architecture decisions are already “done”

⛔️ You’d rather optimise locally than care about the end-to-end product experience

Note: Candidates outside the Netherlands will not be considered

title: Senior Power Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast. By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously. We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do 

  • Own the electrical power system architecture for Hypersonica’s high-speed flight vehicles, ensuring generation, conversion, storage, distribution, protection, and monitoring functions operate as a coherent and resilient system.

  • Define, manage, and maintain power system requirements, ensuring full traceability from mission and vehicle-level needs through subsystem design, verification, and validation.

  • Develop power-system architectures and performance budgets covering voltage regulation, load management, efficiency, redundancy, thermal constraints, fault tolerance, and mission-critical availability.

  • Lead the integration of power generation, battery systems, power electronics, energy storage, distribution networks, protection devices, and control systems across vehicle and payload architectures.

  • Conduct electrical system analyses including load-flow, transient response, fault analysis, protection coordination, power quality, thermal performance, and reliability assessments.

  • Define and support system-level modelling, simulation, laboratory testing, environmental qualification, and vehicle integration activities, using data-driven analysis to improve performance and mitigate risk.

  • Produce and maintain critical engineering artefacts including specifications, electrical schematics, interface control documents (ICDs), analysis reports, verification plans, and design review material.

  • Apply systems engineering and MBSE principles to ensure traceability between requirements, architectures, analyses, verification activities, and flight-test outcomes.

  • Identify and mitigate system-level risks associated with power availability, thermal loading, EMC performance, reliability, safety, integration complexity, and operational resilience.

  • Act as a technical authority across electrical power systems, collaborating closely with avionics, controls, software, thermal, mechanical, EMC, and systems engineering teams to deliver robust vehicle capability.


Who you are 

  • An experienced Power Systems Engineer with 8+ years of experience delivering complex electrical power, energy storage, avionics, aerospace, defence, automotive, space, or other mission-critical systems.

  • Strong background in electrical system architecture, requirements management, systems integration, verification, and validation across the full engineering lifecycle.

  • Deep understanding of electrical power generation, power conversion, battery systems, energy storage, power distribution, protection systems, and power electronics.

  • Experienced in electrical analysis including load-flow studies, transient response, fault analysis, protection coordination, power quality, thermal performance, and reliability assessments.

  • Comfortable designing and integrating high-performance electrical power systems within highly constrained environments where weight, volume, efficiency, and thermal management are critical.

  • Familiar with systems engineering and MBSE approaches, using structured methods to manage complexity, interfaces, traceability, and technical risk.

  • Experienced supporting major design reviews, qualification campaigns, integration programmes, and the transition from concept through detailed design and verification.

  • Technically credible across multiple engineering disciplines, capable of influencing decisions, challenging assumptions, and driving technical direction.

  • Comfortable operating in ambitious, fast-paced environments where priorities evolve quickly and engineering decisions have significant programme impact.

  • Motivated by solving difficult engineering problems and delivering technologies that strengthen European sovereign defence capability.


What we offer 

  • A mission-driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.

  • A fast-paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from testing and operational activities drives real decisions.

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.


Security and Eligibility Requirement 

Due to the nature of the work, applicants must be an EU/Nato/German citizen and be eligible for German Security Clearance.

At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply. Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential. You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

descriptionHtml:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of our Gift Cards vertical - one of the fastest-growing parts of our alternative offers, spanning gift card purchase, redemption, provider partnerships, and cross-market growth across France, Germany, and Spain.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll also work closely with - and may grow into ownership of - adjacent parts of our Alternative Offers and in-store rewards portfolio.

We want a strong senior product leader: someone who has built and scaled products at a leading tech company and/or a startup, who thinks and acts like an entrepreneur, and who can move a commercial product forward with minimal hand-holding.

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here's what you can expect:

Responsibilities:

  • Own the gift card product strategy and roadmap - from provider selection and inventory quality to the end-to-end purchase, redemption, and admin experience.
  • Lead commercial and provider negotiations - framework agreements, commission structures, SLAs, and multi-entity contracting with gift card providers (e.g. Finperks, Tillo), in partnership with Operations, Legal and Finance.

  • Partner cross-functionally - work daily with engineering, design, data, CRM, and adjacent product teams to ship a coherent gift card experience across web, app, and browser extension.
  • Own delivery end to end - set the roadmap, own the backlog, and take each bet from discovery to launch with engineering, design and data: frame the problem, write the specs and user stories, prioritise sprint by sprint, make the scope calls, and measure what shipped. This is a hands-on build role, not a coordination role.
  • Use data to lead, not just report - build and refine models (e.g. fraud-tier scoring), validate revenue and performance data with Finance, and identify the next highest-impact bet.
  • Represent the vertical at the leadership level - bring clear recommendations and trade-offs to cross-team and leadership forums, and help shape Alternative Offers' broader strategic direction.
  • Build for scale - help expand gift cards from a standalone catalogue page into a fully integrated offer type across the platform.

Your Profile:

  • 5+ years in product management, including significant time owning a product or business line end-to-end at a leading tech company and/or a startup.
  • A strong entrepreneurial track record - you've built something from close to zero, made judgment calls with imperfect data, and taken ownership beyond your formal remit.
  • Commercial fluency - comfortable owning revenue targets, running vendor/partner negotiations, and thinking in margin, commission, and unit economics, not just features.
  • Strong analytical skills - fluent working with transaction and revenue data to make and defend decisions; comfortable partnering with data/finance teams on models like fraud scoring.
  • Proven cross-functional leadership - experience leading engineering, design, and data counterparts in a fast-paced, matrixed environment, without formal authority over them.
  • Hands-on product delivery - you have recently (last 2 to 3 years) taken features from problem to production yourself, working day to day with engineers and designers: running discovery, writing the specs, owning backlog and sprint priorities, and making trade-offs when scope, time or data ran short. You are as comfortable in the detail as at the roadmap level.
  • Excellent stakeholder management - able to influence and present confidently to senior/executive stakeholders.
  • A degree from a top-tier university (e.g. Oxford, Cambridge, LSE, HEC Paris, ESSEC, Sciences Po, Bocconi, ETH Zurich, or equivalent); an MBA or further qualification from a leading program is a plus.
  • Fluent English required

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with developers, DevOps, and security teams to enhance system testability, troubleshoot root causes, and build sustainable quality processes together.

  • Standards & Ownership: Define and refine test automation best practices, continuous testing approaches, and tooling to ensure high-performing, reliable digital products.

  • Mentorship & Team Growth: Support and empower fellow QA engineers through constructive code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and supportive technical coaching.

We hire for passion, potential and mindset as much as credentials. If you think you'd be incredible in the role, then apply - even if you don't think you tick every box.


What you'll bring

  • Solid Quality Engineering Experience: Extensive experience in software quality engineering and test automation, with strong hands-on experience testing and automating mobile applications across iOS and Android, as well as APIs.

Your Talent Attraction Partner will be in your corner through every step right up to your Welcome Ritual on day one

Our Benefits

We believe in supporting our team, inside and outside of work. Here's a glimpse of what you can expect:

You'll also have the opportunity to make a local impact through Spirit of Waracle, our initiative for getting involved in charitable causes locally, building strong team bonds and giving back.

title: Senior Regional Marketing Manager, EMEA
descriptionHtml:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

 

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

 

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Where does this role fit in?

You’ll be UpGuard’s first marketer in EMEA, making sure the region gets what it needs to grow. That means two things. First, you’ll deliver partner marketing across EMEA, running programs and events with our channel and technology partners that create pipeline. Second, you’ll be the main marketing contact for the region, working with EMEA sales leaders every week and with our global marketing team to make sure events, campaigns, content, and collateral land well in local markets.

You won’t be expected to do everything yourself. Global teams own demand generation, product marketing, content, and brand. Your job is to bring the region’s needs to them, adapt what they build for EMEA, and run the activity that only someone on the ground can, especially partner events. You’ll work from a regional plan and budget. This is a hands-on role, and success is measured by the pipeline you help create.

 

What will you do?

  • Be the main marketing contact for EMEA, with a standing weekly check-in with regional sales leaders

  • Deliver the EMEA partner marketing plan agreed with your manager and our channel team, running joint campaigns, webinars, and enablement content with the resellers, MSPs, and technology partners most likely to produce pipeline.

  • Manage and organise EMEA partner events end to end, including co-hosted roundtables and executive dinners, sponsored partner conferences, and partner enablement sessions. That covers venue and vendor sourcing, logistics, joint promotion, on-site delivery, and making sure leads are shared and followed up with partners and sales.

  • Work with sales and demand gen on account-based programs and regional campaigns, coordinating events, outreach, and content around target accounts and contributing to regional lead generation.

  • Build UpGuard’s presence in the region through EMEA customer stories, references, and speakers, regional PR and media, and relationships with industry associations and CISO communities (e.g. ISACA and ISC2 chapters).

  • Localize global campaigns, content, and collateral for EMEA markets and languages, and feed regional regulatory developments (e.g. NIS2, DORA, GDPR) to product marketing so our messaging stays relevant.

  • Track market development funds and co-marketing spend for partner events and campaigns, and partner-sourced and influenced pipeline in the CRM, within agreed budgets.

  • Report on regional and partner performance against agreed goals, and share insights and recommendations to inform future plans.

What will you bring?

  • 6+ years in B2B SaaS marketing, with significant time in partner/channel marketing, field marketing, or regional marketing in EMEA.

  • Experience selling to security, IT, risk, or compliance buyers, ideally in cybersecurity.

  • A track record of partner or regional programs that produced measurable pipeline.

  • Experience running account-based programs with sales, and building customer advocacy or regional PR.

  • Comfort working as a team of one in-region while collaborating closely with a global team across time zones.

  • Strong relationships with sales leaders and an instinct for turning field feedback into marketing action.

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce or HubSpot and of partner and event attribution.

  • Willingness to travel across EMEA.

What will give you an edge?

  • Knowledge of EMEA's security regulatory landscape, existing relationships with major regional distributors, MSPs, media, or CISO communities

  • Fluency in a second European language

What’s in it for you?

At UpGuard, we’re passionate about our work, but we’re also passionate about employee wellness and personal growth. We offer a competitive benefits package to help maximize the well-being of all UpGuardians. This includes:

  • Monthly Lifestyle subsidy: use this for financial, physical and mental wellbeing (all regions)

  • WFH set-up allowance: to ensure you have the right environment to work in, we will help you get set-up within your first 3 months at UpGuard (all regions)

  • $1500 USD annual Learning & Development allowance: to support your career development all team members will be able to expense development opportunities against this allowance (all regions)

  • Generous Annual Leave/PTO allowances: time to recharge your batteries (all regions)

  • 18 weeks paid Parental Leave: irrespective of parenting role (all regions)

  • Personal Leave allowance: this includes sick & carer’s leave (all regions)

  • Fully remote working environment: whilst we have physical offices in Sydney & Hobart, we do not mandate compulsory attendance (all regions)

  • Top spec hardware: all team members will be provided with top-spec laptops for their role (all regions)

  • Personal device security & online privacy protection subsidy: UpGuard provides team members with a paid subscription to personal device security & online privacy protection platform (all regions)

  • Generative AI subsidy: UpGuard provides paid subscriptions for all team members to access generative AI tools to support their work (all regions)

UpGuard is a Certified Great Place to Work® in the US, Australia, UK and India, establishing its position as a leading global technology employer. 99% of team members agree that UpGuard is a great place to work! Apply now to find out why!

title: (Senior) Sales Manager (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Als (Senior) Sales Manager (w/m/d) bekommst du die Chance, aktiv zum Erfolg und Wachstum unseres Unternehmens beizutragen.
