title: Staff Engineer - Search
descriptionHtml:
About Staffbase

We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.

Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.

As a Staff Engineer on the Search team, you'll take on one of our most important platform challenges: making every employee able to find what they need, and get a trustworthy answer, across Staffbase and the tools around it. Today search spans people, posts, pages, files and connected integrations, and it increasingly feeds AI-generated answers. You'll define how retrieval, ranking and grounded answers work at that scale.

Your north star is a search platform that finds the right thing, fast, for the right person. It must respect permissions on every query, work in every language our customers use, and give answers that cite their sources. You'll build the core, set the quality bar, and decide where we use proven techniques and where we experiment, all on a mature, multi-tenant platform.

This is a role for someone who wants to drive, not just deliver. You'll shape the direction of an open-ended problem, and you'll measure your work with real relevance data, not gut feeling.

Our tech stack includes Kotlin, Java, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, MongoDB, React, TypeScript, Terraform, Docker and Playwright, plus LLM and embedding services for retrieval, reranking and summarisation.

The Team

The Search team sits at the heart of how employees find information at Staffbase. We own the full path from query to result: indexing and embeddings, hybrid keyword and semantic retrieval, ranking and reranking, typeahead, and the AI summaries that answer questions with citations. Search is also a core source of knowledge for Navigator, our AI assistant, and the main way it grounds its answers in company content.

That means two big things. First, we make results relevant: understanding the query, retrieving the right candidates, ranking them well, and doing it in the user's language. Second, we make search safe and fast: every result respects the user's access rights, every tenant stays isolated, and the fast path stays fast. We don't ship relevance changes on a hunch. We run offline evaluations, golden query sets and online signals, and we change one thing at a time.

Our environment

  • Working with skilled and similar-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity
  • We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees
  • We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world
  • We follow the "You build it, you run it" approach and take pride in it

What you'll be doing

  • Define and drive the search and retrieval strategy: hybrid (BM25 + vector) retrieval, reranking, query understanding and rewriting, chunking and embedding choices
  • Build and evolve the core ingestion and query pipeline, from sync and indexing to ranked results and AI summaries with citations
  • Own search quality: build evaluation tooling and golden sets (including unanswerable and permission-varying queries), define relevance metrics, and turn them into decisions
  • Protect the non-negotiables at scale: permission-aware retrieval, tenant isolation, multilingual handling, and graceful degradation when a dependency is slow or down
  • Balance latency, quality and cost, for example what runs on the fast path versus what is allowed on the slow path
  • Make search observable: tracing, relevance dashboards, and a clear way to debug why a result did or did not appear
  • Lead technical strategy and architecture, and document key decisions so others can build on them
  • Take ownership of major technical decisions, proactively addressing bottlenecks and ensuring product quality
  • Work with Product and Design to turn user problems into measurable search improvements
  • Contribute to technical roadmaps with engineering leadership, and coordinate with teams that feed or consume search (content, integrations, Navigator)
  • Mentor and guide engineers through code reviews, design discussions and experiment reviews
  • Foster a culture of ownership, technical excellence and continuous improvement with teams that feed or consume search (content, integrations, Navigator)

What you need to be successful

title: Staff Hardware Technical Program Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software-defined vehicles around the world.

The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.

Role Summary

As Hardware Technical Program Manager (TPM), you will serve as the central technical liaison driving joint vehicle programs between our engineering teams and Volkswagen, Audi, and Porsche. Based out of our Berlin hub, you will bridge the gap between our US-based core engineering teams and our European brand partners, aligning complex hardware requirements, program roadmaps, and architectural decisions.

Rather than managing tier-level supply chains, your focus is entirely collaborative and strategic: orchestrating alignment across brand engineering groups, manufacturing plants, and internal hardware teams to turn ambitious vehicle programs into production reality.

This role is based in our Berlin office and requires a minimum of three days per week onsite, with occasional travel to other company and partner sites as needed.

 

Responsibilities

  • Serve as the hardware integration partner for VW, Audi, and Porsche in parallel, keeping alignment across the three brands on requirements, schedules, and decisions.

  • Own hardware integration schedules, milestones, and readiness gates across assigned vehicle programs, from prototype builds (EVT, DVT) through production validation.

  • Drive engineering change management, including Program Change Requests (PCRs), impact assessments, and approval through partner boards.

  • Coordinate with internal hardware development and validation teams, and bridge the time difference between the US home base and European partners.

  • Track and close hardware issues and open action items, with clear owners and due dates.

  • Lead cost-reduction initiatives on hardware platforms, including proposal reviews and status reporting.

  • Represent hardware integration in program reviews, quality boards, and steering meetings, preparing decisions and clear status updates for leadership.

  • Maintain the Brand Technical Responsible (BTV) interface, collecting partner feedback and turning it into prioritized actions.

  • Help build and grow the European partnering team over time, including hiring and onboarding as the program scales.

 

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, mechatronics, computer engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Strong background in hardware development and/or hardware validation, with enough technical depth to challenge engineering decisions and follow test results.

  • Generalist profile: comfortable moving between hardware design, validation, program management, and partner alignment.

  • Experience in automotive or another safety-critical industry, ideally across development phases (EVT, DVT, PVT).

  • Fluent German and very good English, both written and spoken, for daily work with brand partners and with colleagues in the US.

  • High stress resistance: able to keep priorities clear and communicate calmly during tight deadlines, escalations, and launch pressure.

  • Agile working style: experience running work in sprints or iterative cycles, adapting plans quickly, and working in cross-functional teams.

  • Comfortable working across time zones, with regular overlap with US colleagues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with OEM partner programs, ideally with multiple brands in parallel.

  • Experience with automotive change management processes and PCR or ECR workflows.

  • Familiarity with zonal architectures, vehicle networking, or ECU platforms such as XMM, RFM, or VAS.

  • Project management certification (PMP, PRINCE2, or similar) is a plus.

Total Rewards

We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus program.

Payments are discretionary and not guaranteed; actual amounts depend on company results and the terms of the plan in effect, and require active employment at the time of payout. This role is also eligible for equity in the form of Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), subject to board approval and the terms of our equity incentive plans, including applicable vesting requirements.

In addition to our compensation programs, we invest in our people with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, wellbeing, and financial future for full-time employees — including health coverage, retirement savings, time off, and family planning programs. Offerings vary by country. Learn more about our global benefit programs.

External candidates can apply for this role through the Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies careers site (https://rivianvw.tech/#careers). If you are a current employee, please apply through our internal job board.

Equal Opportunity

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender expression, gender identity, genetic information or characteristics, physical or mental disability, marital/domestic partner status, age, military/veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are also committed to ensuring compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws regarding citizenship and immigration status.

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is committed to ensuring that our hiring process is accessible for persons with disabilities. If you have a disability or limitation, such as those covered by the Americans with Disabilities Act, that requires accommodations to assist you in the search and application process, please email us at ----- style="min-height:1.5em">

Candidate Data Privacy

Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies” may collect, use and disclose your personal information or personal data (within the meaning of the applicable data protection laws) when you apply for employment and/or participate in our recruitment processes (“Candidate Personal Data”). This data includes contact, demographic, communications, educational, professional, employment, social media/website, network/device, recruiting system usage/interaction, security and preference information. Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies may use your Candidate Personal Data for the purposes of (i) tracking interactions with our recruiting system; (ii) carrying out, analyzing and improving our application and recruitment process, including assessing you and your application and conducting employment, background and reference checks; (iii) establishing an employment relationship or entering into an employment contract with you; (iv) complying with our legal, regulatory and corporate governance obligations; (v) record keeping; (vi) ensuring network and information security and preventing fraud; and (vii) as otherwise required or permitted by applicable law.

title: Stage Bouw
descriptionHtml:
Hé stage topper! Kom jij, net als vele andere stagiaires, stagelopen bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo? Bij ons krijg jij de kans om mee te denken, werken én ontwikkelen aan gave projecten binnen Noord, Midden en Oost-Nederland. Wij hebben weer volop stageplekken vanaf Februari 2027 op onze bouwen en op kantoor!

Dit wordt jouw stage

Als stagiair bij Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo ga je aan de slag op ons kantoor of op één van onze projecten. We kijken in overeenstemming welke afdeling of welk project het beste bij jou en/of de opdracht past. Tijdens je stage word je goed begeleid door één van onze collega’s en krijg je de ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen! Jij staat aan het stuur van je eigen ontwikkeling tijdens je stageperiode: Hoe meer jij wil leren, hoe meer jij kan leren! Naast dat je zelfstandig aan een opdracht kan werken wordt je ook begeleidt door een senior collega die jou alle kneepjes van het vak gaat leren. We hebben door heel ons werkgebied verschillende bouwen waar we ruimte hebben voor een stagiaire, stuur ons vooral een berichtje zodat we samen kunnen kijken wat passend is!

Meer bij Dura Vermeer

Dura Vermeer is een familiebedrijf. Een onafhankelijke bouwonderneming actief in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek in Nederland. Al sinds 1855 vormen onze onafhankelijkheid en langjarige continuïteit de basis voor onze strategie. Met een omzet van circa € 1,8 miljard en ruim 3.000 medewerkers behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Samen realiseren we prachtige projecten. Iconische, en soms ook alledaagse projecten waarmee we nieuwe antwoorden bieden op maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Waarmee we de beste oplossingen voor morgen garanderen en het verschil maken voor Nederland, juist op de langere termijn. We hebben stevige ambities – en daarvoor geldt dat we die alleen kunnen waarmaken dankzij onze mensen. Als beste werkgever maken wij ons er daarom hard voor dat jij elke dag opnieuw kiest voor Dura Vermeer. Dat jij net zo trots bent op wat we maken als wij dat zijn. Dat iedereen die bij ons werkt gelukkig is. Dat je bij ons jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je kunt uitspreken. En dat je tot je recht komt. En het beste uit jezelf kunt halen.

Hier zit je goed!

Wij zijn Dura Vermeer Bouw en Vastgoed Hengelo, een ontwikkelende bouwer in het werkgebied Noord-, Oost- en Midden-Nederland. Als onderdeel van de divisie Bouw & Vastgoed combineren we de kracht van een groot bedrijf, met de fijne sfeer en cultuur van een kleinere organisatie.

Bij ons vind je echte doeners en waarmakers. We ontwikkelen en bouwen, samen met onze klanten, partners en collega’s. Wat ons ons maakt? Gewoon dóen en gewóón doen. Dat zit er nou eenmaal in, en zie je terug in alles wat we doen.

Wil jij nou werken op een plek waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en heel veel plezier samenkomen? Mooi! Wij zoeken nieuwe collega’s binnen onze disciplines ontwikkeling, woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, renovatie & transformatie en beheer & exploitatie.


Dit breng je mee

  • Je volgt een MBO, HBO of WO opleiding (pre: opleiding Bouwkunde);

  • Je bent proactief, nuchter en een harde werker, net als wij!

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een stagevergoeding van €700 per maand op basis van 40 uren per week;

  • Je krijgt ruimte voor eigen initiatieven;

  • De beste collega’s om het vak van te leren en zij zorgen voor een ongekende goede werksfeer;

  • Een familiebedrijf waarin we voor elkaar klaarstaan!

Meer weten?

Wij beantwoorden je vragen graag of denken graag met je mee voor het invullen van je stagewens.

Schroom niet om contact op te nemen met Nikki Koehorst via 0628362285 of Hopelijk spreken we elkaar snel!

title: Stage R&D - conception d'un banc d'essai automatisé
descriptionHtml:
Aerophile développe une technologie de filtration électrostatique (précipitateurs
électrostatiques – ESP) capable d’éliminer jusqu’à 95 % des particules fines.

Pour qualifier, caractériser et faire progresser ces filtres l’équipe R&D souhaite
se doter d’un banc d’essai autonome et polyvalent. Ce banc devra reproduire des
conditions climatiques contrôlées (température, humidité, taux de particules,
gaz si besoin) et des conditions de fonctionnement variables, tout en mesurant
automatiquement les performances du filtre (efficacité de filtration,
concentrations particulaires amont/aval, perte de charge, débit …).

Vous aurez donc pour mission de concevoir et mettre en œuvre l’automatisation
du banc d’essai, de l’acquisition des mesures jusqu’au pilotage des conditions
d’essai permettant de caractériser et de qualifier les performances des filtres
électrostatiques de manière autonome.

Vos missions

Vous interviendrez sur l’ensemble du cycle de conception et de réalisation d’un
banc d’essai automatisé, avec un rôle central dans la conception de son système
de régulation, de pilotage et d’acquisition. Vous travaillerez en collaboration avec
les différents pôles de l’entreprise, de la conception à la mise en service du
système.

En particulier :

  • Conception de la chaîne d’asservissement du débit et des conditions d’essai
    (régulation, actionneurs, boucles de contrôle). Dimensionnement aéraulique
    (mécanique des fluides) ;
  • Conception/choix et intégration des systèmes de génération et de régulation
    des conditions climatiques (température, humidité, génération de particules
    PM calibrées, injection de gaz si besoin) ;
  • Sélection et intégration des capteurs de mesure (compteurs/granulomètres
    de particules amont/aval, capteurs de pression différentielle, débitmètres,
    capteurs environnementaux, ...) ;
  • Conception de cartes électroniques (PCB) dédiées au pilotage et à
    l’acquisition si besoin ;
  • Développement de la chaîne d’acquisition, de traitement et de visualisation
    des données (firmware embarqué, communication, base de données) ;
  • Participation à la conception mécanique du banc d’essai à l’aide d’un logiciel
    de CAO ;
  • Participation au sourcing, consultation de fournisseurs et commande de
    composants et pièces ;
  • Fabrication, montage mécanique, électronique et intégration informatique
    du banc ;
  • Mise en service, calibration et validation métrologique du banc ;
  • Réalisation de campagnes de validation de l’automatisation sur des filtres
    électrostatiques.

Vos compétences

Étudiant(e) en dernière année de cycle ingénieur (Bac+5), avec une formation
orientée vers la mécatronique, l’électronique, le génie électrique, l’automatisme
ou l’instrumentation.
Un profil pluridisciplinaire, avec des connaissances en génie physique, mesures
physiques ou mécanique des fluides, est particulièrement adapté au projet.

  • Programmation embarquée et traitement de données
  • Asservissement et régulation (boucles PID, instrumentation de contrôle)
  • Électronique (conception de cartes PCB, capteurs, interfaçage numérique :
    I²C, RS485, etc.)
  • Physique expérimentale et métrologie (incertitudes de mesure, calibration de
    capteurs)
  • Notions de mécanique des fluides (pertes de charge, dimensionnement de
    ventilateurs et de gaines)
  • Notions de conception mécanique et prototypage (CAO, conception et
    réalisation de prototypes)
  • Connaissance ou appétence pour la qualité de l’air appréciée

Avantages

Au sein d’une PME innovante, vous intégrerez une petite équipe R&D dynamique
et enthousiaste et aurez l’opportunité de concevoir, de A à Z, un outil clé pour le
développement de nos technologies de qualité de l’air. Vous bénéficierez d’une
réelle liberté dans vos choix techniques et travaillerez sur un projet concret, à fort
impact environnemental, au sein d’une structure à taille humaine où vous
contribuerez directement aux futurs développements de l’entreprise.

title: Stagiair Strategy & Operations (meewerkstage)
descriptionHtml:
31-38.75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,- stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master | 6-12 maanden

Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot

Ben je nieuwsgierig naar hoe bedrijven en organisaties in de Nederlandse industrie zijn georganiseerd? Wil je bijdragen aan de verbetering en vernieuwing van toonaangevende bedrijven? Wil je samen met een team consultants bijdragen aan complexe vraagstukken, het ontwikkelen van slimme inzichten en deze vertalen naar strategische oplossingen? Dan is deze stage bij Berenschot iets voor jou.

In deze meewerkstage help je mee aan het oplossen van strategische en operationele vraagstukken van klanten uit de industrie: je bekijkt hun grootste uitdagingen op het gebied van strategische positionering, product- en marktkeuzes,, procesoptimalisatie en digitalisering.

Dit ga je doen

Je gaat meewerken aan diverse opdrachten voor klanten uit de industrie en het bredere bedrijfsleven, zoals het ontwikkelen van een nieuwe strategie, het in beeld brengen van een markt of sector, het verbeteren van de operationele processen, het implementeren van technologische innovaties en het organiseren van transformaties voor groei en prestatieverbetering. Bij ‘industrie’ denken we onder meer aan de maakindustrie, defensie-industrie, voedselverwerkende industrie en hightechindustrie.

Je komt te werken in een platte organisatie die altijd openstaat voor nieuwe en innovatieve ideeën, waar je veel vrijheid krijgt om te leren én om mee te denken.

Voorbeelden van projecten waaraan jij meehelpt:

  • Begeleiding van strategische workshops om de strategie van de organisatie te herijken.

  • Doen van marktonderzoek voor een servicepartner in scheepsmotoren.

  • Verbeteren van de kwaliteit en doorlooptijd van het productieproces bij een fabrikant van auto-onderdelen door toepassing van Lean Six Sigma.

  • Optimaliseren van productieprocessen door gebruik van data van een producent van verzorgingsproducten.

  • Realiseren van bedrijfsbrede performanceverbetering en kostenbesparing bij een offshore-organisatie.

Daarnaast help je mee aan het schrijven van offertes en het maken van pitchdecks van nieuwe opdrachten en het verder ontwikkelen van onze dienstverlening. Het is mogelijk om een stageonderzoek parallel te doen aan je periode bij Berenschot zolang er ook voldoende tijd beschikbaar blijft om te helpen met klantopdrachten en je daarin te ontwikkelen.

Quote

‘Bij Berenschot bepaal je vaak zelf wat je wilt leren en als stagiair werk je meteen mee aan echte projecten bij onze klanten.’ — Nick Fierloos, junior consultant (voormalig stagiair)

Hier kom je terecht

Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk Nederlands organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid vanaf dag één, krijg je de kans om te ontdekken wat je belangrijk vindt, waar je kracht ligt en waarin jij je wilt ontwikkelen.

Dit zijn je directe collega’s

Je gaat werken in het team Strategy & Operations, onderdeel van de adviesgroep Transformatie van Organisaties. Het team bestaat uit zeventien slimme en enthousiaste adviseurs die werken in verschillende sectoren. Zij combineren hun kennis van de markt, strategie en operationele bedrijfsprocessen om scherpe analyses en adviezen te maken. Het team kenmerkt zich door een sterke collegiale band waarbij hard werken, teamwork, het beste uit jezelf en elkaar te halen, impact en plezier maken hand in hand gaan. Met slimme en gedreven Berenschotters om je heen werk je samen aan oplossingen die er écht toe doen.


Dit neem je mee

We zoeken iemand die:

  • ervaring heeft met Microsoft Office (PowerPoint en Excel)

  • gevoel heeft voor rapporteren en visuele presentatie van informatie

  • basiskennis heeft van strategie, organisatiestructuren en bedrijfsprocessen

  • passie heeft voor innovatie, leergierig is en goed kan samenwerken

  • proactief is en opdrachten zelfstandig oppakt

  • uitstekend Nederlands spreekt en schrijft

  • bij voorkeur 12 maanden beschikbaar is, maar minimaal 6 maanden bij ons komt.

Eerdere werkervaring is niet nodig, maar kan een pre zijn. Om stage te kunnen lopen bij Berenschot, moet je gedurende de gehele stageperiode ingeschreven staan bij een universitaire onderwijsinstelling.

Dit bieden we jou

Bij Berenschot bieden we een unieke werkomgeving zonder aandeelhouders of partners, wat ons de vrijheid geeft om te ondernemen en waar niet alleen economische winst, maar ook maatschappelijke winst een uitgangspunt is. We hebben een informele cultuur, korte communicatielijnen en volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele groei.

Daarnaast bieden we:

  • een marktconforme stagevergoeding van € 600,- per maand (op fulltimebasis)

  • de mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan trainingen in het stageplusprogramma

  • een laptop

  • flexibele werkmogelijkheden, ook thuis

  • begeleiding door twee adviseurs op het gebied van strategie en operations

  • een stimulerende en leerzame werkomgeving waarin ruimte is voor eigen inbreng

  • de mogelijkheid om een netwerk op te bouwen binnen Berenschot en met bedrijven

  • mogelijkheid om in te stromen in het traineeship van Berenschot

Stageplusprogramma

Naast je stage kun je deelnemen aan het stageplusprogramma van Berenschot: een opleidingsprogramma van circa 3,5 maand dat trainingen biedt op het gebied van advieskennis, -vaardigheden en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Dit vraagt gemiddeld één dagdeel per twee weken. Via deze link lees je meer over het programma. Alles over ons stageplusprogramma | Berenschot

Heb je inhoudelijke vragen over deze vacature? Collega Jelle van Pijkeren beantwoordt al jouw vragen met plezier. Neem contact op met Jelle via WhatsApp (06 82 39 55 98) of per e-mail ().

Vergeet in je motivatie niet te vermelden voor welke periode je een stage zoekt en hoeveel uur per week je beschikbaar bent. Dan kunnen we je sollicitatie zo goed mogelijk beoordelen.

Zo ziet het sollicitatieproces eruit

Na je sollicitatie ontvang je binnen een werkweek een reactie. Bij een positieve eerste indruk nodigen we je uit voor een kennismaking met collega-adviseurs en je toekomstige manager. Als dat goed aansluit, ontvang je een concreet aanbod.

title: Steuerberater:in für eigene Fachkanzlei
descriptionHtml:
Steuerberatung radikal anders – jetzt mitgestalten

Du bist Steuerberater:in und willst nicht einfach nur eine weitere Kanzlei – sondern eine, die neue Wege geht?

Dann werde Teil von b’steuern, einer digitalen Steuerberatung mit Sitz in Berlin – und einem radikal anderen Selbstverständnis. Wir kombinieren steuerliche Exzellenz mit Automatisierung, unternehmerischer Klarheit und selbstorganisierten Teams.

Über uns

Wir denken Steuerberatung neu.

b’steuern steht für eine agile, digitale und selbstorganisierte Kanzlei.

Unser Anspruch: Steuerberatung, die nicht verwaltet – sondern gestaltet.

Nach vielen Jahren in der traditionellen Steuerberatung war für uns klar:

Es braucht einen strukturellen Neustart.

Deshalb sind wir eine der ersten Kanzleien in Deutschland, die als selbstgeführte Organisation aufgebaut ist – mit klaren Verantwortlichkeiten, hoher Transparenz und echter Mitgestaltung.

Jetzt gehen wir einen Schritt weiter. Statt immer größer zu werden, bauen wir Fachkanzleien, also eigenständige Gesellschaften unter der Marke b'steuern, jede spezialisiert auf eine Branche und geführt von jemandem, der diese Branche wirklich kennt. Nicht als Franchise, nicht als Lizenz. Als gemeinsame Gesellschaft, an der du beteiligt bist. 🚀

Deine Rolle

  • Mandantenbetreuung: Du betreust Mandate in deiner Branche und wirst dort zur Instanz, nicht zum Generalisten

  • Steuererklärungen und Jahresabschlüsse: Erstelle und prüfe Einkommensteuer-, Umsatzsteuer- und Gewerbesteuererklärungen sowie Jahresabschlüsse.

  • Kommunikation mit Behörden: Führe die Korrespondenz mit Finanzbehörden und anderen Institutionen.

  • Gestaltung von Prozessen: Hilf dabei, innovative und effiziente Steuerberatungsprozesse zu entwickeln und zu optimieren. Du arbeitest mit unserem KI First Operating System und entscheidest mit, wie es weiterentwickelt wird

  • Strategische Mitarbeit: Arbeite eng mit dem Gründungsteam und unserem KI-Entwicklungsteam zusammen und unterstütze die Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens und unserer Tech-Landschaft.

  • Mentoring: Teile dein Wissen mit dem Team und unterstütze bei der Entwicklung von Best Practices.

  • Mandantengewinnung: Du unterstützt unser Sales Team bei den Erstgesprächen mit potentiellen VIP-Kunden.

  • Auftritt: Du bist Gesicht nach außen: Gespräche mit Mandanten, Sichtbarkeit in deiner Branche, später der Aufbau deines eigenen Teams.

Was du mitbringst

  • Qualifikation: Bestellung als Steuerberater:in und mindestens fünf Jahre Berufserfahrung

  • Fachkompetenz und Fokus: Umfangreiche Kenntnisse im deutschen Steuerrecht und ein gutes Verständnis für betriebswirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge. Zusätzlich muss es einen Fachbereich geben in dem du dich besser auskennst als alle anderen und den du weiter perfektionieren möchtest.

  • Unternehmerische Haltung: Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, unternehmerisch gestalten und Führen.

  • Kommunikation: Freude an der Arbeit mit Mandanten und der Fähigkeit, komplexe steuerliche Themen verständlich zu erklären.

  • Technologie-Affinität: Erfahrung im Umgang mit bestehenden Tools wie DATEV, Lexware, Buchhaltungsbutler ist Standard. Wir gehen einen Schritt weiter und bauen eigene Lösungen.

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Fließendes Deutsch, gute Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

Was wir bieten

Schlüsselrolle: Die Möglichkeit, von Anfang an eine zentrale Rolle in einem innovativen Steuer-Startup einzunehmen und direkt mit dem Gründerteam zu arbeiten.

Gestaltungsfreiheit – deine Erfahrung zählt, dein Beitrag hat Wirkung

Remote-Arbeit mit voller Flexibilität und Kultur trotz digitaler DNA

Echte Anteile an einer gemeinsamen Gesellschaft. Keinen Titel, keine Aussicht.

Mandate von Anfang an: du gründest nicht in ein leeres Auftragsbuch hinein

Eine Marke, die Mandanten kennen, plus Marketing und Vertriebsunterstützung

Unser KI-First Operating System und die Prozesse dahinter, welche seit 2024 im eigenen Haus entwickelt werden

Zentrales Recruiting: Bei dem Engpass, an dem die meisten Kanzleien scheitern, unterstützen wir

Backoffice, Recht, IT und Infrastruktur, voller Support, damit du an der Kanzlei arbeitest und nicht an ihrer Verwaltung

Ein Team im Rücken: bei Urlaub, Krankheit und Ausfall bist du nicht allein

Zum Gehalt: In der Zeit bis zur Gründung zahlen wir solide, aber nicht das Maximum. Beide Seiten investieren in diese Phase. Die konkrete Zahl besprechen wir früh und offen.

Warum bei uns einsteigen?

Wir setzen auf Innovation, Flexibilität und Teamgeist, um die Steuerberatung neu zu definieren. Bei uns hast du die Chance, Teil einer zukunftsweisenden Unternehmensgruppe zu werden und echte Veränderungen zu bewirken.

Jetzt Partner:in werden

Melde dich jetzt und werde Teil dieser spannenden Reise! Lass uns gemeinsam die Welt der Steuerberatung neu gestalten! 🚀

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

  • You’re a hunter – you’ll get a healthy supply of BDR leads and marketing opportunities, but you’ll prospect and tap into your network to knock down doors and blockers

  • You’re a product evangelist – you’ll solution Zip to meet the pain points today, but also with an eye toward our product of the future

  • You’re a builder – at a startup, you’re not just a team member, but you help build the team culture and bring your best practice to the org

  • Become a product expert – learning the Zip platform through and through, so that you’re demo ready

  • Use cutting-edge sales intelligence and engagement solutions to prospect, manage deal cycles, and ultimately bring on new customers

  • Be adaptable and flexible – as part of an early-stage hyper growth company, we are rapidly growing out our process but we want to you to help shape our sales process

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of closing experience in technology SaaS sales at enterprise level

  • Self driven – you don’t need someone to motivate you to put in your best every day

Nice to Haves

  • Experience selling to procurement, finance, IT, legal

title: Strategic Account Manager – Enterprise Hospitality (Nice)
descriptionHtml:
Lightspeed is looking for an experienced, strategically minded Strategic Account Manager to develop, engage, and closely support our most important enterprise customers in the hospitality segment over the long term. This role is remote-based in Nice, France, with occasional travel to our Paris office.

In this role, you will act as the primary point of contact for our largest hospitality customers in France. You will be responsible for driving growth, product adoption, and stakeholder management within your portfolio, with the goal of building true business partnerships. You will leverage data, customer feedback, and your SaaS expertise to create value at the enterprise level, while collaborating closely with teams across the business.



What you’ll do

  • Act as the main point of contact for our largest and most strategic hospitality customers

  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to drive growth, retention, and product adoption

  • Proactively work on increasing product usage and ensure Net Revenue Retention (NRR) grows across your portfolio

  • Plan and lead quarterly business reviews and success plans

  • Analyze usage data, go-live milestones, and health scores to identify and mitigate risks early

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with C-level and operational stakeholders, positioning Lightspeed as a long-term strategic partner

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Implementation, and Support teams to deliver an excellent customer experience

  • Collect customer feedback and proactively share it with relevant teams to identify product gaps and optimize the overall customer journey


What you bring

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Account Management or Strategic Customer Success within a B2B SaaS environment, ideally with enterprise customers

  • A strong understanding of SaaS metrics (NRR, product adoption, expansion, renewals, churn) and the ability to use them to manage your portfolio

  • A strong sense of ownership; you are hands-on, data-driven, and highly skilled in relationship management

title: Strategic Client Manager
descriptionHtml:
About Flock

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

 

About the role

Our largest fleet clients have the most vehicles, the most data and the most to gain from our connected proposition. As our Strategic Client Manager, you’ll be the main face of Flock for them, from multinationals and well-known brands to fast-growing sector leaders, and you’ll own those relationships end to end.

Nearly all our business comes through brokers, so you’ll sit at the centre of the client, broker and Flock relationship, working closely with our Broker Development Managers and teams across the business. You’ll build our corporate client management approach from scratch, from account reviews and performance reporting to bringing claims, safety, underwriting and finance together for our biggest clients. You’ll report to our Head of Distribution and use AI day to day to prepare for meetings, understand accounts and improve reporting. Success means our clients stay with us and recommend us to others.

 

What you’ll be doing

  • Own the relationship with a portfolio of Flock’s largest fleet clients, becoming their primary point of contact and developing a strong understanding of their business.

  • Build and run our corporate account management approach: client reviews, reporting, relationship cadence and account planning.

  • Work closely with brokers and our Broker Development Managers to deliver a coordinated experience for every large corporate client.

  • Bring together teams across Flock, including claims, safety, underwriting and finance, to resolve client questions and issues quickly, and build strong relationships with key stakeholders across client organisations.

  • Identify retention risks early and create clear plans to protect our most important accounts.

  • Help shape and improve Flock’s wider client service proposition, including account reviews, portal engagement, safety support, claims and reporting, feeding client feedback back into the business.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from account research and meeting preparation to query management, meeting summaries and client reporting.

 

What you’ll need

  • Strong experience within the insurance industry, with a clear understanding of the broker–client–insurer dynamic and the judgement to know where you add value, without duplicating the broker’s role, creating confusion or adding unnecessary layers for the client.

  • Experience in a client-facing role such as insurer account or deal management, broker account management, claims relationship management or a similar position.

  • A proven track record of managing important client relationships and delivering strong retention or customer satisfaction, with the confidence to work with senior stakeholders across clients, brokers and internal teams.

  • Strong commercial judgement. You can identify when an account is at risk, understand what matters to the client and build a plan to retain them.

  • Energy and ownership. You’re comfortable picking up a problem, finding the right people and driving it through to a solution.

  • Confident using technology in your daily work, curious about how it can help you work faster and deliver a better client experience.

Nice to have: experience with large, complex or multi-site corporate clients, Commercial Motor Fleet or fleet risk and safety experience, or exposure to claims or to building a client service proposition.

 

Benefits

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. This role is expected to be field based rather than office based, so visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

Making the world quantifiably safer takes more than good data. It takes a team where different perspectives are heard, and that’s a priority here. We insure fleets and drivers from every background, and we know a team built the same way makes sharper decisions and a better product for our customers. So we hire on merit, full stop, and we actively encourage applications from everyone. If you don’t tick every box, apply anyway. Just come as your genuine self: the qualities and experiences only you bring are exactly what we want.

title: Strategic Finance Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
📊 Want to build the finance function of a fast-growing consumer brand from scratch, and sit right next to the founders when the big decisions get made? Then read on. 🐱

At The Better Cat, we are reinventing the pet food market. 🐾 We are a VC-backed startup (backed by FoodLabs, among others) that has become the fastest growing cat food company in Germany and won the Fressnapf Innovation Award in 2024. We sell D2C, on Amazon and increasingly in retail.

This is our first dedicated finance hire, reporting directly to our co-founder Niklas. The role is a real mix: part finance business partner, giving the founding team accurate and timely numbers to decide on, and part hands-on operational finance, building the close and working with our external accountant and tax advisor. We are AI-first and automate wherever we can, so you will have the freedom (and the expectation) to build finance processes the modern way.

Tasks

Financial Planning & Analysis

  • Own forecasting, budgeting and performance analysis.

  • Analyse revenue, gross margin, contribution margin, costs and working capital.

  • Support pricing, promotion, product mix, channel and product portfolio decisions.

Business Partnering & Decision Support

  • Be the primary finance contact for our Growth & Marketing and Supply Chain teams.

  • Translate financial and operational KPIs into clear insights and actions.

  • Challenge assumptions, connect operational decisions to P&L and cash-flow outcomes, and find opportunities to improve profitability and efficiency.

Supply Chain & Working Capital

  • Partner on inventory, procurement, fulfilment, logistics and working capital decisions.

  • Identify opportunities to improve costs, cash flow and operational efficiency.

Strategic Initiatives & Business Cases

  • Build business cases and quantify the financial impact of major initiatives, such as new brand, channel or country launches, and connect them to financial operations.

  • Support the rollout of controlling processes across the organisation.

Accounting

  • Build the monthly and annual close processes from scratch.

  • Work with our external tax advisor and accountants to ensure robust VAT treatment across countries and channels.

Experience & Background

  • 2-4 years of experience in Consulting, Investment Banking, FP&A, Finance Business Partnering, Commercial Finance or Strategic Finance.

  • At least a bachelor's degree in a relevant subject such as Finance, Accounting, Economics or Business. A professional qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or CFA) in progress or newly completed is a plus.

  • Proven ability to run workstreams independently and deliver high-quality output with minimal supervision.

  • Fluent in German and English.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Excel skills, including complex financial modelling and data analysis.

  • Comfortable working with large datasets and turning analysis into clear, concise business insights.

  • Solid understanding of financial statements, management accounting principles and business performance metrics.

Leadership & Communication

  • Strong analytical mindset with excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong commercial mindset and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

  • Clear and confident written and verbal communication, including presenting findings to non-finance stakeholders.

  • Proactive and self-motivated, with an entrepreneurial mindset and comfort in a fast-paced, scaling company.

Benefits

  • 🦁 An inspiring team: Ambitious, fun, down-to-earth and authentic. Come and meet us!

  • 🏗️ Build it your way: As our first finance hire, you shape the finance function, its processes and its tools from day one.

  • 📈 Direct access to the founders: You work daily with Niklas and the founding team and help make decisions instead of just reporting on them.

  • 🤖 AI-first environment: We automate wherever it makes sense and give you room to experiment with the latest tools.

  • 🐱 Great products: It is more fun to stand behind something that truly works. Read our reviews or ask us for a sample!

  • 💝 Cool benefits: Deutschland-Ticket, MacBook, Wellpass, merch, office snacks and drinks.

  • ⭐ Great workplace: Modern office in Hamburg's HafenCity, hybrid setup, flexible working hours and fast personal growth.

🐾 Ready to build the finance engine of a scaling consumer brand and make the world a better place for cats?

Then get in touch! 📩 Send us your CV and a short cover letter and tell us why you are the right person for this role. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Superviseur support client international (Support technique opération de tracking sportif) - (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
McLloyd est une PME technologique française spécialisée dans les solutions de tracking appliquées aux courses. Nos technologies sont notamment utilisées dans plus de 13000 courses hippiques annuelles organisées en France et à l’international.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités, notamment en Australie puis aux États-Unis, nous créons un nouveau pôle de supervision chargé d’accompagner nos clients pendant leurs opérations. Ce service a vocation à évoluer progressivement vers une couverture internationale 24 heures sur 24 et 7 jours sur 7. L’équipe, constituée dans un premier temps de deux superviseurs, sera amenée à s’étoffer pour atteindre probablement quatre personnes.

Nous recherchons aujourd’hui notre nouveau superviseur pour participer au lancement et à la construction de ce pôle.

Vos missions

Votre mission

Pendant les opérations de tracking, vous serez le premier point de contact du client. Vous prendrez en charge ses demandes, réaliserez les premières vérifications, résoudrez les incidents simples en direct et transmettrez les situations nécessitant une expertise complémentaire à notre équipe d’ingénieurs (ticketing)

Il s’agit d’un poste opérationnel et technique, sans responsabilité managériale.

Vos principales responsabilités

  • Superviser à distance le bon déroulement des opérations de tracking ;

  • Répondre aux sollicitations des clients pendant les plages de couverture ;

  • Recueillir et qualifier les informations nécessaires à la compréhension d’un incident ;

  • Effectuer les premières vérifications et appliquer les procédures de dépannage ;

  • Résoudre les incidents de premier niveau ;

  • Créer, documenter et suivre les tickets dans notre outil interne ;

  • Transmettre aux ingénieurs les incidents nécessitant une expertise technique approfondie ;

  • Informer le client de l’avancement de sa demande et suivre l’incident jusqu’à sa résolution ou sa transmission complète ;

  • Tenir à jour la documentation interne ;

  • Rédiger les comptes rendus d’opération (% de réussite, interventions et résolutions) quotidiens et mensuels

  • Préparer les opérations à venir et participer à l’amélioration continue du pôle de supervision.L’activité alterne des périodes de supervision en temps réel et des périodes consacrées à la préparation des opérations, au suivi des tickets, à la documentation et à l’amélioration des procédures.

Organisation du travail et horaires

Le poste est organisé en temps plein annualisé. Le planning est établi à l’avance selon le calendrier international des courses et fonctionne par rotation entre les membres de l’équipe.

  • Horaires de journée, prises de poste tôt le matin et horaires de soirée ;

  • À terme, horaires de nuit dans le cadre du développement aux États-Unis ;

  • Travail régulier le week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Répartition des plages de couverture entre les superviseurs selon un système de rotation.

Actuellement, certaines opérations peuvent commencer dès 3 heures et se terminer jusqu’à 22 heures. Avec le développement de nos activités aux États-Unis, certaines plages de supervision pourront être réalisées pendant la nuit.

L’organisation des rotations sera réalisée dans le respect du temps de travail annualisé, des temps de repos et des dispositions légales et conventionnelles applicables. Les heures de nuit, du dimanche et des jours fériés donneront lieu aux majorations ou compensations prévues au sein de l’entreprise. Cette organisation implique une réelle disponibilité et l’acceptation d’horaires variables. Elle ne signifie toutefois pas que chaque superviseur travaillera systématiquement la nuit ou tous les week-ends.

Vos compétences

Profil recherché

  • Personne sérieuse, ponctuelle, fiable, calme et méthodique face à un incident ;

  • Autonomie et capacité à travailler efficacement à distance ;

  • Aisance dans la relation client, par téléphone comme par écrit ;

  • Capacité à recueillir des informations précises et à les transmettre clairement ;

  • Aisance avec les outils informatiques et les environnements techniques ;

  • Respect des procédures et attention portée à la qualité de la documentation ;

  • Disponibilité pour travailler selon un planning tournant comprenant des horaires de jour, de nuit, de week-end et certains jours fériés ;

  • Connexion internet stable et environnement adapté au télétravail.

Anglais courant obligatoire, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.

Une expérience professionnelle d’au moins deux ans en support client, assistance technique, supervision d’opérations, exploitation informatique, maintenance à distance ou gestion d’incidents est requise.

La connaissance du secteur hippique constitue un plus, mais elle n’est pas indispensable. Une formation aux solutions et aux procédures Mclloyd sera assurée en interne.

Avantages

Conditions proposées

  • CDI à temps plein annualisé ;

The role exists to strengthen our supplier quality processes as ANYbotics scales production and introduces new products. You will work closely with Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, and will spend time directly with suppliers to solve quality issues at the source.

Your Impact

title: Technical Pre-sales Solution Engineer (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

As a Technical Pre-sales Solution Engineer (EMS, PPC & SCADA) at NeuVerge-Tron GmbH, you will serve as the technical lead and solution architect during pre-sales and tender phases for utility-scale renewable energy and energy storage power plants.

In this position, your core product portfolio comprises Energy Management Systems (EMS), Power Plant Controllers (PPC), and SCADA platforms. You will analyze customer requirements, regional Grid Codes, and Transmission/Distribution System Operator (TSO/DSO) mandates, translating them into resilient, high-availability, and cybersecure system architectures.

(Note: This role focuses on control software, industrial automation, and OT system architecture; it does not cover battery cell sizing, containerized mechanical design, or civil EPC scope.)

 

Key Responsibilities

Technical Pre-sales & Bid Management

  • Analyze customer technical specifications, RFIs, RFQs, and RFPs for utility-scale solar, wind, and hybrid BESS assets.

  • Author technical proposals, functional architecture diagrams, and Statements of Work (SOW) for EMS/SCADA solutions.

  • Compile compliance matrices and deviation lists addressing customer specifications and utility regulations.

  • Define the Bill of Materials (BOM), covering server hardware, industrial controllers, networking equipment, software licenses, and engineering services.

  • Lead technical deep-dive workshops, solution demonstrations, and clarification sessions with customers, EPC contractors, and grid operators.

Grid Code Compliance & Functional Control Design

  • Evaluate regional Grid Code regulations across target European markets (e.g., VDE-AR-N 4110/4120, ENTSO-E standards) and translate them into EMS/PPC control requirements

  • Architect plant-level control logic, including Active Power Control, Reactive Power/Power Factor Regulation, POI/PCC Voltage Support, Frequency Response, and Ramp Rate restrictions.

  • Define EMS-level operational strategies, such as automated dispatch tracking, State of Charge (SoC) management constraints, energy arbitrage scheduling, ancillary service controls, and fail-safe/black-start logics.

System Integration & Communication Architecture

  • Design overall system architectures connecting EMS, PPC, SCADA, Historian, and Human-Machine Interfaces (HMI).

  • Define interface specifications for external subsystems: Battery Management Systems (BMS), Power Conversion Systems (PCS), MV switchgear, digital protection relays, power meters, and TSO/DSO dispatch centers.

  • Develop and maintain interface control documents (ICD), data point lists, and signal mapping registers.

  • Implement and validate standard industrial protocols, including Modbus TCP/RTU, IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850 (MMS/GOOSE), DNP3, and OPC UA.

  • Architect high-availability schemes, redundancy topologies, automated failover mechanisms, time synchronization (NTP/PTP), and disaster recovery plans.

OT Networking & Cybersecurity Architecture

  • Design Operational Technology (OT) network topologies, VLAN segmentations, IP addressing schemes, and DMZ firewall policies.

  • Formulate secure remote maintenance topologies, jump host concepts, VPN tunnels, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) mechanisms.

  • Ensure EMS solution adherence to cybersecurity standards, including IEC 62443 and IEC 62351 frameworks.

  • Collaborate with customer IT/OT security teams and external auditors during security reviews and threat modeling assessments.

Verification & Handover

  • Define verification scopes and technical criteria for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), Site Acceptance Testing (SAT), and grid compliance commissioning.

  • Support engineering, commissioning, and project management teams during post-award handover to ensure seamless project delivery.

 

Scope Boundaries

  • To preserve focus on control systems and software integration, this position explicitly excludes:

  • Battery cell/module selection, chemistry evaluation, and electrochemical degradation modeling.

  • Mechanical layout, thermal HVAC design, or fire suppression engineering of BESS containers.

  • Primary high/medium voltage electrical hardware engineering (transformers, switchgear internals, or EPC civil infrastructure).

 

Qualifications & Profile

Education:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Automation, Power Systems, Computer Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.

Professional Experience:

  • 3 to 5+ years of experience in technical presales, solution architecture, or systems engineering focusing on EMS, PPC, or SCADA in power generation or grid utilities.

  • Practical familiarity with grid integration procedures and technical dialogue with European grid operators (TSOs/DSOs).

Technical & Protocol Competencies:

  • Solid understanding of power utility communication standards: IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61850, Modbus TCP/RTU, DNP3, and OPC UA.

  • Hands-on experience with industrial automation platforms (PLCs/RTUs), real-time historians, and SCADA packages.

  • Working knowledge of industrial cybersecurity best practices (IEC 62443 / IEC 62351).

Key Competencies:

  • Strong analytical capability to dissect technical tender documents into structured requirements.

  • Confident presentation skills in customer-facing technical exchanges and contract negotiations.

Language Skills:

  • Professional fluency in English (written and verbal) is required.

  • German language or any other third EU or Chinese proficiency are strongly preferred.

title: Technical Product Lead - AI Investing App
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

 

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

 

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

 

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

 

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

 

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

     

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

     

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

     

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

title: Territory Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
About Team & About Role

Rubrik helps organisations in every major industry stay resilient against cyberattacks, insider threats and operational disruption, protecting the data that hospitals, banks and public institutions depend on every day. As Territory Account Executive in Germany, you’ll build business in one of Europe’s strongest industrial and financial regions, with large Enterprise companies and ambitious Mittelstand firms on your doorstep. You’ll join a close-knit German team that shares deal strategy openly, backed by regional marketing, events and partner support to help you open doors.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a territory of accounts and decide where your time creates the most value.
  • Tier your list and create the entry points that turn them into real opportunities.
  • Generate your own pipeline through outbound, LinkedIn, local events and partners, so that first conversations become qualified deals that protect customers against cyber risk.
  • Make the most of Rubrik’s regional marketing, events and partner activity by following up quickly on the interest it creates in your territory.
  • Run multi-stakeholder sales cycles end to end with MEDDPICC: find the budget owner, build champions and position Rubrik against the full scope of customer risk.
  • Work with Solutions Engineers, Channel Development and partners to extend your reach, and meet customers in person to build lasting relationships.
  • Learn from experienced colleagues through structured enablement and hands-on mentoring, and share what works with the German team in pipeline reviews and deal strategy sessions.
  • Feed local market insight and competitive signals back to Rubrik’s leadership to shape how we go to market in Germany.

Experience You’ll Need

  • A track record of winning new business in B2B enterprise software or SaaS, with consistent quota attainment and self-generated pipeline.
  • Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and engaging technical, security and executive buyers.
  • Fluent German and professional English.
  • A structured approach to qualification and pipeline management, with MEDDPICC or a comparable framework.
  • Based in or near a major German city with convenient transport links, with willingness to travel regularly across your territory.
  • A learning mindset: you seek feedback, adapt quickly and want to keep growing with the support of a hands-on manager.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in cybersecurity, data protection, backup/recovery or adjacent infrastructure and cloud categories. It’s not a must, since we’ll teach you the rest.
  • Experience selling with channel partners.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce for pipeline management and forecasting.

title: VP Data Centres
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT NEXGEN CLOUD

NexGen Cloud is a fast-growing GPU cloud and AI infrastructure business. We’re the company behind Hyperstack — a self-serve, on-demand cloud platform built for high-performance AI, HPC, and compute-heavy workloads. Powered by 100% renewable energy and NVIDIA architecture, Hyperstack gives teams from AI startups to enterprise the compute they need, without the cost or complexity of legacy cloud.

We move fast, solve hard problems, and build things that matter. If you want ownership, real impact, and a front-row seat to one of the most consequential infrastructure shifts of the decade — this is the place.

THE ROLE: VP OF DATA CENTRE STRATEGY

Everything we sell depends on having the right power, in the right place, at the right time. Until now, decisions about where we build, who we partner with and how we secure capacity have been spread across the business. This new role brings them under one owner: someone who sets NexGen’s global data centre strategy and makes sure capacity is there before customers need it.

This is a senior individual contributor role, and it covers both strategy and execution. One day you’re taking a site recommendation to the executive team. The next you’re across the table from a colocation operator negotiating a multi-year contract. We plan to build a dedicated development function over time. Until then, you’ll do more of the hands-on delivery work yourself, and you’ll help decide when that team gets built.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING

Rather than a checklist, here’s what success in this role actually looks like:
- Build and own NexGen’s global data centre strategy and the 12–36 month capacity roadmap, so capacity is never the reason we miss a customer commitment
- Decide which markets and regions we expand into, set the criteria for choosing sites, and build a pipeline of data centre opportunities against them
- Make the call on colocation vs. owned infrastructure, and own the investment case for each site
- Secure reliable, cost-effective power for GPU-dense workloads, in line with our 100% renewable commitment, and spot grid and capacity constraints before they hit customers
- Lead the big negotiations on colocation agreements, power contracts and strategic vendor deals, and hold partners to their SLAs
- Set NexGen’s position on data sovereignty and planning across jurisdictions, and deal with regulators and government directly when the stakes are high
- Bring cost per MW and cost per GPU rack down, and make sure capex goes where the commercial pipeline needs it

ABOUT YOU

We care more about how you think and work than a perfect CV. You’ll likely bring a combination of the following:

Essential:
- 10+ years in data centre infrastructure, with significant time in a senior strategy, development or commercial role
- A proven track record in site selection, colocation negotiation and data centre partner management at scale
- A deep understanding of power procurement and capacity planning, and of the commercial side of running GPU-dense AI infrastructure
- Experience negotiating complex, multi-year contracts with data centre operators and vendors
- An established network across the colocation ecosystem, plus experience at or with neoclouds, hyperscalers or GPU infrastructure platforms

Nice to Have:
- Power procurement for high-density compute specifically, rather than general enterprise space
- Grid connection, sovereign cloud or government engagement in more than one jurisdiction
- Existing relationships with renewable power providers or experience structuring PPAs
- Experience growing an infrastructure function from a standalone role into a team, including deciding when to bring in dedicated delivery capability

WHAT WE OFFER

- Competitive salary and annual discretionary bonus scheme
- Employee wellbeing benefits
- 25 days holiday, plus public holidays
- Private Medical Insurance
- Enhanced Pension Scheme
- Flexible working arrangements (remote or hybrid, depending on role and location)
- Real ownership and autonomy — the trust to take initiative and experiment
- Visible, meaningful impact as we scale
- Clear career progression in a high-growth company
- A collaborative, international culture built on trust, transparency, and ownership
- The chance to help shape NexGen Cloud’s team, culture, and future

WHY APPLY

We welcome applications from all backgrounds. If you enjoy solving complex infrastructure problems and want to build something meaningful at scale, we’d like to hear from you.

MORE INFORMATION

Visit our careers page to learn more about us or follow us on LinkedIn and X to learn more about our journey and keep up with our latest news and releases.

title: VP, Software Engineering (NwPS)
descriptionHtml:
Join Vonage and help us innovate cloud communications for businesses worldwide!

Job Title: Head of NwPS Engineering 

Location: Global / Remote (preference for US, UK, or Spain) 

About the Role 

The Head of NwPS Engineering is a VP-level leadership role responsible for the full engineering delivery and technical strategy of Vonage’s Network Powered Solutions business. This is not a delivery management role — it is an engineering leadership role that carries end-to-end accountability for the platform powering Vonage’s fastest-growing business unit. 

NwPS is Vonage’s strategic growth engine, commercialising mobile network operator capabilities as developer APIs — including Verify, Silent Authentication, SIM Swap, Number Verification, and Quality on Demand — for enterprise customers across FinTech, Healthcare, Transportation, and beyond. The engineering function that supports it spans multiple squads, complex multi-CSP integrations, a rapidly evolving product portfolio, and an emerging AI and agentic engineering capability. 

The Head of NwPS Engineering will own the vision, structure, and execution of this engineering function. They will report directly to the SA NwPS General Manager and serve as a key voice on the NwPS leadership team. 

Key Responsibilities 

Engineering Delivery 

  • Full engineering accountability for: Verify, VNA (Vonage Network APIs), Connectors, Intelligence Engine, Advanced NwPS, and future NwPS products 
  • Ownership of all NwPS squad delivery across Platform, Network Features, Identity Insights, Frontend, and Verify 
  • QA Excellence and SDET capability across NwPS engineering 
  • DevRel engineering in support of the NwPS developer ecosystem 
  • Operational Excellence, SRE practices, and platform reliability 

Architecture 

  • End-to-end architectural accountability for NwPS engineering 
  • Direct leadership of the NwPS Architecture function (Architecture Lead reports to this role) 
  • Ownership of architectural standards, technical design governance, and domain architecture across NwPS products 
  • Technical decision-making authority for platform design, CSP integration patterns, and engineering standards 

Strategic Engineering Leadership 

  • Agentic AI and MCP engineering strategy and execution 
  • Engineering roadmap aligned with NwPS product strategy and commercial OKRs 
  • Representation on the SA NwPS leadership team alongside NwPS Product, Solution Sales, and Strategic BD 
  • Cross-functional partnership with CTO, Architecture, and SA CPaaS Engineering on shared platform standards and practices 

Reporting Structure 

This role leads the NwPS Architecture Lead and the squad leads for Platform, Network Features, Identity Insights, Frontend, Verify, and SDET Improvements. 

The engineering organisation comprises approximately 40+ engineers across the squads, with seven direct reports once the Architecture Lead position is filled. 

 Qualifications and Experience 

Engineering Vision and Strategy 

  • Demonstrated ability to set and communicate a multi-year engineering vision for a complex, API-native product portfolio 
  • Experience leading engineering for developer-facing or telco/network API products is strongly preferred 
  • Proven capability to align engineering strategy with product roadmap and commercial priorities — not just execute against them 

Leadership at Scale 

  • Track record of leading distributed, multi-squad engineering organisations across multiple geographies 
  • Ability to develop and retain engineering talent at all levels, including squad leads and senior engineers 
  • Experience managing engineering through periods of significant growth and structural change 

Technical Depth 

  • Strong grounding in API platform architecture, distributed systems, and cloud-native engineering 
  • Familiarity with CSP/telco network API standards (CAMARA, GSMA) is a significant advantage 
  • Hands-on architecture experience sufficient to provide meaningful technical guidance to the Architecture function 

Execution and Accountability 

  • History of delivering complex, multi-CSP or multi-partner integrations on aggressive timelines 
  • Operational rigour: reliability, KTLO management, cycle time, and quality engineering are active leadership priorities, not delegated concerns 

Why This Role Matters 

NwPS is building the infrastructure for a market that is still being defined. Carrier-grade, developer-accessible network APIs are emerging as a category, and Vonage is positioned to lead it. The Head of NwPS Engineering will be the person who ensures the engineering organisation is built to move fast, scale reliably, and stay ahead of a rapidly evolving technical landscape. 

This is a role for someone who wants to build something, not manage something that already exists. 

About Vonage and SA NwPS 

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader, part of the Ericsson group. The NwPS Solution Area is Vonage’s dedicated business unit for Network Powered Solutions — commercialising mobile network operator capabilities as developer APIs for enterprise customers globally. NwPS operates as a standalone business with its own P&L accountability, product roadmap, sales motion, and engineering function.

Vonage is a global cloud communications leader. BuildlinX entwickelt die nächste Generation der Gebäudeautomation. Damit packen wir eines der größten Klimaprobleme unserer Zeit an: Der Gebäudebetrieb verursacht rund 30 % der globalen CO₂-Emissionen. Genau hier setzen wir an - und machen Gebäude grundlegend effizienter und klimafreundlicher.

This is not your typical student job.

Something most students never get to see.

RIZM builds RIZMO, an AI agent that makes energy decisions for industrial companies. Our next lever is the public sector: municipalities, utilities and economic development agencies have to implement heat plans, keep business parks competitive and relieve the grid. We're building B2G as a new business line at RIZM, and we're looking for a working student to help build it from day one.

  • Ownership: You work independently and like to take responsibility.

04 · Why you should apply now

B2G is a new business line at RIZM. Join now and help shape it from the start.

  • Real responsibility: In a business line we're building from scratch.

  • Founders: You work directly with them.

  • Insight: Into public funding, research projects and municipal decision-making.

  • Real customers: Our product already runs at industrial customers like BMW and BSH.

05 · One click, then what?

Your application: Send us your CV and, instead of a classic cover letter, a few honest sentences on these two questions.

You will join our team at the intersection of international trade, export control, and day-to-day operations at STARK. From day one, you will work on real cases and gain practical experience in a fast-paced international environment.
